chinese: {{count}} 筆通聯在未經你確認的情況下被記錄——佇列已滿。它們已寫入你的日誌，聯結器將上傳它們；連線日誌中會標明它們。

english: {{count}} contacts were logged without your confirmation — the queue was full. They are in your log and your connectors will upload them; the Connections log names them.
chinese: {{count}} 筆通聯在未經你確認的情況下被記錄——佇列已滿。它們已寫入你的日誌，聯結器將上傳它們；連線日誌中會標明它們。

english: Share card copied — paste it anywhere
chinese: 分享卡已複製——可貼上到任意位置

english: Could not save the share card: {{detail}}
Not saved: picking {{contest}} would end the running contest, and the station could not check that {{contest}} can start.
chinese: 未儲存：選擇 {{contest}} 會結束正在進行的比賽，且電台無法確認 {{contest}} 能否啟動。

english: Contest mode is on, but the contest is not running.
chinese: 比賽模式已開啟，但比賽未進行。

english: Band changed: the log line for {{call}} was set aside. Restore puts it back, to log on {{band}}.
chinese: 波段已變更：{{call}} 的日誌行已被暫存。恢復將把它放回，以在 {{band}} 上記錄。

english: Band changed: the log line was set aside. Restore puts it back, to log on {{band}}.
chinese: 波段已變更：日誌行已被暫存。恢復將把它放回，以在 {{band}} 上記錄。

english: A contest contact logs on the band the radio is on: go back to {{band}} to restore it.
chinese: 比賽通聯記錄在目前電台所在波段：回到 {{band}} 以恢復它。

english: Saving would switch the running contest to {{contest}}, which cannot start yet: {{reason}}
chinese: 儲存會將正在進行的比賽切換為 {{contest}}，但該比賽尚無法啟動：{{reason}}

english: Band — your last frequency on this band in this mode this session, else the start of your licensed segment
chinese: 波段——本工作階段中此模式下該波段的上次頻率，否則為你授權頻段起點

english: No current band-condition data for this band
chinese: 該波段暫無即時傳播條件資料

english: TX locked — your split transmit frequency, {{tx}} MHz, is outside your license privileges. Receiving on {{rx}} MHz is fine.
chinese: TX 鎖定——你的分頻發射頻率 {{tx}} MHz 超出授權範圍。在 {{rx}} MHz 接收不受影響。

english: This frequency/mode is outside your license privileges — transmit is blocked. Pick a band above, or change your license class in Settings.
chinese: 此頻率/模式超出你的授權範圍——發射被阻止。請在上方選擇波段，或在設定中更改執照等級。

english: 60 m allows only USB phone — transmit is blocked. Pick USB or AUTO.
chinese: 60 米僅允許 USB 話音——發射被阻止。請選擇 USB 或 AUTO。
選擇一個波段規劃頻道

english: Your licence class has no transmit privileges on this band. You can tune here and listen; transmitting will be refused.
chinese: 你的執照等級在此波段無發射權限。你可在此調諧並收聽；發射將被拒絕。

english: The dial is not on a listed channel for this mode. Pick a channel here, or type a frequency.
chinese: 旋鈕未停在此模式的任一已列頻道上。請在此選擇頻道，或輸入頻率。

english: Scroll a digit to tune it (100 Hz … 10 MHz) · ←/→ pick a digit, ↑/↓ spin it · click to type a frequency (MHz)
chinese: 捲動某位數字進行調諧（100 Hz … 10 MHz）· ←/→ 選擇數字位，↑/↓ 增減 · 點選輸入頻率（MHz）
顯示/隱藏顏色與型別圖例

english: Open the vertical band map in its own window
chinese: 在新視窗開啟豎向波段圖

english: Your licensed phone segment on this band
chinese: 你在此波段上獲授權的語音段

english: You: {{freq}} MHz — transmit blocked (outside your privileges)
chinese: 你：{{freq}} MHz —— 發射被阻止（超出授權範圍）

english: This install's build stamp — confirm a fresh install actually took
chinese: 本次安裝的構建戳——確認全新安裝確實生效

english: Check for a newer Nexus release
chinese: 檢查是否有更新的 Nexus 版本

english: Your whole setup in one file — for a new computer, before a rebuild, or to get back to a known-good state. These used to live under Radio → Transmit limits & sharing, where nobody found them.
chinese: 你整套設定就在這一個檔案裡——換台電腦、重建系統前，或想回到已知的良好狀態時使用。它們原本放在電台 → 發射限制與共享下，沒人找得到。

english: Erase all settings and return to factory defaults
chinese: 清除所有設定並恢復出廠預設

english: Erases your radios, audio devices, callsign and preferences. Your logbook is not touched, and stored passwords stay in your keychain (clear those individually under Logging & Connectors). Back up first — this cannot be undone.
chinese: 清除你的電台、音訊裝置、呼號與偏好設定。你的日誌簿不受影響，已存密碼仍留在鑰匙串中（需在「日誌與連線」下逐條清除）。請先備份——此操作不可復原。

english: Enter your callsign on the Station tab before saving.
chinese: 儲存前請先在「本台」索引標籤填寫呼號。

english: Name this position on the Contesting tab before hosting or joining a club event — the club band board shows this name.
chinese: 在「比賽」索引標籤為此位置命名，再主持或加入俱樂部活動——俱樂部波段榜單會顯示此名稱。

english: {{group}} is a group that cannot be joined. Take it out of Groups under JS8 on the Digital tab before saving.
chinese: {{group}} 是一個無法加入的組。儲存前請在「數字」索引標籤的 JS8 下將其移出「組」。

english: The JS8 CQ message must start with CQ or hold your callsign, as in JS8Call. Change it under JS8 on the Digital tab before saving.
chinese: JS8 的 CQ 報文必須以 CQ 開頭或包含你的呼號，如同 JS8Call 那樣。儲存前請在「數字」索引標籤的 JS8 下修改。

english: Share this radio with other programs and Share by TCI both use port {{port}}, and only one of them can have it. Give one of them another port.
chinese: 本電台與其他程式共享、以及透過 TCI 共享都使用連線埠 {{port}}，二者只能有一方佔用。請給其中一方換個連線埠。

english: Switch a whole rig / antenna / CAT / band setup in one move.
chinese: 一鍵切換整套電台 / 天線 / CAT / 波段配置。

english: Apply this profile — merged onto your current settings. Your callsign, license class, radio roster and sync history never come from a profile, and anything the profile predates keeps its current value.
chinese: 應用此方案——合併到目前設定之上。你的呼號、執照等級、電台清單與同步歷史不會來自方案，方案未涵蓋的部分保留現有值。

english: Snapshots the current settings under a name.
chinese: 將目前設定以名稱儲存為快照。

english: Picks which screens are on and how much of Settings opens at first. Changing it replaces the set in Settings ▸ Appearance ▸ Features. Every setting stays reachable by search.
chinese: 決定哪些介面開啟、以及首次開啟設定時展開多少。更改會替換「設定 ▸ 外觀 ▸ 功能」中的組合。每項設定仍可透過搜尋找到。
無法儲存你的經驗水平

english: These screens turn off: {{screens}}. You can turn any of them back on in Settings ▸ Appearance ▸ Features.
chinese: 以下介面將關閉：{{screens}}。你可隨時在「設定 ▸ 外觀 ▸ 功能」中重新開啟其中任意一項。

english: Your own mix of these settings. It matches none of the looks, and a tap on one replaces it.
chinese: 你自己的這些設定組合。它不匹配任何預設風格，點選任一預設會將其替換。

english: Put back the settings you had before this look
chinese: 恢復應用此風格前的設定

english: Shack, Field / POTA and Night set up the whole screen. Contest, Big & clear and Touch set text size, density and contrast, and keep Field mode and Night as they are. No look changes your theme, UI scale, colours, waterfall palettes or a Night set to Auto.
chinese: 機房、野外 / POTA 與夜間會配置整個螢幕。比賽、大號清晰與觸控只設定字號、密度與對比度，並保持野外模式與夜間不變。任何風格都不會更改你的主題、UI 縮放、顏色、瀑布調色盤，或設為自動的夜間模式。

english: The language Nexus writes in. Frequencies, signal reports, callsigns, grid squares, band and mode names are never translated or reformatted — a dial reads the same in every language.
chinese: Nexus 所用的語言。頻率、訊號報告、呼號、網格、波段與模式名稱一律不翻譯、不改格式——在任何語言下，錶盤讀數都相同。

english: Light reads best outdoors in daylight; the top bar’s Field chip boosts contrast and size in whichever theme you use.
chinese: 淺色在白天戶外最易讀；無論用哪種主題，頂欄的「野外」按鈕都會增強對比度與字號。

english: Stronger text-against-background in whichever theme you are using, at the size you already have. Turn this on if the screen is hard to read — it does not change the UI scale.
chinese: 在你所用的主題下增強文字與背景的對比，並保持現有字號。若螢幕難讀可開啟——它不改變 UI 縮放。

english: Field mode is on, so high contrast is applied already. This setting is your own standing choice, and it is what the screen keeps when you turn Field mode off.
chinese: 野外模式已開啟，因此高對比度已應用。此設定是你自己的常駐選擇，關閉野外模式後螢幕會保持這一選擇。

english: A darker, warmer screen for operating after dark, in whichever theme you use. The transmit red, alerts and signal colours stay exactly as they are.
chinese: 在你所用的主題下，提供更暗、更暖的螢幕以便天黑後操作。發射紅、報警與訊號顏色保持原樣不變。

english: Comes on at dusk and goes off at dawn at your grid square: when the sun is 6° below the horizon there.
chinese: 在你網格所在地，黃昏開啟、黎明關閉：即當地太陽落到地平線以下 6° 時。

english: Auto needs your grid square (Settings ▸ Station ▸ Grid) to know when the sun sets. Until it has one, Night stays off.
chinese: 自動模式需要你的網格（設定 ▸ 本台 ▸ 網格）才能判斷日落時間。在獲得網格之前，夜間模式保持關閉。

english: Maximum contrast and larger type in one switch — for daylight outdoors, and for any screen that is hard to read. The same control as the Field chip in the top bar.
chinese: 一個開關即可達到最大對比度與更大字號——適用於白天戶外，以及任何難讀的螢幕。它與頂欄的「野外」按鈕是同一控制元件。

english: This window only fits up to {{fits}}% — a larger window or monitor unlocks {{wanted}}%.
chinese: 此視窗最多只能適配到 {{fits}}%——放大視窗或使用更大顯示器可解鎖 {{wanted}}%。

english: Fits the whole interface to the window so nothing is cut off (currently {{scale}}%). This window maxes out at {{fits}}% — raising the cap can't help until you enlarge the window, or switch to Manual to force a bigger scale.
chinese: 將整個介面適配到視窗，確保不被裁切（目前 {{scale}}%）。此視窗最大為 {{fits}}%——在放大視窗前提高上限無濟於事，或切換到手動以強制更大縮放。

english: Fits the whole interface to the window so nothing is cut off (currently {{scale}}%). This window fits up to {{fits}}%; bigger caps need a larger window or monitor. The waterfall stays sharp.
chinese: 將整個介面適配到視窗，確保不被裁切（目前 {{scale}}%）。此視窗最多適配到 {{fits}}%；更大的上限需要更大的視窗或顯示器。瀑布圖仍保持清晰。

english: Fits the whole interface to the window so nothing is cut off (currently {{scale}}%). The waterfall stays sharp. Raise the max for big monitors.
chinese: 將整個介面適配到視窗，確保不被裁切（目前 {{scale}}%）。瀑布圖仍保持清晰。大顯示器可提高上限。

english: Fixed scale. Switch to Auto to fit the interface to the window automatically.
chinese: 固定縮放。切換到自動可將介面自動適配視窗。

english: Makes all the text bigger, including the decode and log lists. UI scale above zooms the whole screen instead.
chinese: 放大所有文字，包括譯碼清單與日誌清單。上方的 UI 縮放則是縮放整個螢幕。

english: How tightly rows and controls pack. Compact fits more on screen. Touch makes buttons big enough for a finger.
chinese: 行與控制元件排布的緊密程度。緊湊可在螢幕放下更多。觸控讓按鈕大到適合手指點按。

english: Open the station card when the pointer rests on a call
chinese: 指標停在呼號上時開啟電台卡片

english: A click on a call, or Enter on it, always opens its card. On: resting the pointer on a call for half a second opens it too.
chinese: 點選呼號或在其上按Enter，總會開啟其卡片。開啟後：指標停在呼號上停留半秒也會開啟。

english: Show the 3-D globe above the Logbook
chinese: 在日誌簿上方顯示 3D 地球

english: The 3-D globe above the Logbook table. Turn it off and the table starts at the top.
chinese: 日誌簿表格上方的 3D 地球。關閉後表格從頂部開始。

english: The columns and widths chosen in the Logbook (its Columns button), kept with your settings. Reset puts back the default table.
chinese: 在日誌簿中所選的列與欄寬（其「列」按鈕），隨你的設定一起儲存。重設恢復預設表格。
本地時間（與 UTC 並列）

english: Show this computer's local time next to the UTC clock in the top bar. Logs, spots and FT slots always use UTC.
chinese: 在頂欄的 UTC 時鐘旁顯示本機本地時間。日誌、頻點播報與 FT 時隙一律使用 UTC。

english: Restore the default left/right pane widths.
chinese: 恢復預設的左右面板寬度。

english: Band Activity — heard on the band
chinese: 波段活動——本波段上聽到的訊號

english: The radio reports 0% power and transmit is armed — it will key and put nothing on the air. Check the Pwr slider, and the rig’s own power for THIS mode: Yaesu rigs keep a separate level for SSB, DATA, CW and AM.
chinese: 電台報告功率為 0% 且發射已待發——它會鍵控卻不在空中發出任何訊號。請檢查功率滑桿，以及本模式下電台自身的功率設定：Yaesu 電台對 SSB、DATA、CW 和 AM 各自保留獨立的電平。

english: Your Parsec session dropped (or Parsec’s log stopped answering) at {{time}} UTC, so Nexus stopped: {{what}}. Nothing was restarted; key up again when you are back.
chinese: 你的 Parsec 工作階段在 {{time}} UTC 斷開（或 Parsec 的日誌停止響應），因此 Nexus 停止了：{{what}}。未重啟任何內容；回來後再重新鍵控。

english: The radio did not accept PTT at {{time}} UTC ({{why}}), so that over was not sent and TX was turned off. Check your PTT method and CAT/port, then turn TX on again.
chinese: 電台在 {{time}} UTC 未接受 PTT（{{why}}），因此該次通聯未發出且發射已關閉。請檢查你的 PTT 方式與 CAT/連線埠，然後重新開啟發射。

english: Nexus did not key the {{mode}} over at {{time}} UTC: Flex native DAX audio is on, but the radio was not yet taking its transmit audio from Nexus over DAX. Nothing was sent and TX was turned off. Nexus finishes setting the radio up within a moment; then turn TX on again.
chinese: Nexus 未在 {{time}} UTC 鍵控 {{mode}} 通聯：Flex 原生 DAX 音訊已開啟，但電台尚未從其經 DAX 接收來自 Nexus 的發射音訊。未發出任何內容，發射已關閉。Nexus 會在片刻內完成電台設定；隨後請重新開啟發射。

english: Nexus did not key the {{mode}} over at {{time}} UTC: Flex native DAX audio is off, but the radio was still taking its transmit audio from DAX, as Nexus had set it, and nothing feeds DAX now. Nothing was sent and TX was turned off. Nexus puts the radio back on its mic input within a moment; then turn TX on again.
chinese: Nexus 未在 {{time}} UTC 鍵控 {{mode}} 通聯：Flex 原生 DAX 音訊已關閉，但電台仍按 Nexus 所設從其經 DAX 接收發射音訊，而此刻 DAX 無輸入。未發出任何內容，發射已關閉。Nexus 會在片刻內將電台切回麥克風輸入；隨後請重新開啟發射。

english: Nexus did not key the radio at {{time}} UTC because the transmit audio output would not open ({{why}}). Nothing was sent and TX was turned off. Check Output Device (TX) in Settings (another program may be holding it, or it is unplugged), then turn TX on again.
chinese: Nexus 未在 {{time}} UTC 鍵控電台，因為發射音訊輸出無法開啟（{{why}}）。未發出任何內容，發射已關閉。請檢查設定中的輸出裝置（TX）（可能有其他程式佔用，或裝置已拔出），然後重新開啟發射。
PTT 關閉失敗——發射停止

english: The radio did not accept PTT off at {{time}} UTC ({{why}}), so TX was turned off. It may still be transmitting: check the radio now. Nexus keeps sending PTT off until the radio accepts it. Turn TX on again once the radio is receiving.
chinese: 電台在 {{time}} UTC 未接受 PTT 關閉（{{why}}），因此發射已關閉。它可能仍在發射：請立即檢查電台。Nexus 會持續傳送 PTT 關閉指令，直到電台接受。待電台恢復接收後再重新開啟發射。

english: The route carrying an over's audio to the radio (Flex DAX or TCI) stopped at {{time}} UTC in the middle of the over, so the rest of it would have gone out silent. Nexus ended the over there and turned TX off. Turn TX on again to carry on.
chinese: 承載某次通聯音訊至電台的路由（Flex DAX 或 TCI）在該次通聯中途於 {{time}} UTC 中斷，因此其餘部分會靜默發出。Nexus 就此結束該次通聯並關閉發射。請重新開啟發射以繼續。
通聯丟棄——電台鍵控過晚

english: This over was dropped: the radio keyed only at {{time}} UTC, {{late}} after your period had ended (slow CAT), so Nexus unkeyed it at once and sent nothing, and left TX on for your next over. Split operation sends the radio its commands before each key, which on a slow CAT link can take seconds: if this keeps happening, check the CAT link and Split operation in Settings.
chinese: 此次通聯被丟棄：電台僅在 {{time}} UTC 鍵控，即你的時隙結束後 {{late}}（CAT 較慢），因此 Nexus 立即解除鍵控且未傳送任何內容，並保持發射開啟以等待你的下一次通聯。分頻操作會在每次鍵控前向電台傳送指令，在慢速 CAT 鏈路上可能耗時數秒：若此情況持續，請檢查設定中的 CAT 鏈路與分頻操作。

english: Nexus did not key the {{mode}} over at {{time}} UTC: the radio was still taking its transmit audio from DAX, as Nexus had set it, not from its mic, so your voice would not have gone out. Nothing was sent. Let go of PTT and Nexus puts the radio back on its mic input within a moment; then press PTT again.
chinese: Nexus 未在 {{time}} UTC 鍵控 {{mode}} 通聯：電台仍按 Nexus 所設從其經 DAX 接收發射音訊，而非來自麥克風，因此你的語音不會發出。未傳送任何內容。鬆開 PTT，Nexus 會在片刻內將電台切回麥克風輸入；隨後再次按下 PTT。

english: Nexus did not play the voice message at {{time}} UTC: the radio did not switch its transmit audio to DAX within 2 seconds, so nothing was keyed. The message was dropped, not held; press its key again.
chinese: Nexus 未在 {{time}} UTC 播放語音訊息：電台未在 2 秒內將其發射音訊切換至 DAX，因此未鍵控任何內容。該訊息被丟棄而非暫存；請再次按下其按鍵。

english: Nexus did not play the voice message at {{time}} UTC: something else was transmitting or keyed the radio first (your mic or PTT, a tune carrier, another program), so nothing was keyed. The message was dropped, not held.
chinese: Nexus 未在 {{time}} UTC 播放語音訊息：另有程式正在發射或已先行鍵控電台（你的麥克風或 PTT、一個調諧載波、另一程式），因此未鍵控任何內容。該訊息被丟棄而非暫存。

english: Nexus is repairing this computer’s clock. Nothing starts transmitting until the repair finishes, two minutes at most, so the clock cannot move in the middle of an over.
chinese: Nexus 正在修復本機時鐘。在修復完成前（最多兩分鐘）不會開始發射，以免時鐘在通聯中途移動。

english: A newly signed-in Remote device is waiting for your approval. Press Allow to transmit under Settings ▸ Remote to let it transmit.
chinese: 一台新登入的遠端裝置正在等待你的批准。請前往設定 ▸ 遠端，按下「允許」以讓其發射。

english: No live propagation data yet — set your callsign in Settings and check your internet connection.
chinese: 尚無即時傳播資料——請在設定中填寫呼號並檢查網路連線。

english: Live propagation refetch failed — showing the last-good snapshot.
chinese: 即時傳播重新獲取失敗——顯示最後一次有效的快照。

english: Any messages still waiting to send will be cancelled. This can't be undone.
chinese: 任何仍在等待傳送的訊息將被取消。此操作無法復原。

english: Stopped at the {{band}} band edge, {{edge}} MHz — scroll again to keep tuning down
chinese: 已在 {{band}} 波段邊緣停下，{{edge}} MHz——再次捲動以繼續向下調諧

english: {{label}} — trim so your rig's ALC is just zero
chinese: {{label}}——微調使你的電台 ALC 剛好歸零
共 {{total}} 條中的第 1 條

english: Clear this alarm once you have checked the radio. An alarm raised since stays on screen.
chinese: 檢查電台後清除此報警。之後新產生的報警會保留在螢幕上。

english: Could not clear the transmitter alarm

chinese: 交換 VFO A 與 B

english: Swap VFO A and B — each dial keeps its frequency and they change places, so the one you were listening on is a press away.
chinese: 交換 VFO A 與 B——每個錶盤保留各自頻率並互換位置，因此你正在監聽的那個只差一鍵之遙。
穩健非相干層級——抗衰落（15 秒）

english: FT2 — Decodium’s fast slotted mode (3.75 s), FT4 with a halved symbol time. Transmit and receive. No settings: the period is fixed
chinese: FT2——Decodium 的快速時隙模式（3.75 秒），即符號時長減半的 FT4。可發射與接收。無設定：時隙固定

english: WSPR propagation beacons — 2 min intervals. Transmits on a schedule; set the transmit % and power in Settings ▸ Beacons (WSPR & FST4W)
chinese: WSPR 傳播信標——間隔 2 分鐘。按計劃發射；在設定 ▸ 信標（WSPR 與 FST4W）中設定發射百分比與功率

english: Q65 — EME / VHF+ scatter. Transmit and receive. Period + submode in Settings ▸ Q65
chinese: Q65——EME / VHF+ 散射。可發射與接收。週期 + 子模式在設定 ▸ Q65

english: MSK144 — meteor scatter. Transmits for nearly the whole period (that is how the mode works). Period in Settings ▸ MSK144
chinese: MSK144——流星散射。幾乎整段週期都在發射（即該模式的工作方式）。週期在設定 ▸ MSK144

english: JT65 — classic EME, 60 s. Receive only in this build (transmit is disabled pending a fix). Submode in Settings ▸ JT65
chinese: JT65——經典 EME，60 秒。本版本僅接收（發射因待修復而禁用）。子模式在設定 ▸ JT65

english: FST4 — slow weak-signal QSO mode (LF/MF). Transmit and receive
chinese: FST4——慢速弱訊號 QSO 模式（LF/MF）。可發射與接收

english: FST4W — LF/MF beacons. Transmits on a schedule; set the transmit % and power in Settings ▸ Beacons (WSPR & FST4W). Hashed calls show as <...>
chinese: FST4W——LF/MF 信標。按計劃發射；在設定 ▸ 信標（WSPR 與 FST4W）中設定發射百分比與功率。雜湊呼號顯示為 <...>

english: This mode is receive-only in Nexus — it decodes but does not transmit
chinese: 此模式在 Nexus 中僅接收——可譯碼但不發射

english: Field mode is on: larger type, maximum contrast. Click to turn off.
chinese: 野外模式已開啟：更大字號、最大對比度。點選關閉。

english: Field mode for operating outdoors: larger type, maximum contrast
chinese: 用於戶外操作的野外模式：更大字號、最大對比度

english: Operating as {{call}} — click to change who is at the key
chinese: 正以 {{call}} 身份操作——點選更改誰在鍵控

english: Nobody is set as the operator — click to say who is at the key
chinese: 尚未設定操作員——點選說明誰在鍵控

english: No operators logged yet — set the first one on the Contest screen
chinese: 尚無已記錄的操作員——請在比賽螢幕設定第一位

english: Your rig is on {{rig}}, but Nexus has {{believed}}. Turn the rig's mode knob (or pick the band in an operating cockpit) to match.
chinese: 你的電台目前在 {{rig}}，但 Nexus 判斷為 {{believed}}。請轉動電台的模式旋鈕（或在操作台中選擇波段）以匹配。

english: RX audio level (aim ~30 dB, like WSJT-X)
chinese: RX 音訊電平（目標約 30 dB，與 WSJT-X 相同）

english: Recording this QSO to a WAV — click to stop
chinese: 正在將本次 QSO 錄製為 WAV——點選停止

english: Hold Tx Freq: keep your TX offset where you put it when you double-click a station to work them. Off, your TX moves onto theirs (WSJT-X's behaviour). A plain waterfall click never moves TX either way.
chinese: 保持發射頻率：當你按兩下某電台以通聯時，讓你的 TX 偏移停留在你放置的位置。關閉時，你的 TX 會移動到對方頻率（WSJT-X 的行為）。純瀑布圖點選則無論如何都不移動 TX。

english: Your PC clock is {{offset}} off UTC and Nexus is already correcting for it — transmit and decode windows land on the true UTC grid. Measured {{age}} ago, {{servers}} time servers agreeing.
chinese: 你的 PC 時鐘相對 UTC 偏差 {{offset}}，Nexus 已在糾正——發射與譯碼視窗落在真實的 UTC 網格上。於 {{age}} 前測得，{{servers}} 台時間伺服器一致。

english: Logged QSO times still come from the PC clock, so this one is worth fixing at the machine.
chinese: 記錄的 QSO 時間仍來自 PC 時鐘，因此值得在機器層面修復這一點。

english: The last UTC measurement was {{age}} ago and has aged out, so Nexus has stopped correcting — slot timing now follows the PC clock directly. It resumes on its own as soon as a time server answers.
chinese: 上次 UTC 測量在 {{age}} 前進行，已過期，因此 Nexus 停止了糾正——時隙時序現在直接跟隨 PC 時鐘。一旦有時間伺服器應答，會自動恢復。

english: Your PC clock is {{offset}} off UTC — too far for Nexus to correct, and your logged QSO times would be wrong by the same amount. Set the clock on the machine itself (off-grid: GPS).
chinese: 你的 PC 時鐘相對 UTC 偏差 {{offset}}——偏差過大，Nexus 無法糾正，且你記錄的 QSO 時間會錯同樣多。請在機器本身校正時鐘（離網：GPS）。

english: Fix what the clock check found. Windows asks for administrator rights first, and Nexus runs the fix only when you press this.
chinese: 修復時鐘檢查所發現的問題。Windows 會先請求管理員權限，Nexus 僅在按下此項時才執行修復。

english: Not while transmitting: a clock repair can move the clock in the middle of an over. Try again when the transmitter is idle.
chinese: 發射時不可修復：時鐘修復可能在一次通聯中途移動時鐘。待發射機空閒後重試。

english: Not in the middle of a message: a JS8 or Tempo message is still going out, and a clock repair would pause it between two of its overs. Try again when it has finished.
chinese: 不可在訊息中途進行：一條 JS8 或 Tempo 訊息仍在發出，時鐘修復會在其兩次發射之間暫停它。待其完成後重試。

english: A clock repair is already running. Answer the Windows prompt, or wait for it to finish.
chinese: 時鐘修復已在執行。請應答 Windows 提示，或等待其完成。

english: There is nothing to repair now: the latest clock check found nothing to fix.
chinese: 目前無需修復：最新的時鐘檢查未發現要修復的問題。

english: Clock repaired. Hover the clock readout to see what changed.
chinese: 時鐘已修復。懸停時鐘讀數可檢視更改內容。

english: The clock was not repaired: the administrator prompt was declined, or Windows refused a step.
chinese: 時鐘未被修復：管理員提示被拒絕，或 Windows 拒絕了某一步驟。
時間同步正常（依據譯碼時序）

english: Decodes land far off the slot boundary and no NTP measurement has come back yet, so nothing is being corrected. Check the network, or set the PC clock (off-grid: GPS).
chinese: 譯碼遠落在時隙邊界之外，且尚無 NTP 測量返回，因此未做任何糾正。請檢查網路，或設定 PC 時鐘（離網：GPS）。

english: Decode time offset (how far heard signals land from the slot boundary)
chinese: 譯碼時間偏移（聽到的訊號偏離時隙邊界的程度）

english: Auto-cycle (FT8-style): when you answer a station, transmit on the opposite T/R cycle to theirs
chinese: 自動迴圈（FT8 風格）：當你應答某電台時，在其相反的 T/R 迴圈上發射

english: Lock transmit to the even (1st) T/R slots — the station you work must be Tx 2nd
chinese: 鎖定發射到偶數（首）T/R 時隙——你要通聯的電台必須發射次

english: Lock transmit to the odd (2nd) T/R slots — the station you work must be Tx 1st
chinese: 鎖定發射到奇數（次）T/R 時隙——你要通聯的電台必須發射首

english: Opened from the Help menu · also offered at the end of the setup wizard
chinese: 從幫助選單開啟 · 設定嚮導結束時也會提供
檢測、配對音訊、測試 CAT
下一步——日誌（重要的一項）→
第 1 / 4 步 · 你的電台

english: Your callsign and your grid square. Everything location-shaped in Nexus — the propagation map, satellite passes, distances, bearings, DXpedition windows, VHF opening locality — is computed from these two fields.
chinese: 你的呼號與網格。Nexus 中一切與位置相關的東西——傳播地圖、衛星過境、距離、方位、DX 遠征視窗、VHF 開通的本地性——都由這兩個欄位算出。

english: Open the first-run wizard (it appears on first launch) or Settings ▸ Station at any time.
chinese: 開啟首次執行嚮導（首次啟動時出現），或隨時開啟設定 ▸ 本台。

english: Callsign — stored uppercase. Nexus will not start PSK Reporter or the RBN/cluster feed until a valid one is set: 3–10 characters, at least one letter and one digit.
chinese: 呼號——以大寫儲存。在設定有效的呼號之前，Nexus 不會啟動 PSK Reporter 或 RBN/cluster 饋送：3–10 個字元，至少包含一個字母和一個數字。

english: Grid square — your Maidenhead locator. QRZ shows yours.
chinese: 網格——你的梅登海德定位格。QRZ 可顯示你的。

english: Name — optional, in Settings ▸ Station. Feeds the CW {NAME} macro and logbook autofill.
chinese: 姓名——可選，在設定 ▸ 本台中。供 CW 宏 {NAME} 與日誌簿自動填充使用。

english: Four characters pins you to the middle of a ~100-mile square, and every distance and bearing you will ever read is measured from that point. {{full}} beats {{short}}. A malformed locator is refused outright — the wizard will not let you past it.
chinese: 四位字元會把你釘在約 100 英里方格的中心，而你將來讀到的每個距離與方位都從這一點起算。{{full}} 優於 {{short}}。格式錯誤的定位格會被直接拒絕——嚮導不會讓你越過它。

english: Setup wizard ▸ step 1 · re-run any time from Settings ▸ Appearance ▸ Features
chinese: 設定嚮導 ▸ 第 1 步 · 可隨時從設定 ▸ 外觀 ▸ 功能重新執行

english: Your grid square is the anchor for everything location-based — satellite passes, propagation, the map, and DXpedition windows are all computed from it.
chinese: 你的網格是任何基於位置的錨點——衛星過境、傳播、地圖與 DX 遠征視窗都由它算出。

english: Maidenhead locator (qrz.com shows yours). Give all 6 — 4 characters pins you to the middle of a ~100-mile square.
chinese: 梅登海德定位格（qrz.com 可顯示你的）。請填寫全部 6 位——4 位字元會把你釘在約 100 英里方格的中心。
第 2 / 4 步 · 你的裝置

english: One button does the archaeology. Nexus reads the USB descriptors, matches the rig model, pairs the audio CODEC, and looks for FlexRadios on your network — in a single scan.
chinese: 一個按鈕完成排查。Nexus 讀取 USB 描述符、匹配電台型號、配對音訊編解碼器，並在一次掃描中查詢你網路上的 FlexRadio。

english: In the wizard, or in Settings ▸ Radio ▸ Rig & CAT, click Detect my radio.
chinese: 在嚮導中，或在設定 ▸ 電台 ▸ 裝置與 CAT，點選檢測我的電台。

english: Pick the row that is your radio. It fills the port, the Hamlib model and both audio devices at once. On a dual-UART Icom two rows describe the same rig — take the one tagged CI-V port — use this one.
chinese: 選擇屬於你的電台那一行。它會一次性填好連線埠、Hamlib 型號與兩個音訊裝置。在雙 UART 的 Icom 上，兩行描述同一台裝置——請選標註為CI-V 連線埠——用這個的那行。

english: Generic cable? A CH340 reporting only “USB Serial” fills the port and audio but leaves the model blank — choose it from the dropdown.
chinese: 通用線纜？一個只報告「USB Serial」的 CH340 會填好連線埠與音訊，但型號留空——請從下拉選單中選擇。

english: FlexRadio is found on the network and configured the WSJT-X-proven way: CAT through the SmartSDR CAT app at 127.0.0.1:5002, audio through DAX.
chinese: FlexRadio 在網路上被發現，並以經 WSJT-X 驗證的方式配置：透過 SmartSDR CAT 應用在 127.0.0.1:5002 進行 CAT，音訊經由 DAX。

english: Then press Test CAT. Nexus saves what you entered, starts rigctld for the radio, and reports the dial frequency it read back — or the specific error. Other programs share the radio through the address in Settings ▸ Radio ▸ Transmit limits & sharing.
chinese: 然後按下 Test CAT。Nexus 儲存你的輸入，為該電台啟動 rigctld，並報告它讀回的本振頻率——或具體的錯誤。其他程式透過「設定 ▸ 電台 ▸ 發射限制與共享」中的地址共享該電台。

english: USB: plug it in and power it on. Flex: it has to be on this network. Either way you can skip and set it up later — the wizard never blocks on hardware. Set Tx Level (default 0.9) down until your rig’s ALC reads zero before you transmit.
chinese: USB：插上並開機。Flex：必須在同一網路上。無論哪種你都可以跳過，稍後設定——嚮導從不在硬體上阻塞。在發射前，將發射電平（預設 0.9）調低，直到你的電台 ALC 讀數為零。

english: Setup wizard ▸ step 2 · Hamlib ships inside the installer
chinese: 設定嚮導 ▸ 第 2 步 · Hamlib 隨安裝包內建

english: Setup wizard ▸ step 2 · CAT needs Homebrew Hamlib — in Terminal: brew install hamlib
chinese: 設定嚮導 ▸ 第 2 步 · CAT 需要 Homebrew Hamlib——在終端中：brew install hamlib

english: One detect finds everything — USB rigs and FlexRadios on the network. Skippable; Settings ▸ Radio ▸ Rig & CAT has all of this later.
chinese: 一次檢測找到一切——USB 電台與網路上的 FlexRadio。可跳過；稍後「設定 ▸ 電台 ▸ 裝置與 CAT」中都有。

english: SDR software, or a remote rig

chinese: ✓ 電台在 {{port}} 應答——本振讀數為 {{dial}}
第 3 / 4 步 · 你的執照

english: Declare your class, get a real lockout
chinese: 申報你的等級，獲得真正的鎖定

english: This one field becomes a software guard in every transmit path in the app. Nexus parks the dial in your licensed segments and refuses to key up outside them, with a toast that says why.
chinese: 這一個欄位會成為應用中每一條發射路徑的軟體守衛。Nexus 把本振停在你的授權頻段內，並拒絕在其外來鍵控，同時彈出說明原因的提示。

english: On the wizard’s last step, under What’s your license?. It is persisted the moment you click it.
chinese: 在嚮導的最後一步，位於你的執照是什麼？下。點選的瞬間即被儲存。

english: A Technician on 40 m is held to the CW segment — phone and FT8 TX outside it are blocked.
chinese: 40 米上的技術員級被限定在 CW 段——其外的話音與 FT8 發射被阻止。

english: A General on 20 m cannot transmit in the Extra-only portion at the low end.
chinese: 普通級在 20 米低端 Extra 專屬部分不能發射。

english: The channelized 60 m segments are included.
Outside the US? Pick Outside the US. The lockout models US FCC Part 97 / ITU Region 2 only, so it is off rather than wrong.
chinese: 美國境外？選美國境外。鎖定僅建模美國 FCC Part 97 / ITU 第 2 區，因此是關閉而非錯誤。

english: You are responsible for knowing your privileges. The lockout catches the slip; it does not replace the knowledge. A fresh install defaults to Open, so nothing is silently restricted before you say so.
chinese: 你有責任瞭解自己的權限。鎖定攔下的是疏忽，而非替代知識。全新安裝預設為開放，因此在你明確之前不會悄悄限制任何東西。

english: Setup wizard ▸ step 4 · everything starts on — this is the one question
chinese: 設定嚮導 ▸ 第 4 步 · 一切從開啟狀態開始——這是唯一的問題

english: Sets your transmit privileges — the app parks the dial in your licensed band segments and won’t let you transmit outside them. Pick “Outside the US” for no limits.
chinese: 設定你的發射權限——應用把本振停在授權頻段內，不會讓你在其外發射。選「美國境外」則無限制。
美國——有限的 HF + 完整 VHF/UHF
美國——大部分 HF 權限

english: TX blocked — {{freq}} is outside your General phone privileges on 40 m.
chinese: 發射被阻止——{{freq}} 超出你在 40 米上的普通級話音權限。
第 4 / 4 步：你的 ADIF 日誌

english: Step 4 of 4 · The one that matters
chinese: 第 4 / 4 步 · 重要的一項

english: One log, every mode. Import one ADIF file and the app knows every station you have already worked, every entity you still need, and exactly how far you are from your next award — on digital, phone and CW alike, computed offline from your own history.
chinese: 一個日誌，所有模式。匯入一個 ADIF 檔案，應用便知道你已通聯過的每個電台、仍需的每個實體，以及距下一個獎項究竟多遠——數字、話音與 CW 皆然，由你自己的歷史離線算出。

english: Every callsign looks the same, whether it arrives as a decode, a cluster spot or a voice on the band. Every station is new. The Needed board has nothing to say.
chinese: 每個呼號看起來都一樣，無論它來自譯碼、cluster 頻點還是波段上的語音。每個電台都是新的。缺項面板無話可說。

english: B4 chips wherever a callsign appears — digital decodes, the Call Roster, spots, and the recall card in the Phone and CW cockpits.
chinese: 只要呼號出現就有 B4 標記——數字譯碼、呼號名單、頻點，以及話音與 CW 操作台中的呼叫卡片。

english: New DXCC, new state, new grid, new band slot — ranked across every band and mode at once, with the evidence that says it is workable now.
chinese: 新的 DXCC、新的州、新的網格、新的波段槽位——跨所有波段與模式一次排好序，並附上說明其目前可通聯的證據。

english: DXCC, Challenge, Honor Roll, WAS, WAZ, VUCC and IOTA — mode-agnostic and per-mode alike — the moment the import finishes.
chinese: DXCC、Challenge、Honor Roll、WAS、WAZ、VUCC 與 IOTA——與模式無關及分模式皆然——匯入完成的瞬間即顯現。
你的 ADIF 從何而來

english: Any standard ADIF export — .adi or .adif. If you have been operating, you already have one.
chinese: 任何標準 ADIF 匯出——.adi 或 .adif。如果你一直在操作，你已有一個。

english: QRZ Logbook or LoTW — download your full ADIF export.
chinese: QRZ Logbook 或 LoTW——下載你完整的 ADIF 匯出。

english: N1MM+, Log4OM, HRD, ClubLog — export ADIF from the logbook.
Wizard step 3, or Logbook ▸ Import ADIF at any time. Import as many files as you like — duplicates are detected and skipped, so a second pass costs you nothing.
chinese: 嚮導第 3 步，或隨時在日誌簿 ▸ 匯入 ADIF。想匯入多少檔案都行——重複項會被檢測並跳過，因此第二次匯入毫無損失。
沒有任何資料離開你的電腦

english: The import is local. Your log lives in log.adi on your own machine, and the awards engine computes against it offline. Uploading to LoTW, QRZ, ClubLog or eQSL is a separate, opt-in connector.
chinese: 匯入在本地進行。你的日誌儲存在你本機的 log.adi 中，獎項引擎離線針對它計算。上傳到 LoTW、QRZ、ClubLog 或 eQSL 是獨立的、需主動開啟的聯結器。

english: Setup wizard ▸ step 3 · or Logbook ▸ Import ADIF, any time
chinese: 設定嚮導 ▸ 第 3 步 · 或日誌簿 ▸ 匯入 ADIF，隨時

english: Nexus works best when it knows your history. Importing your ADIF log is what powers worked-before flags, the Needed board, and your awards progress — without it, the app starts blind and treats every station as new.
chinese: Nexus 在瞭解你的歷史時表現最佳。匯入 ADIF 日誌正是曾通聯標記、缺項面板與你獎項進度的來源——沒有它，應用盲目啟動，把每個電台當新的對待。
匯入我的 ADIF 日誌…

english: ✓ Imported {{count}} QSOs · {{present}} already present. Your worked-before and Needed board are now seeded.
chinese: ✓ 已匯入 {{count}} 筆 QSO · {{present}} 個已存在。你的曾通聯與缺項面板現已播種。

english: From WSJT-X, N1MM, Log4OM, HRD, QRZ, LoTW, ClubLog — any standard ADIF (.adi/.adif) export. Nothing leaves your computer; duplicates are detected and skipped.

english: Coming from WSJT-X? The short path

Your muscle memory transfers — double-click semantics, Esc / F4 / F6 / Alt+1–6, Band Activity bottom-pinned, early decodes at 11.8 s, Fake-It split, Hound auto-move. So do your settings: point step 2 at the same rig and audio devices WSJT-X uses, and hand step 4 your wsjtx_log.adi. JTAlert and GridTracker keep working once you turn on WSJT-X UDP API (off by default) in Settings ▸ Logging & Connectors ▸ Integrations & Feeds. Its address already matches WSJT-X’s default, so nothing else needs setting, and they see Nexus as a WSJT-X.
chinese: 你的肌肉記憶能遷移——按兩下語義、Esc / F4 / F6 / Alt+1–6、波段活動底部固定、11.8 秒的早期譯碼、Fake-It 分頻、Hound 自動移動。你的設定也能：把第 2 步指向 WSJT-X 所用的同一台裝置與音訊裝置，並把第 4 步交給你的 wsjtx_log.adi。一旦在「設定 ▸ 日誌與連線 ▸ 整合與訂閱」中開啟WSJT-X UDP API（預設關閉），JTAlert 與 GridTracker 會繼續工作。其地址已與 WSJT-X 預設一致，因此無需設定其他，它們把 Nexus 當作 WSJT-X 看待。

english: CQ WW rule VIII.2 counts “a CW decoder, DX cluster, DX spotting Web sites … local or remote call sign and frequency decoding technology (e.g., CW Skimmer or Reverse Beacon Network)” as QSO-finding assistance. Using any of them places the entry in Single Operator Assisted (V.A.2) instead of Single Operator (V.A.1).
chinese: CQ WW 規則 VIII.2 將「CW 譯碼器、DX cluster、DX spotting 網站……本地或遠端的呼號與頻率譯碼技術（如 CW Skimmer 或 Reverse Beacon Network）」計為 QSO 尋找輔助。使用其中任何一項都會將參賽歸入單人輔助（Single Operator Assisted，V.A.2）而非單人（V.A.1）。

english: ARRL contests call it spotting assistance and name “PSKReporter, Telnet, DX spotting websites or bulletin board systems, automated multi-channel decoders”. Single Operator may not use it (HCAT.1.1: “Use of spotting assistance is not permitted.”). Single Operator Unlimited may (HCAT.2.1). ARRL’s glossary defines a multi-channel decoder as software that “displays multiple decoded signals at the same time”. Nexus decodes one signal at a time, so that definition does not describe its CW decoder. It does describe the cluster, RBN and PSK Reporter feeds.
chinese: ARRL 比賽稱之為 spotting 輔助，並點名「PSKReporter、Telnet、DX spotting 網站或公告板系統、自動化多通道譯碼器」。單人不可使用它（HCAT.1.1：「不允許使用 spotting 輔助。」）。單人無限（Single Operator Unlimited）可以使用（HCAT.2.1）。ARRL 術語表將多通道譯碼器定義為「同時顯示多個已譯碼訊號」的軟體。Nexus 一次只譯碼一個訊號，因此該定義並不描述其 CW 譯碼器。但它確實描述了 cluster、RBN 與 PSK Reporter 饋送。

english: Your radio’s own digital decodes, FT8 and FT4 among them, keep feeding the Needed board in unassisted mode. Neither ruleset sets them apart: both count any technology that identifies a callsign or multiplier as assistance, so do not use the Needed board to find stations if your contest counts them. Your outbound PSK Reporter uploads also keep running, because ARRL says “Generating spotting information for use by other stations is not considered to be spotting assistance.”

english: Earlier versions of Nexus could put the confirmation of one contact, from LoTW, eQSL or QRZ, or the mark that LoTW holds its upload, on another contact with the same station, band and mode on the same UTC day. Check downloads your whole history once from each of these services you have set up, which can take several minutes for LoTW, and lists each contact holding a confirmation or upload mark that the service’s own records give another contact, or none. A line starts ticked only when those records decide it. Nothing changes until you press the button, nothing is uploaded, and no paper card is touched.

A bulk edit never changes the worked call. Nothing is sent from here. A STATION_CALLSIGN replaced with another call is the call a contact is uploaded under, so its upload marks are cleared and the next upload sends it again under the new call, and its LoTW, eQSL and QRZ confirmations, matched under the old call, are cleared; paper QSL cards stay. Filling in a blank STATION_CALLSIGN, clearing one, or adding or removing /P clears no upload mark or confirmation. But a contact with no STATION_CALLSIGN is uploaded under the call in Settings, so a fill or a clear can change the call a contact is sent under to a service it has not been sent to yet: the confirm names those. Every other field keeps its upload marks and confirmations.
chinese: 批次編輯絕不會修改已通聯的呼號。從此處不會傳送任何內容。若 STATION_CALLSIGN 被替換為另一個呼號，則該呼號是通聯上傳所用的呼號，因此其上傳標記會被清除，下次上傳會以新呼號重新傳送，並且其 LoTW、eQSL 和 QRZ 確認（在舊呼號下匹配）也會被清除；紙質 QSL 卡片保留。填寫空白的 STATION_CALLSIGN、清除它，或新增/移除 /P，都不會清除任何上傳標記或確認。但若某通聯沒有 STATION_CALLSIGN，則會以「設定」中的呼號上傳，因此填寫或清除可能將通聯傳送到的呼號變更為某個尚未傳送過的服務：確認資訊會列出這些。所有其他欄位均保留其上傳標記與確認。

english: Already in the contest log — this contest counts a station once regardless of band, so logging this again will be refused as a dupe.
chinese: 已在競賽日誌中——本競賽無論波段只計電台一次，因此再次記錄將被作為重複拒絕。

english: Already in the contest log — this contest counts a station once regardless of band. Work and log it anyway: it keeps duplicates and scores them zero. Leaving it out costs the other station its credit.
chinese: 已在競賽日誌中——本競賽無論波段只計電台一次。仍可通聯並記錄：其保留重複並計零分。遺漏會導致對方損失其積分。

chinese: 另一台位已在 {{band}} 上通聯過他們——允許記錄但不加分。

chinese: 已在 {{band}} 上通聯過——現在記錄將是重複。計該波段上任意模式，除非設定了「同時匹配模式」。

chinese: FT2（Decodium）—— 3.75 秒 T/R，FT4 符號時間減半

chinese: T/R 週期 —— 15 秒是 6 米主力；30 秒便於在 2 米深搜

english: FT8/FT4 decode depth — Deep catches weaker signals but uses more CPU/battery (a field/POTA lever)
chinese: FT8/FT4 解碼深度——深度可捕獲更弱訊號但更耗 CPU/電量（外場/POTA 調節項）

english: TX drive (Pwr) — trim down until your rig's ALC is just zero
chinese: 發射驅動（功率）——調低直至電台 ALC 恰好為零

english: DXpedition hound: calls go out above 1000 Hz, your R+report auto-moves to the Fox's frequency, and the QSO ends on the Fox's RR73 with NO parting 73 — a 73 there is QRM in the Fox's own segment. Click to turn it on and off; a QSO already running keeps the rules it started under. Off again at every launch: turn it on for the DXpedition, not for the day.
chinese: DX 遠征獵手（hound）：呼叫發在 1000 Hz 以上，你的 R+ 報告自動移到 Fox 的頻率，QSO 在 Fox 的 RR73 處結束，不道別 73——此處的 73 是 Fox 自身頻段內的 QRM。點選開關；已進行的 QSO 沿用起始時的規則。每次啟動後預設關閉：為 DX 遠征開啟，而非整天開啟。
do_not_translate: DXpedition | RR73 | Fox | QRM | QSO | 73 | Hz

english: SuperFox on the air: {{calls}} — Nexus does not decode SuperFox in this version. Work that one in WSJT-X.
chinese: SuperFox 正在空中：{{calls}} —— 本版本 Nexus 不解碼 SuperFox。請在 WSJT-X 中通聯它。

english: A SuperFox DXpedition transmits in a format this version of Nexus has no decoder for, so its transmissions do not reach the decode list here and Hound cannot help. Work it in WSJT-X and log it back in Nexus.
chinese: SuperFox DX 遠征以本版本 Nexus 無解碼器的格式發射，因此其發射不會進入此處的解碼清單，獵手也無法協助。請在 WSJT-X 中通聯，並在 Nexus 中記錄回來。

chinese: 解碼來源 —— 目前：{{active}}。原生（Native）= Nexus 解碼本地音訊；伴侶（Companion）= 透過 UDP {{addr}} 搭載上游 WSJT-X/JTDX/MSHV 的解碼流。
do_not_translate: {{active}} | {{addr}} | WSJT-X | Nexus | JTDX | MSHV | UDP | JTDX/MSHV

english: Where decodes come from — active: {{active}} · listening {{addr}}. Native = Nexus decodes local audio; Companion = ride an upstream WSJT-X/JTDX/MSHV decode stream over UDP {{addr}}.
chinese: 解碼來源 —— 目前：{{active}} · 監聽中 {{addr}}。原生 = Nexus 解碼本地音訊；伴侶 = 透過 UDP {{addr}} 搭載上游 WSJT-X/JTDX/MSHV 的解碼流。
do_not_translate: {{active}} | {{addr}} | WSJT-X | Nexus | JTDX | MSHV | UDP | JTDX/MSHV

chinese: 原生引擎 —— Nexus 解碼本地音訊

chinese: 伴侶 —— 透過 UDP {{addr}} 搭載現有 WSJT-X / JTDX / MSHV 解碼流

chinese: 將接收到的音訊錄製為 recordings 資料夾中的 WAV

chinese: 錄製中 —— 點選停止錄製此 QSO

chinese: 經典 —— WSJT-X 佈局（波段活動 + 接收頻率成對，名冊在側）

english: Roster — Call Roster layout (roster dominant, Band Activity + Rx Frequency aside)
chinese: 名冊 —— 呼號名冊佈局（名冊為主，波段活動 + 接收頻率在側）

chinese: 在獨立視窗中開啟 POTA 活動地圖

chinese: 向 DX 叢集通報呼號（開啟彈窗 —— 呼號、頻率、備註）

chinese: 在獨立視窗中開啟操作面板

chinese: 在獨立視窗中開啟操作面板（用於第二顯示器）

chinese: ⧉ 瀑布圖已彈出 —— 點選重新停靠

chinese: 瀑布圖已獨立成窗 — 點選將其收回此處

english: Add a box to the main column
Add a box to the side rail
On a narrower window, the columns stand one above the other.
chinese: 視窗變窄時，各列將上下排列。

english: This mode is receive-only in Nexus — it decodes but does not transmit
chinese: 該模式在 Nexus 中為純接收 — 可解碼但不發射

english: This is a beacon mode — it transmits your callsign, grid and power on a schedule. There is no QSO sequence. Set the transmit % and power in Settings ▸ Beacons (WSPR & FST4W).
chinese: 這是信標模式 — 它按預定計劃發射你的呼號、網格和功率。沒有 QSO 流程。在設定 ▸ 信標（WSPR 與 FST4W）中設定發射百分比和功率。

english: Auto CQ — call CQ continuously, work each station that answers with the normal FT8/FT4 sequence, then return to CQ automatically. In an FT8 or FT4 contest it stops after each contact: press it again to call CQ
chinese: 自動 CQ — 持續呼叫 CQ，用標準 FT8/FT4 流程通聯每個應答的電台，然後自動回到 CQ。在 FT8 或 FT4 競賽中，每次通聯後停止：再次點選以呼叫 CQ

english: Search & pounce — listens; double-click a CQ to call that station
chinese: 搜尋與撲擊 — 監聽；按兩下某個 CQ 以呼叫該電台

english: Hold Tx Freq: keep your TX offset where you put it when you double-click a station to work them. Off, your TX moves onto theirs (WSJT-X's behaviour). A plain waterfall click never moves TX either way.
chinese: 鎖定發射頻率：在你按兩下電台進行通聯時，讓你的發射偏移保持在原位置。關閉時，你的發射會移動到對方頻率（WSJT-X 的行為）。單純的瀑布圖點選無論如何都不會移動發射頻率。
電台 TX 超時 {{sec}} 秒
電台 TX 超時 {{min}} 分鐘

english: The radio's transmit timeout is off. If Nexus or the network fails during a tune, nothing will end the carrier. Set a transmit timeout in SmartSDR.
chinese: 電台的發射超時已關閉。若在調諧過程中 Nexus 或網路發生故障，載波將無人終止。請在 SmartSDR 中設定發射超時。

english: Tune keys nothing here: the radio's own carrier would be outside your CW privileges on this frequency.
chinese: 調諧按鍵在此無效：電台自身載波將超出你在本頻率的 CW 操作權限。

english: ATU keys nothing here: the radio's own carrier would be outside your CW privileges on this frequency.
chinese: ATU 按鍵在此無效：電台自身載波將超出你在本頻率的 CW 操作權限。

english: Your rig is on {{rigMode}}, but Nexus has {{mode}}. Something moved it at the radio (SmartSDR, another program, or the mode knob). Transmit and logging use {{mode}} — set the radio to match, or re-pick the band here.
chinese: 你的電台處於 {{rigMode}}，但 Nexus 為 {{mode}}。電台端有東西改變了它（SmartSDR、其他程式或模式旋鈕）。發射與記錄使用 {{mode}} — 請將電台設為匹配，或在此重新選擇頻段。

english: The radio's receive filter is {{hz}} Hz — far narrower than an FT8/FT4 window. Signals outside it are not reaching the decoder at all. Widen the filter at the radio (2.4-3 kHz is normal).
chinese: 電台的接收濾波器為 {{hz}} Hz — 遠窄於 FT8/FT4 視窗。其外的訊號根本無法抵達解碼器。請在電台端加寬濾波器（2.4–3 kHz 為正常）。

english: Auto CQ is running — calling CQ continuously, working each station that answers, then returning to CQ for the next one. Click S&P to stop.
chinese: 自動 CQ 執行中 — 持續呼叫 CQ，通聯每個應答的電台，然後回到 CQ 呼叫下一個。點選 S&P 停止。

english: The contest's Running is calling CQ — it works the station that answers, then stops after the contact: TX goes off until you call CQ again (TX On, Running, or Call CQ on FT8 and FT4). Click S&P to stop.
chinese: 競賽中的定點呼叫正在呼叫 CQ — 它通聯應答的電台，然後在通聯後停止：在再次呼叫 CQ 之前 TX 保持關閉（TX 開啟、定點呼叫或呼叫 CQ，FT8 與 FT4）。點選 S&P 停止。
do_not_translate: CQ | TX | TX On | FT8 | FT4

chinese: 收到關於你訊號的報告
TX 看門狗已停止呼叫

english: The TX watchdog turned transmit off before this call was answered. Turn TX On to call again.
chinese: TX 看門狗在本次呼叫被應答前關閉了發射。開啟 TX 以再次呼叫。
已傳送 {{count}} 次 — 正在重複呼叫
重新裝定並再次傳送此訊息

english: Log this QSO now. Waiting for Log: {{count}}
chinese: 立即記錄此次 QSO。等待記錄：{{count}}

english: Transmit cycle — click to cycle Auto → Tx 1st → Tx 2nd. Auto picks the opposite cycle of the station you answer; the station you work must be on the OPPOSITE period.
chinese: 發射週期 — 點選在 自動 → 先發 → 後發 之間迴圈。自動選擇你所應答電台的相反週期；你所通聯的電台必須處於相反週期。

english: Skip Tx1 — when you answer a CQ, open with your signal report (Tx2) instead of your grid (Tx1), saving a cycle. Standard callsigns only (a compound call still sends its grid). Resets each launch, like WSJT-X.
chinese: 跳過 Tx1 — 當你應答 CQ 時，先用訊號報告（Tx2）而不是網格（Tx1）開頭，從而節省一個週期。僅限標準呼號（複合呼號仍傳送其網格）。每次啟動重設，與 WSJT-X 相同。

english: Show or hide this pane's filter and sort controls. They fold away when the pane is short, so the list keeps its rows. Lit while a filter is on.
chinese: 顯示或隱藏此面板的篩選與排序控制元件。面板較矮時它們會摺疊起來，讓清單保留自己的行。開啟篩選時高亮。

english: 73 and RR73 signoffs included — a free frequency is about to appear
chinese: 包含 73 與 RR73 結束用語 — 一個空閒頻率即將出現

english: On my RX frequency (±50 Hz), plus anything addressed to me — follow a QSO without clutter
chinese: 在我的 RX 頻率上（±50 Hz），以及任何指向我的內容 — 無雜亂地跟蹤一次 QSO

english: New DXCC / new grid — the "new one" chase
chinese: 新 DXCC / 新網格 — 「新目標」追逐

english: Hide blocked callsigns from this pane (they render dimmed when off). The auto-responder never answers blocked calls regardless — Alt-double-click a row to block or unblock.
chinese: 從此面板隱藏被遮蔽的呼號（關閉時它們顯示為暗淡）。無論如何，自動應答器都不會應答被遮蔽的呼號 — 按住 Alt 按兩下某行可遮蔽或解除遮蔽。

english: Hide stations whose ENTITY is already confirmed (LoTW/card) on this band — chase what you still need. It is the country that is confirmed, not necessarily this callsign. A station that's new on the band always shows.
chinese: 隱藏在本頻段實體已確認（LoTW/卡片）的電台 — 去追逐你仍需要的。被確認的是國家，未必是這個呼號。本頻段上的新電台始終顯示。

english: Hide stations you have already worked (B4) from whichever filter is active — CQ-only minus B4, and friends
chinese: 從目前生效的篩選器中隱藏你已通聯的電台（B4）— 僅 CQ 減去 B4，以及好友

english: The B4 chip shows worked stations — the hide switch is idle there
chinese: B4 晶片顯示已通聯的電台 — 此處的隱藏開關處於空閒狀態

english: Hide stations you have already worked on this band (B4) from whichever filter is active. A station worked only on another band stays. The menu beside −B4 in Band Activity sets this.
chinese: 從目前生效的篩選器中隱藏你已在本頻段通聯的電台（B4）。僅在另一頻段通聯過的電台仍保留。頻段活動中 −B4 旁的選單可設定此項。
−B4 隱藏哪些已通聯的電台

english: Any band: −B4 hides every station you have worked before. This band: it hides only those worked on this band, so a station worked on another band stays for a new band slot.
chinese: 任意頻段：−B4 隱藏你此前通聯過的每個電台。本頻段：僅隱藏在本頻段通聯過的，因此另一頻段通聯過的電台會保留以用作新的頻段槽位。

english: Draw the newest decodes at the top and follow them there. Off is the WSJT-X order, with the newest at the bottom.
chinese: 將最新的解碼繪製在頂部並跟隨它們。關閉時為 WSJT-X 順序，最新在底部。

english: Newest on top works in Time order
chinese: 最新在上按時間順序排列

english: ▲ reviewing — scroll to bottom to follow
chinese: ▲ 審查中 — 捲動到底部以跟隨
IR-HARQ 本次工作階段恢復了 {{count}} 條解碼

english: Decoded stations — arrow to move, Enter to select, Shift+Enter to work
chinese: 已解碼電台 — 方向鍵移動，Enter選擇，Shift+Enter通聯

english: Waiting for the next slot — decoded signals will appear here as they arrive.
chinese: 等待下一時隙 — 解碼到的訊號將在到達時顯示於此。

english: {{count}} decodes in history are hidden by the current filter — pick another chip to see them.
chinese: 歷史中有 {{count}} 條解碼被目前篩選器隱藏 — 選擇其他標籤以檢視它們。

chinese: 週期 {{time}} UTC，在變更前於 {{band}} {{mode}} 上聽到

chinese: 在頻段或模式變更前於 {{band}} {{mode}} 上聽到。僅顯示：無法從此處通聯。

english: Click to select {{call}} · double-click to work{{highlight}}
chinese: 點選選擇 {{call}} · 按兩下通聯{{highlight}}

english: Start of the period it was heard in (UTC). Arrived at {{time}}.
chinese: 其被聽到所屬週期的開始（UTC）。到達於 {{time}}。

english: DT — time offset (s); large = clock/sync skew
chinese: DT — 時間偏移（秒）；值大表示時鐘/同步偏差

english: Uploads to LoTW — a QSO with {{call}} should confirm (ARRL activity list)
chinese: 上傳至 LoTW — 與 {{call}} 的 QSO 應當能確認（ARRL 活動清單）

english: Hide stations you have already worked — EXCEPT the ones that still fill a need, which stay on the list. That is why a B4 chip can survive this filter: you worked that call on another band or mode and this is still a new slot, or that call is on a park or summit you have not worked in the activation running right now. Turn on Needed only to see just those.
chinese: 隱藏你已通聯的電台 — 但仍在填補需求的那些例外，會保留在清單中。這就是 B4 標籤能在此篩選下倖存的原因：你在另一頻段或模式通聯過該呼號，而此處仍是新槽位；或者該呼號位於你目前正在進行的啟用中尚未通聯的公園或山峰。

english: Drop blocked callsigns from the roster entirely (unchecked: they render dimmed). Alt-double-click a row to block or unblock; the auto-responder never answers blocked calls either way.
chinese: 從名冊中完全移除被遮蔽的呼號（未勾選：它們顯示為暗淡）。按住 Alt 按兩下某行可遮蔽或解除遮蔽；無論如何，自動應答器都不會應答被遮蔽的呼號。

english: Show only the stations within this distance of your grid square. A station you have not heard send a grid yet has no known distance, so it always stays on the list, and so does the station you are working.
chinese: 僅顯示距你網格方格此距離內的電台。尚未聽到其傳送網格的電台沒有已知距離，因此始終保留在清單中；你正在通聯的電台同樣如此。

chinese: 選擇一個電台以將其點報至 DX 叢集

chinese: 呼號名冊 — 方向鍵移動，Enter選擇，Shift+Enter通聯

chinese: 正在呼叫 CQ {{dir}} — 定向呼叫。他只求 {{dir}}，因此從其他任何地方應答通常會被忽略。

chinese: Tx6 呼叫 CQ（可編輯為定向 CQ）

chinese: 競賽的 CQ — Tx 6 像呼叫 CQ 那樣呼叫它

chinese: 將此作為下一次發射傳送（Alt+{{n}}）

chinese: 未傳送 — 這不是 Nexus 能呼叫的 CQ。試試：{{fix}}

chinese: 未傳送 — 這不是 Nexus 能呼叫的 CQ。格式為 CQ，可選的方向詞，然後是 {{mycall}} 和你的網格。

english: Waterfall color palette (Phone, CW, RTTY and SSTV — FT has its own)
chinese: 瀑布圖調色盤（語音、CW、RTTY 與 SSTV — FT 單獨）

english: Waterfall color palette — applies to this mode
chinese: 瀑布圖調色盤 — 應用於本模式

english: Waterfall color palette — shared by Phone, CW, RTTY and SSTV. The FT waterfall keeps its own.
chinese: 瀑布圖調色盤 — 由語音、CW、RTTY 與 SSTV 共享。FT 瀑布圖保持獨立。

english: left = RX · right / Shift = TX · {{mod}} = both
chinese: 左 = RX · 右 / Shift = TX · {{mod}} = 兩者

english: Waterfall view — Std (0–3 kHz, WSJT-X-like), Full (0–4 kHz), or zoom in around the RX marker
chinese: 瀑布圖檢視 — 標準（0–3 kHz，類似 WSJT-X）、完整（0–4 kHz），或圍繞 RX 標記放大

english: Gain — contrast (how punchy strong signals look). Center = auto.
chinese: 增益 — 對比度（強訊號顯示的醒目程度）。居中 = 自動。

english: Zero — where the black point sits relative to the noise floor. Center = the default (background black); left shows more of the noise, right buries it deeper.
chinese: 零點 — 黑點相對於噪底的位置。居中 = 預設（背景為黑）；向左顯示更多雜訊，向右將其更深埋沒。

english: Scrolls down — the newest row appears at the TOP and history travels downward. Click for the other way: newest at the bottom, history travelling up (the default).
chinese: 向下捲動 — 最新行出現在頂部，歷史向下移動。點選切換：最新在底部，歷史向上移動（預設）。

english: Scrolls down — the newest row appears at the TOP and history travels downward. Click for the other way: newest at the bottom, history travelling up (the default). The 3D view keeps its own front-to-back perspective either way.
chinese: 向下捲動 — 最新行出現在頂部，歷史向下移動。點選切換：最新在底部，歷史向上移動（預設）。3D 檢視無論如何都保持自身的縱深視角。

english: Scrolls up — the newest row appears at the BOTTOM and history travels upward (the default). Click for the other way: newest at the top, history travelling down.
chinese: 向上捲動 — 最新行出現在底部，歷史向上移動（預設）。點選切換：最新在頂部，歷史向下移動。

english: Scrolls up — the newest row appears at the BOTTOM and history travels upward (the default). Click for the other way: newest at the top, history travelling down. The 3D view keeps its own front-to-back perspective either way.
chinese: 向上捲動 — 最新行出現在底部，歷史向上移動（預設）。點選切換：最新在頂部，歷史向下移動。3D 檢視無論如何都保持自身的縱深視角。

chinese: 暫停瀑布圖 — 然後用滑鼠滾輪迴滾瀏覽歷史

english: Resume the live waterfall (history kept accumulating while paused)
chinese: 恢復即時瀑布圖（暫停期間歷史持續累積）

english: Pop the waterfall out into its own window (frees this space; drag to another monitor)
chinese: 將瀑布圖彈出到獨立視窗（釋放此處空間；可拖到另一顯示器）

english: Click sets RX (WSJT-X) · Shift+click sets TX · {{mod}}+click sets both
chinese: 點選設定 RX（WSJT-X）· Shift+點選設定 TX · {{mod}}+點選設定兩者

english: Color = signal strength (dB relative to the current strongest signal)
chinese: 顏色 = 訊號強度（相對於目前最強訊號的 dB）
正在發射 — 顯示保持

chinese: 還有 {{count}} 條解碼在此無處顯示其呼號

chinese: 還有 {{count}} 條解碼在此無處顯示其呼號

english: {{call}} · {{snr}} dB · {{hz}} Hz — click to listen here
chinese: {{call}} · {{snr}} dB · {{hz}} Hz — 點選在此收聽

english: Show the callsigns decoded in the last period above their signals
chinese: 在上次週期解碼出的呼號上方顯示其訊號

english: S-meter {{reading}} ({{db}} dB rel S9, via CAT)
chinese: S 表 {{reading}}（相對 S9 的 {{db}} dB，經 CAT）
發射期間 S 表暫停

english: No CAT S-meter reported by this rig
chinese: 本電台未報告 CAT S 表

english: Native FlexRadio panadapter (SmartSDR) — real RF spectrum, not the soundcard FFT
chinese: 原生 FlexRadio 全景介面卡（SmartSDR）— 真實 RF 頻譜，而非音效卡 FFT

english: Native Icom CI-V scope — real RF spectrum, not the soundcard FFT
chinese: 原生 Icom CI-V 頻譜 — 真實 RF 頻譜，而非音效卡 FFT

english: How far the strongest signal in this view stands above the noise floor. The scope's vertical scale is FIXED at 50 dB above the noise, so a louder signal really does draw a taller spike — use G to widen or tighten that window.
chinese: 本檢視中最強訊號高出噪底多少。頻譜的垂直刻度固定為噪底以上 50 dB，因此更強的訊號確實畫出更高的尖峰 — 用 G 加寬或收緊該視窗。

english: Visual gain — stretch (right) or flatten (left) the color contrast
chinese: 視覺增益 — 拉伸（右）或壓平（左）顏色對比度

english: Visual zero — raise (right) to darken the noise floor, lower (left) to reveal weak texture
chinese: 視覺零點 — 提高（右）以壓暗噪底，降低（左）以顯現微弱紋理

english: Back to the flat trace + waterfall
chinese: 返回平面軌跡 + 瀑布圖

english: Switch to the 3D stacked-spectrum view (fills the panel; hides the trace)
chinese: 切換到 3D 堆疊頻譜檢視（填滿面板；隱藏軌跡）

english: Pause the waterfall — then scroll back through it with the mouse wheel
chinese: 暫停瀑布圖 — 然後用滑鼠滾輪迴滾瀏覽

english: Resume the live scope (history kept filling while paused)
chinese: 恢復即時頻譜（暫停期間歷史持續填充）

english: Scrolls down — the newest row appears at the TOP and history travels downward. Click for newest at the bottom.
chinese: 向下捲動 — 最新行出現在頂部，歷史向下移動。點選切換為最新在底部。

english: Scrolls up — the newest row appears at the BOTTOM and history travels upward. Click for newest at the top.
chinese: 向上捲動 — 最新行出現在底部，歷史向上移動。點選切換為最新在頂部。

english: Click a signal to tune it · press and drag to slide the passband
chinese: 點選訊號以調諧 · 按住拖曳以滑動通帶

english: Click a signal to tune it · press and drag to slide the passband · drag a filter edge to change the width
chinese: 點選訊號以調諧 · 按住拖曳以滑動通帶 · 拖曳濾波器邊緣以更改寬度

english: Scope: ← and → tune, with Shift in bigger steps; Enter tunes onto the signal in the passband; [ and ] narrow and widen the filter; ↑ and ↓ scroll back while paused
chinese: 頻譜：← 和 → 調諧，Shift 為更大步進；Enter調諧到通帶中的訊號；[ 和 ] 收窄與加寬濾波器；↑ 和 ↓ 在暫停時回滾

english: No scope data from the radio
Fast — 1024-point window, 85 ms. Keying and speech onsets resolve; carriers read twice as wide.
chinese: 快速 — 1024 點窗，85 毫秒。鍵控與語音起始可分辨；載波顯示為兩倍寬。

english: Balanced — 2048-point window, 171 ms. The default. A 25 WPM dit is shorter than this window.
chinese: 均衡 — 2048 點窗，171 毫秒。預設值。25 WPM 的點比此窗更短。

english: Sharp — 4096-point window, 341 ms. Half the carrier width, at double the time smear.
chinese: 銳利 — 4096 點窗，341 毫秒。載波寬度減半，時間拖尾加倍。

english: Averaging — how long each frequency is smoothed. Longer steadies the noise floor; shorter keeps keying and syllables. Off draws every sweep as it arrives.
chinese: 平均 — 每個頻率被平滑的時長。更長使噪底更穩；更短保留鍵控與音節。關閉則每條掃描即時繪製。

english: Peak — where one pixel covers several frequency bins, draw the strongest. A narrow carrier keeps its level.
chinese: 峰值 — 當一個畫素覆蓋多個頻率分箱時，繪製最強者。窄載波保持其電平。

english: Average — where one pixel covers several frequency bins, draw their mean power. A smoother noise floor; a narrow carrier in a wide view reads lower.
chinese: 平均 — 當一個畫素覆蓋多個頻率分箱時，繪製其平均功率。噪底更平滑；寬檢視中的窄載波讀數更低。

english: Display settings — resolution, smoothing, the detector, and how a slow scope scrolls
chinese: 顯示設定 — 解析度、平滑、檢波器，以及慢速頻譜的捲動方式

english: Smooth scroll — the waterfall moves at a steady rate. When the radio's scope sweeps slower than that, the newest sweep is repeated until the next one arrives, and each repeat is recorded as one. Click for one row per sweep.
chinese: 平滑捲動 — 瀑布圖以穩定速率移動。當電台頻譜掃描慢於該速率時，最新掃描會被重複，直到下一條到達，且每次重複記錄為一行。點選切換為每行一次掃描。

english: One row per sweep — the waterfall moves only when the radio sends a new sweep, so a slow scope scrolls slowly, in steps, and every row is new. Click for smooth scroll.
chinese: 每行一次掃描 — 瀑布圖僅在電台傳送新掃描時移動，因此慢速頻譜緩慢、分步捲動，且每行都是新的。點選切換為平滑捲動。

english: HiDef — the CW passband is analysed on its own: a steady carrier draws about 4–5 Hz wide, two signals 10 Hz apart stay apart, and keying keeps its gaps. The picture runs about a quarter of a second behind the audio. Click for Fast.
chinese: 高畫質 — CW 通帶單獨分析：穩定載波繪製約 4–5 Hz 寬，相距 10 Hz 的兩個訊號保持分離，鍵控保留其間隔。影像比音訊滯後約四分之一秒。點選切換為快速。

english: Fast — the scope is analysed like every other display: the picture follows the audio closely and carriers draw wider (the resolution is under ⚙). Click for HiDef.
chinese: 快速 — 頻譜像其他顯示一樣分析：影像緊隨音訊，載波繪製更寬（解析度在 ⚙ 之下）。點選切換為高畫質。

english: Fast Graph — signal power across the T/R period; pings draw as spikes
chinese: 快速圖 — 跨 T/R 週期的訊號功率；ping 繪製為尖峰
天線匹配 — 保持在 2:1 以下

english: Antenna match — this is the radio's own raw figure, and Nexus has no verified scale for this model, so it cannot tell you what counts as high here. Watch which way it moves as you tune; the absolute number may be well out, and nothing stops your transmission on it.
chinese: 天線匹配 — 這是電台自身的原始數值，而 Nexus 沒有為該型號驗證過的刻度，因此無法告知你何為過高。調諧時注意其變化方向；絕對值可能偏差很大，且不會據此阻止你發射。

english: ALC — set mic gain so SSB peaks just tickle the zone, never peg it
chinese: ALC — 設定麥克風增益，使 SSB 峰值僅輕觸該區，切勿頂滿

english: Speech compression — the bar is the meter, the line is the processor level ({{level}}%). Drag the bar or use the arrow keys to set the level.
chinese: 語音壓縮 — 柱條是表，線是處理器電平（{{level}}%）。拖曳柱條或用方向鍵設定電平。

english: SSB transmit bandwidth: {{step}}. Click for the radio's next setting.
chinese: SSB 發射頻寬：{{step}}。點選切換電台的下一個設定。
SSB 發射頻寬 {{step}}，下一個設定

english: Not while transmitting — change the transmit bandwidth between overs
chinese: 發射中不可更改 — 在間歇之間更改發射頻寬

english: The radio's power-amplifier (finals) temperature, as the radio reports it
chinese: 電台功放（末級）溫度，按電台報告值

english: The amplifier's temperature, as the amplifier reports it
chinese: 放大器的溫度，按放大器報告值

english: The radio's power-amplifier (finals) temperature meter, as a share of its scale — this radio reports its meter, not degrees
chinese: 電台功放（末級）溫度表，以其刻度佔比表示 — 該電台報告的是表值，而非度數

english: No street map is downloaded yet.
chinese: 尚未下載任何街道地圖。

english: This frees {{size}}. The map choice stays, and Street offers a download again.
chinese: 這將釋放 {{size}}。地圖選擇保留，街道地圖會再次提供下載。

english: Every street map is up to date.
chinese: 所有街道地圖均為最新。
已將 {{name}} 更新至 {{date}} 的地圖資料。

english: Kept in <path>{{folder}}</path>, outside your data folder. Uninstalling Nexus leaves it: delete it by hand to free the space.
chinese: 儲存在 <path>{{folder}}</path>，位於你的資料資料夾之外。解除安裝 Nexus 會保留它：需手動刪除以釋放空間。

english: Bench only (NEXUS_STREET_MAP=1): a .pmtiles map file, or the fonts and icons archive (.tar.gz).
chinese: 僅限 Bench（NEXUS_STREET_MAP=1）：.pmtiles 地圖檔案，或字型與圖示歸檔（.tar.gz）。

english: Interrupts you the INSTANT a needed station appears on the cluster or RBN, rather than waiting for the spot board to refresh. A loud tone plays whether or not Nexus is the window you are looking at, and a banner offers one-click Work. Off until you switch it on. How rare "rare" is depends on your own totals: if you are chasing your first hundred entities then almost every DX spot is a new one and this would never stop talking. Start with New DXCC entity only once your log is far enough along that a new one is genuinely an event. Each station alerts once per band and mode.
chinese: 當所需電台出現在叢集或 RBN 上的瞬間即打斷你，而非等待點報板重新整理。無論 Nexus 是否是你正在看的視窗，都會播放響亮提示音，橫幅提供一鍵通聯。預設關閉，需手動開啟。「罕見」有多罕見取決於你自身的統計：若你正在追逐前一百個實體，則幾乎每個 DX 點報都是新目標，此功能會喋喋不休。當你的日誌足夠豐富、新目標確實成為事件時，再從 僅新 DXCC 實體 開始。每個電台在每個頻段和模式僅提醒一次。
新實體或 CQ 分區

english: New entity, zone, US state, or IOTA group
chinese: 新實體、分區、美國州或 IOTA 群

english: The messages in the bottom-right corner. Turned off, confirmations such as Logged QSO and alerts such as a new DXCC, a station calling you, a band opening or space weather stop popping up. Sounds are not affected. Errors, notices about transmitting, the radio or the log, and any message with a button, such as Stop alarm, still pop up.
chinese: 右下角的訊息。關閉後，諸如「已記錄 QSO」的確認，以及新 DXCC、有人呼叫你、頻段開通或空間天氣等提醒將不再彈出。聲音不受影響。錯誤、關於發射/電台/日誌的通知，以及任何帶按鈕的訊息（如停止警報）仍會彈出。

english: Keep pop-ups up for at least
Most pop-ups go after 4 seconds, errors after 12. Pick a longer time if you look away and miss them. A pop-up that stays until you close it still does.
chinese: 大多數彈窗 4 秒後消失，錯誤 12 秒。若你轉頭錯過，可選更長時間。一直保持到你關閉的彈窗仍如此。

english: Beep + flash when someone directs a call at you.
chinese: 當有人定向呼叫你時，蜂鳴 + 閃爍。

english: Show worked-but-unconfirmed award slots — LoTW confirmation chances — on the Needed board and as chips on decodes. Turn off to chase only new contacts.
chinese: 在需求板和解碼上的晶片中顯示已通聯但未確認的獎項槽位 — LoTW 確認機會。關閉則僅追逐新聯絡。

chinese: 當你在選單允許的頻段上解碼出新 DXCC、新網格或罕見網格 💎 時的聲音與彈窗。關閉會使它們靜音，但不改變其他：需求板以及 NEW ONE 與 GRID 圖示仍跟隨這三個選單。

english: The bands where a new DXCC entity — a “new one” — counts: the Needed boards, the NEW ONE icon and its loud alert all follow this choice. Off takes NEW ONE off every board.
chinese: 一個新 DXCC 實體 —「新目標」— 計數的頻段：需求板、NEW ONE 圖示及其響亮提醒都遵循此選擇。關閉則從每個板移除 NEW ONE。

english: The bands where a grid you haven't worked counts: the Needed boards, the GRID icon on the roster and the decode rows, and its quiet toast all follow this choice. Default VHF+ only — grid awards (VUCC/FFMA) start at 6 m; on HF nearly every decode is an unworked grid.
chinese: 你未通聯過的網格計數的頻段：需求板、名冊和解碼行上的 GRID 圖示，以及其安靜的提示都遵循此選擇。預設僅 VHF+ — 網格獎項（VUCC/FFMA）從 6 米起；在 HF 上幾乎每個解碼都是未通聯的網格。

english: The bands where a rare or water-only grid (rovers, maritime, DXpeditions) counts: the Needed boards, its GRID icon and the loud 💎 alert all follow this choice. Separate from plain grids, so silencing HF chatter keeps the gems.
chinese: 罕見或僅水域網格（漫遊車、海上、DXpeditions）計數的頻段：需求板、其 GRID 圖示和響亮的 💎 提醒都遵循此選擇。與普通網格分開，因此遮蔽 HF 嘈雜聲會保留這些珍寶。

english: Leave every box clear to be alerted about the whole world — that is the default and what this panel has always done. Tick one or more and the new-one, new-grid and CQ alerts are kept to those continents. Someone calling YOU, and anything on your watch list, always alerts wherever they are.
chinese: 將所有框留空以接收全球提醒 — 這是預設且本面板一直的做法。勾選一個或多個，則新目標、新網格和 CQ 提醒僅限於這些洲。呼叫你的某人，以及你關注清單上的任何內容，無論在哪裡都會提醒。

english: Countries added here alert as well as the continents ticked above, so you can follow all of Europe plus Japan. Untick one to drop it. Names are the DXCC list’s own, so Germany appears as Fed. Rep. of Germany.
chinese: 此處新增的國家與上面勾選的洲一同提醒，因此你可關注整個歐洲加日本。取消勾選以移除。名稱採用 DXCC 清單自身的叫法，因此德國顯示為 Fed. Rep. of Germany。

english: The Rig / CAT + Audio settings below edit “{{name}}”. Each radio has its OWN CAT + audio — click “Edit” on any radio to configure it WITHOUT changing the one you're operating on; “Make active” swaps your operating radio. These Rig / CAT controls are station-wide instead, so changing one changes every radio: “Interface keys RTS on the CAT port”, “Split operation”, “Follow the radio's split”, “Wheel tuning sensitivity”, and under Advanced, “Sharing port”, “Serial handshake” and “Keying line at startup”.
