english: Enter the radio's IPv4 address, for example {{example}}.
chinese: 輸入電台的 IPv4 地址，例如 {{example}}。

english: No network user is set, so the radio will refuse the login.
chinese: 未設定網路使用者，因此電台將拒絕登入。

english: No network password is saved for this radio yet: type it and press Set.
chinese: 尚未儲存此電台的網路密碼：輸入後按設定。

english: Enter the SDR program's address on its own, such as {{example}} when it runs on this computer.
chinese: 單獨輸入 SDR 程式的地址，例如它在本機執行時為 {{example}}。

english: Enter the TCI port, a number from 1 to 65535: {{example}} as ExpertSDR3 and Thetis come.
chinese: 輸入 TCI 連線埠，1 到 65535 之間的數字：{{example}} 為 ExpertSDR3 與 Thetis 的預設值。

english: 🎚 Audio devices below are for {{radio}}. Each radio has its OWN input/output — click “Edit” on another radio (in Radios above) to set its audio. The live RX audio + waterfall follow whichever radio is active.
chinese: 🎚 下方音訊裝置用於 {{radio}}。每台電台都有自己的輸入/輸出 — 點選另一電台（上方電台中）的「編輯」以設定其音訊。即時 RX 音訊 + 瀑布圖跟隨目前活動電台。
承載接收音訊的音效卡。
向電台饋送（發射）的音效卡。

english: Flat — no audio on the selected input. Check the device above (radio on? right codec?).
chinese: 平坦 — 所選輸入無音訊。檢查上方裝置（電台開了嗎？編解碼器對嗎？）。

english: What the selected input hears, live — band noise should show as a moving floor. Confirms the RIGHT device before you leave Settings.
chinese: 所選輸入即時聽到的內容 — 頻段雜訊應顯示為移動的底噪。在離開設定前確認是正確裝置。

english: The audio drive into the rig — the SAME control as the cockpit Pwr slider (they always match now). Trim down until your rig's ALC is just zero. This is not the rig's RF watts — set those on the radio.
chinese: 送入電台的音訊 驅動 — 與駕駛艙 功率 滑桿是同一控制（現在始終一致）。下調直到電台的 ALC 剛好為零。這 不是 電台的 RF 瓦數 — 那些在電台上設定。

english: A dB scale like WSJT-X — aim for around 30 dB. Anything from ~15–60 dB decodes fine; red means too hot (back off RX Gain or the rig's audio).
chinese: 類似 WSJT-X 的 dB 刻度 — 目標約 30 dB。約 15–60 dB 範圍內都能正常解碼；紅色表示過熱（調低 RX 增益或電台音訊）。

english: Boost a quiet interface until RX Level reads around 30 dB — the meter responds as you release the slider. Leave at ×1.0 unless the meter reads low (under ~15 dB) — FT8 decodes on a small signal, so you rarely need much.
chinese: 提升安靜的介面直到 RX 電平讀至約 30 dB — 儀表會在你鬆開滑桿時響應。除非儀表讀數偏低（低於約 15 dB），否則保持 ×1.0 — FT8 在小訊號上也能解碼，因此你很少需要很多。

english: Save stores this for {{radio}}, and it takes effect when that radio is in use; the radio in use now does not change.
chinese: 儲存 為 {{radio}} 儲存此項，並在該電台使用時生效；目前正在使用的電台不改變。

english: A short audio cue when the dial crosses your license privileges — a rising "ding" back in band, a falling "dong" past an edge. Applies on every mode.
chinese: 當刻度盤越過你的執照權限時發出簡短音訊提示 — 回到頻段內為上升的「叮」，越過邊緣為下降的「咚」。適用於所有模式。
按模式限制最大功率（安全）

english: A ceiling on RF output per mode — leave blank for full power. FT8/FT4/RTTY run ~100% duty cycle, so capping the Digital modes (e.g. 30%) protects your finals and any amplifier. The rig is brought down to the cap the moment you enter a capped mode, not only when you touch the power slider.
chinese: 每種模式的 RF 輸出上限 — 留空為滿功率。FT8/FT4/RTTY 佔空比約 100%，因此限制數字模式（如 30%）可保護你的末級和任何放大器。一旦進入受限模式，電台即降至上限，而非僅在你動功率滑桿時。

english: Stop transmitting when SWR is high

Two readings in a row above this and Nexus stops transmitting, exactly as Stop TX does, and tells you why. It never starts a transmission and never turns TX back on — you do that once the antenna is sorted out. Off by default; a high reading on one poll is ignored, so a tuner stepping or a keyup transient will not cut you off.
chinese: 連續兩次讀數高於此值，Nexus 即停止發射，與停止 TX 完全相同，並告知原因。它從不發起發射，也從不重新開啟 TX — 待天線整理好後由你操作。預設關閉；單次輪詢的高讀數會被忽略，因此調諧器步進或按鍵瞬態不會切斷你。

english: This radio's SWR reading isn't verified yet, so Nexus won't stop your transmission on it. Nexus only trusts the number where it knows the radio's own scale — Icom over native CI-V, and FlexRadio. On other radios the figure can be far out: some show a near-perfect match on their own meter while reporting a fault here.
chinese: 此電台的 SWR 讀數尚未驗證，因此 Nexus 不會據此停止你的發射。Nexus 僅在知道電台自身刻度時才信任該數值 — 原生 CI-V 的 Icom，以及 FlexRadio。在其他電台上該數值可能偏差很大：有些在自己表上顯示近乎完美匹配，卻在此報告故障。

english: Nexus is not receiving this Flex's own SWR meter, so this cutoff will not stop anything, however high the SWR goes. That meter comes from the radio's native stream, and it is off. Turn on "Flex native panadapter (Beta)" in Settings ▸ Radio ▸ Rig & CAT to start it. Until then this setting has no effect.
chinese: Nexus 未收到此 Flex 自身的 SWR 表，因此無論 SWR 多高，此切斷都不會停止任何發射。該表來自電台的原生資料流，且目前關閉。在 設定 ▸ 電台 ▸ 電台與 CAT 中開啟「Flex 原生全景介面卡（測試版）」以啟動它。在此之前此設定無效。

english: Stop latched transmissions if my Parsec session drops
chinese: 若我的 Parsec 工作階段斷開則停止鎖存發射

english: For running the shack over Parsec. Nexus watches Parsec's own log on this computer. If the Parsec session that was connected drops, or its log can no longer be read, Nexus stops a latched PTT, continuous RTTY or PSK, and Tune, exactly as their own Stop does, and says why. It never starts a transmission or turns TX back on. FT8/FT4 overs are not touched: they end by themselves, and the TX watchdog still applies. Parsec can take up to a minute to notice a pulled network cable, so this backs up the watchdog rather than replacing it.
chinese: 用於在 Parsec 上執行機房。Nexus 監視本機上 Parsec 自身的日誌。若已連線的 Parsec 工作階段斷開，或其日誌無法再讀取，Nexus 會停止鎖存的 PTT、連續 RTTY 或 PSK，以及調諧，與其自身的停止完全相同，並說明原因。它從不發起發射或重新開啟 TX。FT8/FT4 週期不受影響：它們自行結束，且 TX 看門狗仍然適用。Parsec 可能需要近一分鐘才注意到拔掉的網路線，因此這是看門狗的備份而非替代。
do_not_translate: Parsec | Nexus | PTT | RTTY | PSK | Tune | TX | FT8/FT4

english: Available on Windows only, where Nexus can read the Parsec host’s log.
chinese: 僅在 Windows 上可用，Nexus 可在其上讀取 Parsec 主機的日誌。
正在檢查 Parsec 日誌…

english: A Parsec session is connected. If it drops, a latched transmission stops.
chinese: 已連線一個 Parsec 工作階段。若斷開，鎖存發射將停止。

english: No Parsec session is connected, so nothing will be stopped.
chinese: 未連線任何 Parsec 工作階段，因此不會停止任何發射。

english: Nexus cannot find or read Parsec’s log (it looks for log.txt in %APPDATA%\Parsec and %ProgramData%\Parsec), so nothing will be stopped until it can.
chinese: Nexus 無法找到或讀取 Parsec 的日誌（它在 %APPDATA%\Parsec 和 %ProgramData%\Parsec 中查詢 log.txt），因此在能夠讀取之前不會停止任何發射。

english: Stream this station from my browser
chinese: 從我的瀏覽器串流此電台

english: A browser you approved for station control, while it holds control, is shown this Nexus window and can operate it as you would here, transmit included. Its clicks and keys reach Nexus only, never anything else on this computer. Only this window is sent: a dialog that opens outside it, such as a file picker, is not, and a minimized window sends nothing. The stream is encrypted end to end. While a browser is connected, every transmission stops within five seconds if its connection drops, and within seven if its picture freezes.
chinese: 你批准用於電台控制、且正持有控制的瀏覽器，會顯示此 Nexus 視窗，並可像你在此處一樣操作它，包括發射。它的點選和按鍵僅送達 Nexus，絕不會觸及本機其他任何內容。僅傳送此視窗：在視窗外開啟的對話方塊（如檔案選擇器）不會傳送，最小化的視窗不傳送任何內容。串流端到端加密。瀏覽器連線期間，若連線斷開，所有發射在五秒內停止；若畫面凍結，在七秒內停止。

english: The stream is this window as Windows draws it on this computer, so keep Nexus open, and not minimized, while a browser streams it.
chinese: 串流就是 Windows 在本機上繪製的此視窗，因此在瀏覽器串流期間，保持 Nexus 開啟且不要最小化。

english: Available on Windows only, for now.
Available on Windows only, for now. Elsewhere, open Remote in your browser.
chinese: 目前僅限 Windows。其他平台請在瀏覽器中開啟遠端。

english: Saving applies your rig settings live (no restart). Test CAT saves, launches the bundled rigctld (Hamlib ships with Nexus on Windows — no separate install), and reads your rig's frequency to confirm CAT. For CAT, pick your Rig Model and Serial Port; serial RTS/DTR and VOX need no model.
chinese: 儲存會即時應用你的電台設定（無需重啟）。測試 CAT 會儲存、啟動內建的 rigctld（Hamlib 隨 Nexus 在 Windows 上提供 — 無需單獨安裝），並讀取你的電台頻率以確認 CAT。對於 CAT，選擇你的 電台型號 和 串列埠；序列 RTS/DTR 與 VOX 無需型號。
do_not_translate: <b> | <code> | <em> | rigctld | Hamlib | Nexus | CAT | VOX | RTS/DTR

english: Save your radios, preferences, memory channels and watchlist to a file
chinese: 將你的電台、偏好、記憶頻道和關注清單儲存到檔案

english: Your radios, operating preferences, memory channels, watchlist and chase sets in one file — for a new computer, or before a rebuild. It holds no passwords or API keys: those stay in your operating system's keychain, so a restore asks for them again, and the file is safe to keep on a USB stick. Your contact log is separate — export that from the Logbook. Restoring replaces your current setup.
chinese: 你的電台、操作偏好、記憶頻道、關注清單和追逐集集中於一個檔案 — 用於新電腦，或重建前。它不含任何密碼或 API 金鑰：那些保留在你的作業系統鑰匙串中，因此恢復時會再次索要，檔案可放心存於 U 盤。你的聯絡日誌是獨立的 — 從日誌簿匯出。恢復會替換你目前的設定。

english: It also carries how Nexus looks: the theme, colours, text size, density, Night and waterfall palettes, and a restore puts them back. Field mode and UI scale stay with each computer.
chinese: 它還攜帶 Nexus 的外觀：主題、顏色、文字大小、密度、夜間與瀑布圖調色盤，恢復時會還原這些。現場模式與 UI 縮放隨每台電腦保留。

english: Back up to a folder you choose (Back up saves straight to Downloads)
chinese: 備份到你選擇的資料夾（備份直接存入下載）

english: Replace your current setup with a saved backup
chinese: 用已儲存的備份替換目前設定

english: Share this radio with other programs
chinese: 與其他程式共享此電台

english: {{wanted}} is taken (another program is listening there, or it is your radio’s own rigctld address), so Nexus leaves it free and is sharing on {{port}} instead. Point other programs at this address.
chinese: {{wanted}} 已被佔用（另一程式正在該處監聽，或它是你電台自身的 rigctld 地址），因此 Nexus 將其留空，改為在 {{port}} 共享。將其他程式指向此地址。

english: Copy the address to paste into the other program
chinese: 複製地址以貼上到其他程式

english: Nexus itself answers at this address, so VarAC, FreeDV, WSJT-X, JS8Call and fldigi can use the radio while Nexus runs — pick the rig Hamlib NET rigctl (VarAC and FreeDV call it a network or rigctld connection), give it the address above, and leave their serial port blank. They stay connected even while Nexus tests or reconfigures the radio link, and they follow whichever radio is active. Only for this computer — the address is not reachable from the network. Takes effect right away. Both programs can command the rig, so expect them to argue if you tune in both at once.
chinese: Nexus 自身在此地址應答，因此 VarAC、FreeDV、WSJT-X、JS8Call 和 fldigi 可在 Nexus 執行時使用電台 — 選擇電台 Hamlib NET rigctl（VarAC 與 FreeDV 稱之為網路或 rigctld 連線），填入上方地址，並將其串列埠留空。即使 Nexus 測試或重新配置電台鏈路，它們仍保持連線，並跟隨目前活動電台。僅限本機 — 該地址無法從網路訪問。立即生效。兩個程式都能指令電台，因此若你同時調諧兩者，它們會「爭執」。
do_not_translate: <b> | <em> | JS8Call | rigctld | Hamlib | WSJT-X | fldigi | Nexus

english: Off — other programs cannot use the radio while Nexus runs. Turn it on and point them at the address that appears here (Hamlib NET rigctl).
chinese: 關閉 — Nexus 執行時其他程式無法使用電台。開啟後將它們指向此處出現的地址（Hamlib NET rigctl）。

english: Driving a specific radio that is not the active one: use its direct address {{address}} (per-radio; this link drops briefly whenever Nexus reconfigures that radio).
chinese: 驅動某個非活動電台：使用其直連地址 {{address}}（每台電台獨立；每當 Nexus 重新配置該電台時，此鏈路會短暫斷開）。

english: On: a shared program (WSJT-X, VarAC) can key the rig, exactly as it could when it owned the CAT cable — every Nexus transmit safeguard still applies. Off: shared programs tune and read but never transmit.
chinese: 開啟：共享程式（WSJT-X、VarAC）可觸發電台，正如它獨佔 CAT 線纜時那樣 — Nexus 的所有發射安全措施仍然適用。關閉：共享程式可調諧與讀取，但絕不會發射。

english: Off. Turn it on and programs on this computer that speak TCI, such as WSJT-X, JTDX, MSHV and Log4OM, can use the radio through Nexus at the address that appears here.
chinese: 關閉。開啟後，本機上支援 TCI 的程式（如 WSJT-X、JTDX、MSHV 和 Log4OM）可透過此處出現的地址經 Nexus 使用電台。
do_not_translate: <b> | WSJT-X | JTDX | MSHV | Log4OM | TCI | Nexus

english: Programs on this computer connect to this address as they would to an SDR program's TCI server. In WSJT-X and JTDX, pick the rig TCI Client RX1 and give it this address as its TCI server. They follow whichever radio is active: they can tune it, switch its sideband and lower its power (never raise it), and they get its receive audio. Only programs on this computer can connect, never another computer and never a web page. Takes effect when you save.
chinese: 本機程式連線到此地址，如同連線到某 SDR 程式的 TCI 伺服器。在 WSJT-X 與 JTDX 中，選擇電台 TCI Client RX1 並將此地址作為其 TCI 伺服器。它們跟隨目前活動電台：可對其調諧、切換邊帶並降低功率（絕不升高），並獲取其接收音訊。僅本機程式可連線，絕不來自另一台電腦，也絕不來自網頁。儲存時生效。
do_not_translate: <em> | WSJT-X | JTDX | TCI Client RX1 | TCI | SDR

english: Not listening yet. The address appears here once programs can connect. If you just turned this on, save first.
chinese: 尚未監聽。程式可連線後地址將出現於此。若你剛開啟，請先儲存。

english: WSJT-X, JTDX and MSHV look for 40001. A second Nexus window uses the next port, and the address above always shows the one in use. Change it only if another program on this computer already has it.
chinese: WSJT-X、JTDX 和 MSHV 尋找 40001。第二個 Nexus 視窗使用下一連線埠，上方地址始終顯示正在使用的那個。僅當本機另一程式已佔用時才更改。

english: Off: programs tune and read but never transmit. On: a program may key the radio with its own audio or the radio's microphone while Nexus is on its Phone screen, send CW macros on the CW screen, and Tune. Its own audio goes out only once it has asked for a voice mode (USB, LSB, AM or FM). WSJT-X and JTDX ask for a mode only when it differs from Nexus's, so set to USB while Nexus is already in USB they ask for nothing and are refused. Every Nexus transmit safeguard still applies: TX must be on in Nexus, Stop TX wins and holds, and nothing goes past your licence or your power limits. A program never turns TX on. Set at the station only.
chinese: 關閉：程式可調諧與讀取，但絕不發射。開啟：當 Nexus 處於語音螢幕時，程式可用其自身音訊或電台麥克風觸發電台，在 CW 螢幕傳送 CW 宏，並調諧。其自身音訊僅在它請求了語音模式（USB、LSB、AM 或 FM）後才發出。WSJT-X 與 JTDX 僅在模式與 Nexus 不同時才請求模式，因此當 Nexus 已在 USB 時設為 USB，它們請求無內容並被拒絕。Nexus 的所有發射安全措施仍然適用：Nexus 中 TX 必須開啟，停止 TX 優先且保持，且任何內容都不會越過你的執照或功率限制。程式絕不會開啟 TX。僅可在電台處設定。
do_not_translate: Stop TX | Nexus | TX | Tune | CW | WSJT-X | JTDX | USB | LSB | AM | FM

english: FT8, FT4 and other slot-timed modes may not transmit through TCI yet. Nexus refuses a program's digital transmissions until the delay it adds to their timing has been measured.
chinese: FT8、FT4 及其他時隙定時模式尚可能無法透過 TCI 發射。在 Nexus 測量其給這些時序增加的延遲之前，會拒絕程式的數字化發射。
來自程式的 CW 宏

english: A logger's TCI keyer (Log4OM, 5MContest) sends its CW macros through Nexus, on the CW screen only, and only while programs may transmit. Any program can stop the CW.
chinese: 日誌記錄器的 TCI 鍵控器（Log4OM、5MContest）透過 Nexus 傳送其 CW 宏，僅在 CW 螢幕，且僅在程式可發射期間。任何程式都能停止 CW。

english: Spots a program sends show on Nexus's band map and in the Phone and CW screens' band activity. A click on one only tunes Nexus, and a click on a spot in Nexus is passed back to the programs. A spot or a click never transmits.
chinese: 程式傳送的點報顯示在 Nexus 的頻段地圖以及語音和 CW 螢幕的頻段活動中。點選其一僅調諧 Nexus，而點選 Nexus 中的點報會回傳給程式。點報或點選絕不發射。

english: Close this program's connection. Anything it is transmitting stops first.
chinese: 關閉此程式的連線。它正在發射的內容先停止。

english: Nexus could not disconnect the program

chinese: 用於聊天的逗號分隔標籤。
用於有序 QSO 的標籤。

english: Open broadcasts — the Call CQ launchpad + band feed.
chinese: 公開廣播 — 呼叫 CQ 啟動台 + 頻段推送。

english: Round-trips the QRZ Logbook API (ACTION=STATUS) — proves the key works without logging anything
chinese: 往返測試 QRZ Logbook API（ACTION=STATUS）— 在不記錄任何內容的情況下證明金鑰有效

english: ✗ QRZ test failed: {{detail}} (Uploads need the per-logbook API key from logbook.qrz.com ▸ Settings ▸ API — not your QRZ password.)
chinese: ✗ QRZ 測試失敗：{{detail}}（上傳需要每個日誌簿的 API 金鑰，來自 logbook.qrz.com ▸ 設定 ▸ API — 而非你的 QRZ 密碼。）

english: every save, sync, push, and failure lands here
chinese: 每次儲存、同步、推送與失敗都記錄於此

english: No events yet this session — save a credential or run a sync and it shows here.
chinese: 本次工作階段尚無事件 — 儲存憑據或執行同步後它會顯示於此。

english: This log is kept at the station: read it in Settings there.
chinese: 此日誌儲存在電台處：在其中的設定中讀取。

english: Off (the default, and WSJT-X’s): working a station on 40m marks them B4-on-band for 40m in every mode, and the log strip’s Dupe badge counts any mode on the band. On: 40m FT8 and 40m phone are separate contacts — the solid B4 chip and the Dupe badge require the mode to match as well. The hollow B4 chip (worked anywhere) is unaffected either way.
chinese: 關閉（預設，也是 WSJT-X 的）：在 40m 上通聯某台電台，會在每種模式下將其標記為 40m 頻段已通聯，且日誌條上的重複徽章計入該頻段任意模式。開啟：40m FT8 與 40m 語音是不同的聯絡 — 實心 B4 晶片與重複徽章也要求模式匹配。空心 B4 晶片（任何地方已通聯）無論如何都不受影響。
本地 API 與日誌記錄器

english: for JTAlert / GridTracker / loggers — and FT8 contest scorers. Several at once: separate addresses with a comma.
chinese: 用於 JTAlert / GridTracker / 日誌記錄器 — 以及 FT8 競賽計分器。可多個同時使用：用逗號分隔地址。

english: push each QSO to HRD Logbook over its QSO-Forwarding UDP port (HRD must be running; don't also run JTAlert/QSO Relay into HRD or you'll double-log)
chinese: 透過 HRD 的 QSO 轉發 UDP 連線埠將每筆 QSO 推送到 HRD Logbook（HRD 必須執行；不要同時讓 JTAlert/QSO Relay 也寫入 HRD，否則會重複記錄）
HRD QSO 轉發 host:port（預設 127.0.0.1:2333）
● 可訪問 HRD — 聯絡正在轉發

english: ○ HRD not reachable — {{count}} contact(s) queued, will send when HRD is back
chinese: ○ 無法訪問 HRD — {{count}} 個聯絡已排隊，HRD 恢復後將傳送

english: Where Nexus listens for WSJT-X/JTDX in Companion source mode.
chinese: Nexus 在伴侶源模式下監聽 WSJT-X/JTDX 的位置。
寫入 ALL.TXT 解碼日誌

english: WSJT-X-format decode log for GridTracker / loggers to tail. Written only while this is on, and it first appears after the next decode.
chinese: 供 GridTracker / 日誌記錄器跟蹤的 WSJT-X 格式解碼日誌。僅在此開啟時寫入，且首次出現在下次解碼之後。

english: In JS8 it also writes DIRECTED.TXT beside it, as JS8Call does: every directed message heard.
chinese: 在 JS8 中，它還會像 JS8Call 那樣在旁邊寫入 DIRECTED.TXT：每個聽到的定向訊息。

english: Save a WAV per logged QSO
chinese: 為每個已記錄 QSO 儲存一個 WAV

english: Auto-records the last ~60 s of RX audio on log.
chinese: 在記錄時自動錄製最近約 60 秒的 RX 音訊。

english: Saved in {{path}}, created the first time you record.
chinese: 儲存在 {{path}}，首次錄製時建立。
儲存接收音訊（每個週期一個 .wav）

english: WAVs land in recordings/periods (12 kHz mono, ~360 KB each). "All" writes ~2 GB/day of continuous monitoring — use for decoder debugging, not always-on.
chinese: WAV 存入 recordings/periods（12 kHz 單聲道，每個約 360 KB）。「全部」在連續監控下每天寫入約 2 GB — 用於解碼器除錯，而非常開。

english: upload spots to the global map
chinese: 將點報上傳到全球地圖

english: While {{event}} runs, its rules allow spots only over amateur RF, so no reports are sent; they resume when it ends.
chinese: 當 {{event}} 執行時，其規則僅允許透過業餘 RF 傳送點報，因此不會上報；結束後恢復。
DX 叢集 / RBN 點報

english: Surface "new ones" from the Reverse Beacon Network on the Needed board + Conditions. Takes effect on restart.
chinese: 在需求板 + Conditions 上凸顯來自 Reverse Beacon Network 的「新目標」。重啟後生效。

english: No nodes — add one below to get SSB/phone needs (RBN only carries CW + digital).
chinese: 無節點 — 在下方新增一個以獲取 SSB/語音需求（RBN 僅承載 CW + 數字）。

english: We connect to ALL listed nodes and union their human SSB/phone spots — more nodes = wider phone coverage (RBN CW + digital connect automatically; RBN endpoints are ignored here). Nexus never changes this list for you. An added node connects, and a removed one disconnects, on the next Save.
chinese: 我們連線所有列出的節點併合並其人工 SSB/語音點報 — 節點越多，語音覆蓋越廣（RBN 的 CW + 數字自動連線；此處的 RBN 端點被忽略）。Nexus 絕不會為你更改此清單。新增的節點會在下次儲存時連線，移除的節點會斷開。
自動選擇可用節點（推薦）

english: Nexus keeps two of these nodes connected for SSB/phone spots and spreads operators across them. A node that stops answering for five minutes, while your other spot feeds are working, is skipped for a day and another takes its place. A quiet band never counts against a node. RBN CW + digital connect automatically either way. Takes effect on the next Save.
chinese: Nexus 保持其中兩個節點連線以獲取 SSB/語音點報，並在它們之間分散操作員。某節點若停止應答達五分鐘（而其他點報源正常），將被跳過一天，由另一節點取代。安靜的頻段絕不計入節點。RBN 的 CW + 數字無論哪種方式都自動連線。下次儲存時生效。

english: Added to your callsign at login (2 = W9XYZ-2). A node allows one session per callsign and drops the older one, so a second Nexus — or another cluster program on the same call — knocks this one off unless each uses a different SSID. 1-99, or leave it empty to log in with your bare call. Your spots still reach the network under your plain callsign. On a node that requires registration, register the suffixed call there too or it will not let you post spots. Takes effect on the next Save.
chinese: 在登入時新增到你的呼號（2 = W9XYZ-2）。一個節點每個呼號允許一個工作階段並丟棄較舊的那個，因此第二個 Nexus — 或同一呼號上的另一個叢集程式 — 會把此工作階段踢掉，除非各自使用不同的 SSID。1–99，或留空以用裸呼號登入。你的點報仍以純呼號到達網路。在需要註冊的節點上，也需在那裡註冊帶字尾的呼號，否則它不會讓你釋出點報。下次儲存時生效。

english: Watch VHF/10 m activity near your QTH (not just your own contacts) so openings flag "open around you" before you've worked anyone. Takes effect on restart.
chinese: 監視你 QTH 附近的 VHF/10 米活動（不僅是你自己的聯絡），以便在通聯任何人之前就標記「你周圍開通」。重啟後生效。

english: Log space weather on each contact
chinese: 為每個聯絡記錄空間天氣

english: Adds the planetary K index, A index and solar flux to every contact you log (ADIF K_INDEX, A_INDEX, SFI), from the latest reading Nexus fetched. Nothing is added when that reading is more than 3 hours old.
chinese: 為記錄的每個聯絡新增行星 K 指數、A 指數和太陽通量（ADIF K_INDEX、A_INDEX、SFI），取自 Nexus 獲取的最新讀數。當該讀數超過 3 小時則不新增。

english: Drives the per-station path outlook + 24h band×hour grid. P.533 is the real circuit-reliability method (validated against the ITU reference; ~0.1 s per prediction, uses your station power). Live spots always win over any model.
chinese: 驅動每電台路徑展望 + 24 小時 頻段×小時 網格。P.533 是真實的電路可靠性方法（對照 ITU 參考驗證；每次預測約 0.1 秒，使用你的電台功率）。即時點報始終優先於任何模型。
LoTW 清單已載入 — {{count}} 個呼號

english: Not fetched yet — decode lists gain an L mark on calls that upload to LoTW.
chinese: 尚未獲取 — 解碼清單會在上傳到 LoTW 的呼號上顯示 L 標記。

english: Count as a LoTW user if uploaded within (days)
chinese: 若在該天數內上傳則計為 LoTW 使用者

english: ARRL's activity list updates weekly — refetching more often just returns "unchanged". Manual fetch by design (WSJT-X convention).
chinese: ARRL 的活動清單每週更新 — 更頻繁地重新獲取只會返回「未改變」。按設計手動獲取（WSJT-X 約定）。
呼號→州資料庫已更新 — {{count}} 個美國呼號
{{count}} 個美國呼號 · 獲取於 {{date}}

english: Not loaded yet — downloads on first launch, then auto-refreshes weekly.
chinese: 尚未載入 — 首次啟動時下載，之後每週自動重新整理。

english: A callsign→state index (from the FCC license file) so a New State lights up on cluster / CW / SSB spots that carry no grid. Refreshed weekly from hamradiotools.io; a live decode grid refines it for rovers.
chinese: 呼號→州索引（來自 FCC 執照檔案），以便在沒有網格的叢集 / CW / SSB 點報上點亮「新州」。每週從 hamradiotools.io 重新整理；即時解碼網格為漫遊車細化它。

english: Island group names: © Islands On The Air (IOTA) Ltd and RSGB — iota-world.org
chinese: 島嶼群名稱：© Islands On The Air (IOTA) Ltd 與 RSGB — iota-world.org
do_not_translate: Islands On The Air (IOTA) Ltd | RSGB | iota-world.org

english: The IOTA island list could not be downloaded
chinese: 無法下載 IOTA 島嶼清單

english: {{ref}} is not on the IOTA island list.
chinese: {{ref}} 不在 IOTA 島嶼清單上。

english: Kept in your log, but sent to no service until you confirm it on the contact card.
chinese: 保留在你的日誌中，但在你在聯絡卡片上確認之前不傳送至任何服務。

english: Filled from a spot: kept in your log, sent to no service until you confirm it.
chinese: 由點報填入：保留在你的日誌中，在你確認之前不傳送。

english: Filled from the callbook: kept in your log, sent to no service until you confirm it.
chinese: 由呼號簿填入：保留在你的日誌中，在你確認之前不傳送。

english: New IOTA: {{ref}}, from the spot comment

chinese: 顯示 IOTA 島嶼名稱

english: IOTA Ltd's island-group list (© RSGB and IOTA Ltd) ships with Nexus by IOTA Ltd's permission and is checked at iota-world.org for a newer copy at most monthly. It names island groups and flags a reference that is not one. Off shows no names, stops the check and deletes any downloaded copy.
chinese: IOTA Ltd 的島嶼群清單（© RSGB 與 IOTA Ltd）經 IOTA Ltd 許可隨 Nexus 提供，並在 iota-world.org 最多每月檢查一次更新副本。它為島嶼群命名並標記非法的參考。關閉則不顯示名稱、停止檢查並刪除任何已下載副本。

english: {{count}} island groups · the copy shipped with Nexus ({{date}})
chinese: {{count}} 個島嶼群 · Nexus 隨附副本（{{date}}）

english: Off: references are checked by their shape (EU-131) only.
chinese: 關閉：參考僅按其格式（EU-131）檢查。

english: Country file downloaded — AD1C {{ver}} applies at next launch.
chinese: 國家檔案已下載 — AD1C {{ver}} 於下次啟動時應用。

english: Country file is already current — AD1C {{ver}}.
chinese: 國家檔案已是最新 — AD1C {{ver}}。
{{count}} 個實體 · AD1C {{ver}} · 獲取於 {{date}}

english: Update downloaded (AD1C {{ver}}) — applies at next launch.
chinese: 更新已下載（AD1C {{ver}}）— 下次啟動時應用。

english: The AD1C cty.dat country file maps callsigns to DXCC entities — the country on decode rows, the Needed board and the log. Checked weekly; a downloaded update applies at the next launch.
chinese: AD1C cty.dat 國家檔案將呼號對映到 DXCC 實體 — 即解碼行、需求板與日誌上的國家。每週檢查；下載的更新於下次啟動時應用。

english: The colours of the waterfalls and scopes: the same two settings as the pickers in the cockpits. Turbo is the default. Cividis looks almost the same to red-green colour-blind eyes as to everyone else.
chinese: 瀑布圖與頻譜的顏色：與駕駛艙中選擇器相同的兩項設定。Turbo 為預設。Cividis 在紅綠色盲眼中和在其他人眼中看起來幾乎相同。

english: Shared by the scopes and waterfalls of those four modes.
chinese: 由這四種模式的頻譜與瀑布圖共享。

english: The FT waterfall keeps a palette of its own.
chinese: FT 瀑布圖保留自己的調色盤。

english: The Conditions map’s view (globe, flat or beam), its layers and its colours are chosen on the map itself, and Conditions keeps a separate set for each activity you pick there.
chinese: Conditions 地圖的檢視（地球儀、平面或波束）、其圖層與顏色在地圖上自行選擇，且 Conditions 為你在此處選擇的每個活動保留一套獨立設定。

english: Reduce turns off the animations and fades, which also helps a slow computer keep up. Alerts still show; they just stop pulsing. Follow the computer uses your system’s own reduce-motion setting.
chinese: 減少會關閉動畫與淡入淡出，這也有助於慢速電腦跟上。提醒仍會顯示；只是停止脈動。跟隨電腦使用你係統自身的減少動態設定。

english: Your logbook, the data tables Nexus downloads and the Winlink mailbox live in one folder. Keep it on a drive inside this computer. Nexus keeps your logbook in a database, and a database on a network drive can be damaged by the way file locking works across a network, so a network drive is refused. A synced folder (Dropbox, OneDrive, iCloud, Google Drive) is allowed, but only ONE Nexus may use it at a time: two computers writing one logbook through a sync client make a conflicted copy, not a merged log.
chinese: 你的日誌簿、Nexus 下載的資料表以及 Winlink 信箱都位於一個資料夾中。請將其保留在本機的一個驅動器上。Nexus 將你的日誌簿儲存在資料庫中，而網路驅動器上的資料庫可能因跨網路的檔案鎖定方式而損壞，因此網路驅動器被拒絕。同步資料夾（Dropbox、OneDrive、iCloud、Google Drive）是允許的，但一次僅允許一個 Nexus 使用它：兩台電腦透過同步使用者端寫入同一日誌簿會產生衝突副本，而非合併日誌。
do_not_translate: Google Drive | OneDrive | Dropbox | Winlink | iCloud | Nexus

english: This folder is on a network drive. Nexus keeps your logbook in a database, and a database on network storage can be damaged by the way file locking works across a network — the worst case is a logbook that will not open. Copy the folder to a drive inside this computer and point Nexus at the copy.
chinese: 此資料夾位於網路驅動器上。Nexus 將你的日誌簿儲存在資料庫中，而網路儲存上的資料庫可能因跨網路的檔案鎖定方式而損壞 — 最壞情況是日誌簿無法開啟。將資料夾複製到本機的驅動器上，並將 Nexus 指向該副本。

english: This folder looks like it is synced by Dropbox, OneDrive, iCloud or Google Drive. Only ONE Nexus may use it at a time — two computers writing one logbook through a sync client make a conflicted copy, not a merged log.
chinese: 此資料夾看起來由 Dropbox、OneDrive、iCloud 或 Google Drive 同步。一次僅允許一個 Nexus 使用它 — 兩台電腦透過同步使用者端寫入同一日誌簿會產生衝突副本，而非合併日誌。
do_not_translate: Google Drive | OneDrive | Dropbox | iCloud | Nexus

english: Set by NEXUS_DATA_DIR for this launch, which wins over this setting.
chinese: 由本次啟動的 NEXUS_DATA_DIR 設定，優先於本設定。

english: Chosen: {{path}} — Nexus uses it the next time it starts.
chinese: 已選擇：{{path}} — Nexus 下次啟動時啟用。

english: Pick the folder from your computer instead of typing the path. This only fills the box in — nothing changes until you choose one of the buttons below.
chinese: 從你的電腦選擇資料夾，而非鍵入路徑。這僅填入方框 — 在你選擇下方按鈕之一前不會改變任何內容。

english: Could not open the folder picker
chinese: 無法開啟資料夾選擇器

english: Use this folder from the next start. Nothing is copied, so the folder should already hold your log.
chinese: 從下次啟動起使用此資料夾。不復制任何內容，因此該資料夾應已包含你的日誌。

english: Copy my log and data there
chinese: 將我的日誌與資料複製到此處

english: Copy the logbook, the data tables and the Winlink mailbox to the new folder, check every copied file against the original, and use it from the next start. Your old folder is left exactly as it is.
chinese: 將日誌簿、資料表和 Winlink 信箱複製到新資料夾，對照原檔案檢查每個複製的檔案，並從下次啟動起使用它。你的舊資料夾保持原樣。

english: Forget the chosen folder and go back to the default one at the next start. Nothing is deleted.
chinese: 忘記所選資料夾，並在下次啟動時回到預設資料夾。不會刪除任何內容。

english: A new folder is used the next time Nexus starts. Nothing is ever moved or deleted — your old folder stays as it is.
chinese: Nexus 下次啟動時將使用新資料夾。絕不會移動或刪除任何內容 — 你的舊資料夾保持原樣。

english: How long Recently deleted and Undo can put back a deleted or purged contact. After that, the logbook's copy of it is removed when Nexus starts. Every edit's old and new values are kept for good. 0 keeps deleted contacts for good too.
chinese: 「最近刪除」與復原可將已刪除或已清除的聯絡恢復的時間長度。此後，日誌簿中的該副本在 Nexus 啟動時會被移除。每次編輯的舊值與新值永久保留。0 也表示永久保留已刪除聯絡。

english: Copied {{files}} files ({{bytes}} bytes) and checked every one against the original. Nexus uses the new folder the next time it starts.
chinese: 已複製 {{files}} 個檔案（{{bytes}} 位元組）並對照原檔案檢查每一個。Nexus 下次啟動時使用新資料夾。

english: Saved. Nexus uses the new folder the next time it starts.
chinese: 已儲存。Nexus 下次啟動時使用新資料夾。

english: Could not change the data folder
This replaces your custom feature set.
chinese: 這將替換你的自訂功能集。

english: Custom — a blended feature set (manual toggles or multiple goals)
chinese: 自訂 — 混合功能集（手動開關或多個目標）

english: Custom — a blended feature set. Pick a single goal above to reset to its defaults.
chinese: 自訂 — 混合功能集。在上方選擇單一目標以重設為預設。

english: Pick a goal to set sensible defaults — every feature stays toggleable below. Switching profiles re-applies its set.
chinese: 選擇一個目標以設定合理預設 — 每個功能在下方仍可調。切換配置檔案會重新應用其集合。

english: Speech and sound cues for operating by ear (screen-reader users, or anyone who wants audible feedback). The keyboard and screen-reader labels throughout Nexus are always on — these settings only control what comes out of the speakers.
chinese: 用於憑聽操作的語音與聲音提示（螢幕閱讀器使用者，或任何想要可聽回饋的人）。Nexus 各處的鍵盤與螢幕閱讀器標籤始終開啟 — 這些設定僅控制從揚聲器輸出的內容。
僅需要的（呼叫你 / 新 / 已關注）
全部（新增每週期 CQ 摘要）

english: What a screen reader speaks as decodes arrive. Silent without a reader running. "Needed" mirrors your alerts; "All" adds a spoken batch summary each cycle.
chinese: 螢幕閱讀器在解碼到達時所說的內容。沒有執行閱讀器時靜音。「需要的」映象你的提醒；「全部」在每個週期新增語音批次摘要。

english: A rising tone when you key up, falling when you unkey — know your TX state by ear.
chinese: 按鍵時上升音，松鍵時下降音 — 憑耳朵知曉你的 TX 狀態。

english: A soft tick each cycle new signals are decoded — the band's rhythm, eyes-free.
chinese: 每個週期有新訊號解碼時的輕柔滴答 — 頻段的節奏，無需目視。

english: A short rising chirp when the CW turn cue says it is your turn to send. Never while you transmit.
chinese: 當 CW 輪次提示說輪到你傳送時的短暫上升啁啾。絕不在你發射時。

english: A few choices for each colour, every one checked for contrast in both themes and on the dark displays. Transmit red, the alert orange and the Needed colours stay fixed.
chinese: 每種顏色提供幾個選項，每個都在兩種主題與暗色顯示上檢查過對比度。發射紅、提醒橙與需要的顏色保持固定。
將 {{role}} 重設為其標準顏色

english: Selected chips, focus rings, your own chat bubbles
chinese: 選中的標籤、焦點環、你自己的聊天氣泡

english: The frequency digits and other readouts
Walk through which radio does what: bands, modes on a shared band, switching, audio and a check. Nothing is saved until Finish.
chinese: 逐步設定各電台的職責：頻段、共享頻段上的模式、切換、音訊與一項檢查。在「完成」前不儲存任何內容。

english: Edit this contact: the call, what they sent, the band and the mode. It keeps its time, serial and number. In the log strip, Ctrl+Y edits the newest contact.
chinese: 編輯此聯絡：呼號、對方傳送的內容、頻段與模式。其時間、序號與編號保留。在日誌條中，Ctrl+Y 編輯最新聯絡。

english: Editing {{contact}}: Enter saves, Esc leaves it as it was.
chinese: 正在編輯 {{contact}}：Enter儲存，Esc 保持原樣。

english: Not private — announced in the clear. Coordinated QSY steps you and one other station to a new channel together, with the move sent as plain text (FCC Part 97 forbids encryption / obscured meaning, and your callsign IDs every 10 min). It shakes a casual scanner parked on the old frequency — it does not hide you from anyone with a wideband receiver, who can follow. Use it for anti-QRM and modest obscurity, never for secrecy.

chinese: 你正按著 PTT，因此Enter不會播放任何內容。

chinese: 未來 24 小時內的可通聯過境（峰值 10° 以上）

english: Logs the contact from your dial, exactly as the Phone and CW log panels do. On the downlink of a satellite LoTW lists — the one you are working, or the one you last worked until you pick another — Nexus tags it for you: it writes the ADIF PROP_MODE and SAT_NAME fields, so the contact counts toward LoTW satellite credit and Nexus’s own satellite totals. english: {{count}} of your radios cover this band, so APRS had a choice to make. It follows the active radio, currently {{name}} — if that is not the rig your packet audio is wired to, this is why nothing is decoding. Routing rules decide which radio a band goes to: Settings → Radios.

chinese: 最近 0.1 秒的輸入：數字靜音（恰好為零）

chinese: 最近 0.1 秒的輸入峰值：{{db}} dBFS

english: This radio doesn't cover {{freq}} MHz, so it can't receive RF APRS. RF APRS needs a VHF radio. The internet feed works without one — turn it on to see APRS traffic reported by other stations.
chinese: 此電台不覆蓋 {{freq}} MHz，因此無法接收射頻 APRS。射頻 APRS 需要 VHF 電台。沒有它網際網路資料來源也能工作 — 開啟即可檢視其他台站報告的 APRS 流量。

chinese: APRS 解碼器未執行。啟用監視以解碼接收音訊。

english: The radio is on {{want}} but in {{mode}} — APRS needs FM. FM packet audio demodulated as SSB is garbled, so nothing will decode however strong the signal is. Tune to the APRS channel to start hearing it.
chinese: 電台在 {{want}} 上，但模式是 {{mode}} — APRS 需要 FM。把 FM 分組音訊按 SSB 解調會亂碼，無論訊號多強都解不出來。請調到 APRS 頻道。

english: The radio is on {{dial}} {{mode}} — APRS needs {{want}} FM. Nothing on this channel can decode as APRS packet, whatever the audio level says. Tune to the APRS channel to start hearing it.
chinese: 電台在 {{dial}} {{mode}} — APRS 需要 {{want}} FM。此頻道上任何內容都無法按 APRS 分組解碼，無論音訊電平顯示什麼。請調到 APRS 頻道。

english: The radio is on {{dial}} — APRS needs {{want}}. Nothing on this channel can decode as APRS packet, whatever the audio level says. Tune to the APRS channel to start hearing it.
chinese: 電台在 {{dial}} — APRS 需要 {{want}}。此頻道上任何內容都無法按 APRS 分組解碼，無論音訊電平顯示什麼。請調到 APRS 頻道。

english: Armed, but no audio samples are arriving at all — the capture device is not delivering anything. Check that Input Device (RX) in Settings ▸ Radio ▸ Audio is the radio (not a microphone or a disconnected device); what you hear on the speaker does not tell you what the app is capturing.
chinese: 已啟用，但完全沒有音訊樣本到達 — 採集裝置沒有送出任何資料。請檢查 設定 ▸ 電台 ▸ 音訊 中的輸入裝置（接收）是否為電台（而不是麥克風或已斷開的裝置）；揚聲器裡聽到的聲音並不代表應用正在採集的聲音。
啟用以來已解碼 {{count}} 個分組。即時 {{level}}。

english: {{count}} packets decoded since arming, last one {{age}} ago. Live {{level}}.
chinese: 啟用以來已解碼 {{count}} 個分組，最近一次在 {{age}}。即時 {{level}}。

english: {{count}} bursts heard since arming, last one {{age}} ago — none passed the checksum. Some of that is normal: when the squelch opens partway through a burst the start of the packet is lost, and a part-heard packet can never pass. It is only a fault if nothing ever decodes — in which case check the rig is on {{channel}} in FM.{{advice}} Last burst peaked {{burst}}; live {{level}}.
chinese: 啟用以來聽到 {{count}} 個突發，最近一次在 {{age}} — 均未透過校驗。其中一部分屬正常：若靜噪在突發中途開啟，分組開頭會丟失，殘缺的分組永遠無法透過。只有當從未解出任何內容時才算故障 — 那時請檢查電台是否在 {{channel}} 且為 FM。{{advice}} 最近一次突發峰值為 {{burst}}；即時 {{level}}。

english: The burst is CLIPPING (peaked {{peak}}, {{samples}} sample(s) at the rails) — lower the rig's USB AF output level, or the Windows input level for that device. Packet survives a lot of clipping, so this costs headroom rather than decodes, but there is no reason to run into the rails.
chinese: 該突發正在削波（峰值 {{peak}}，有 {{samples}} 個樣本頂到上限）— 請降低電台的 USB AF 輸出電平，或降低該裝置在 Windows 中的輸入電平。分組能承受相當程度的削波，因此這損失的是餘量而非解位元速率，但也沒必要頂到上限。

english: The burst peaked {{peak}}, well below the healthy {{min}} to {{max}} band — raise the rig's USB AF output level (IC-9700: SET > Connectors > USB AF Output Level) or the Windows input level for that device. That buys margin against noise; it is not by itself why a checksum fails.
chinese: 該突發峰值為 {{peak}}，遠低於健康區間 {{min}} 至 {{max}} — 請提高電台的 USB AF 輸出電平（IC-9700：SET > Connectors > USB AF Output Level）或該裝置在 Windows 中的輸入電平。這能留出抗噪餘量；但它本身並不是校驗失敗的原因。

english: The input is alive and delivering audio, but it is silent — normally that just means the squelch is closed between packets, which is what an idle FM channel looks like. To confirm the routing, open the squelch: hiss should show up here as a level. If it still reads silent with the squelch open, the wrong input device is selected. Live {{level}}.
chinese: 輸入正常並正在送音訊，但內容是靜音 — 通常只表示分組之間靜噪關閉，這正是空閒 FM 頻道的樣子。要確認路由是否正確，請開啟靜噪：嘶聲應當在此顯示為電平。若開啟靜噪後仍顯示靜音，說明選錯了輸入裝置。即時 {{level}}。

english: Audio is reaching the decoder and no packets have been heard recently — a quiet channel. Live {{level}}. With the squelch open, hiss should sit around {{hiss}}; a packet burst should peak {{min}} to {{max}}.
chinese: 音訊已到達解碼器，但近期未聽到分組 — 頻道安靜。即時 {{level}}。開啟靜噪時，嘶聲應約為 {{hiss}}；分組突發的峰值應在 {{min}} 至 {{max}}。

chinese: RTTY — 按設定波特率與頻移的 Baudot/ITA2（45.45 / 170 Hz 為 HF 標準；可在 設定 → RTTY 中更改）

english: True FSK — data bits on the serial keyline, rig in RTTY mode (its narrow RTTY filters work). Change the backend in Settings → RTTY.

chinese: AFSK — 音效卡音訊以 LSB 送入電台（由音效卡定時的穩健預設方案）。可在 設定 → RTTY 中更改後端。

english: Heartbeat menu: send one now, or start or stop the repeat. Right-clicking HB opens it too.
chinese: 心跳選單：立即傳送一次，或啟動/停止重複。右鍵點選 HB 也可開啟。

english: Heartbeat networking is off, as JS8Call ships it: no HB button, no heartbeats and no heartbeat acknowledgements. Click to turn it on (remembered). It sends nothing by itself.
chinese: 心跳組網已關閉，與 JS8Call 出廠預設一致：沒有 HB 按鈕，不發心跳，也不做心跳確認。點選開啟（會被記住）。它本身不會傳送任何內容。

english: Heartbeat networking is on: HB sends your heartbeats, and HB ACK may answer the heartbeats you hear. Click to turn it off (remembered); a running heartbeat repeat stops.
chinese: 心跳組網已開啟：HB 會傳送你的心跳，HB ACK 可能會應答你聽到的心跳。點選關閉（會被記住）；正在執行的心跳重複會停止。

english: No heartbeats at {{speed}}: JS8Call sends heartbeats and their acknowledgements only at Slow, Normal and Fast. HB is hidden until you change speed, and this switch keeps its setting.
chinese: 在 {{speed}} 速率下不傳送心跳：JS8Call 僅在 Slow、Normal 和 Fast 下傳送心跳及其確認。在你更改速率之前 HB 會隱藏，而此開關會保留其設定。

english: Heartbeat acknowledgements are on, but none goes out at {{speed}}: JS8Call answers heartbeats only at Slow, Normal and Fast.
chinese: 心跳確認已開啟，但在 {{speed}} 速率下不會發出：JS8Call 僅在 Slow、Normal 和 Fast 下應答心跳。

english: Heartbeat acknowledgements are on, but held back now: a message is still arriving, as in JS8Call.
chinese: 心跳確認已開啟，但目前被暫緩：仍有訊息正在接收，與 JS8Call 一致。

english: Heartbeat acknowledgements are on, but held back now: a call is in the To box (the QSO pause, Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8). Clear the To box to answer heartbeats again.
chinese: 心跳確認已開啟，但目前被暫緩：收件框中存在呼號（QSO 暫停，設定 ▸ 數字 ▸ JS8）。清空收件框即可重新應答心跳。

english: Not answering these stations, which heartbeat more often than every 55 minutes: {{calls}}.
chinese: 正在忽略以下台站的心跳，因為它們的心跳間隔短於 55 分鐘：{{calls}}。

english: ≈ {{count}} frame — over the {{max}}-frame airtime cap; shorten it
chinese: ≈ {{count}} 幀 — 超過 {{max}} 幀的發射時長上限；請縮短

english: ≈ {{count}} frames — over the {{max}}-frame airtime cap; shorten it
chinese: ≈ {{count}} 幀 — 超過 {{max}} 幀的發射時長上限；請縮短

english: ≈ {{count}} frames — over the {{max}}-frame airtime cap; shorten it
chinese: ≈ {{count}} 幀 — 超過 {{max}} 幀的發射時長上限；請縮短

english: ≈ {{count}} frames — over the {{max}}-frame airtime cap; shorten it
chinese: ≈ {{count}} 幀 — 超過 {{max}} 幀的發射時長上限；請縮短

english: How many periods this takes on the air (one frame per period). An estimate — the engine packs the real frames and refuses anything over ten minutes of airtime.
chinese: 這需要佔用多少週期的空口時間（每週期一幀）。僅為估算 — 引擎會實際打包，並拒絕任何超過十分鐘空口時長的內容。

english: Auto-reply is off — an answer to SNR?, GRID?, INFO? or STATUS? to you, an ACK for a MSG or a relay is put in the message box for you to send, as JS8Call does, and nothing keys by itself; QUERY MSGS goes unanswered. Click to turn it on (remembered). It answers only while TX is on.
chinese: 自動回覆已關閉 — 發給你的 SNR?、GRID?、INFO? 或 STATUS? 的答覆，以及對 MSG 或中繼的 ACK，會放入訊息框由你自行傳送，與 JS8Call 一致，絕不自行發射；QUERY MSGS 不會得到應答。點選開啟（會被記住）。僅在發射開啟時才會應答。
do_not_translate: SNR? | GRID? | INFO? | STATUS? | ACK | MSG | QUERY MSGS | JS8Call | TX

english: Auto-reply is on, but TX is off — nothing keys; a reply is shown as “would have replied”. Enable TX (the header pill) to let replies go out.
chinese: 自動回覆已開啟，但發射已關閉 — 不會發射；回覆會顯示為「本應回覆」。啟用發射（頂欄膠囊）後回覆才會發出。

english: Auto-reply is ARMED: SNR?, GRID?, INFO?, QUERY and MSG addressed to you or a group you joined are answered, each after your Yes when Settings asks for one. Click to turn it off.
chinese: 自動回覆已就緒：發給你的、或發給你加入的組的 SNR?、GRID?、INFO?、QUERY 和 MSG 都會得到應答，若設定在詢問時要求確認，則在你說「是」之後回覆。點選關閉。

english: Relay is off — a > message routed through you is displayed and not passed on. Click to turn it on (remembered). Relaying is third-party traffic; you are responsible for it.
chinese: 中繼已關閉 — 經你轉發的 > 訊息只顯示，不再傳遞。點選開啟（會被記住）。中繼屬於第三方資訊，你需對其負責。

english: Relay is on, but TX is off — nothing keys. Enable TX (the header pill) to relay.
chinese: 中繼已開啟，但發射已關閉 — 不會發射。啟用發射（頂欄膠囊）後方可中繼。

english: Relay is ARMED: a > message routed through you is retransmitted with *DE* your call, and the final hop is acknowledged. With Auto-reply off, it is put in the message box for you to send instead. Click to turn it off.
chinese: 中繼已就緒：經你轉發的 > 訊息會以 *DE* 你的呼號 重新傳送，最後一跳會被確認。若自動回覆關閉，則改為放入訊息框由你傳送。點選關閉。

english: Relay is on, but with AUTOREPLY off a relay is put in the message box for you to send, and nothing keys by itself. Turn AUTOREPLY on to relay on the air.
chinese: 中繼已開啟，但自動回覆關閉時，轉發的訊息會放入訊息框由你傳送，絕不自行發射。開啟自動回覆才能在空口上中繼。

english: Heartbeat acknowledgements are off (JS8Call’s default). Click to answer heartbeats with HEARTBEAT SNR (remembered). Answers only while TX is on.
chinese: 心跳確認已關閉（JS8Call 的預設設定）。點選可用 HEARTBEAT SNR 應答心跳（會被記住）。僅在發射開啟時才會應答。

english: Heartbeat acknowledgements are on, but TX is off — nothing keys. Enable TX (the header pill).
chinese: 心跳確認已開啟，但發射已關閉 — 不會發射。請啟用發射（頂欄膠囊）。

english: Heartbeat acknowledgements are ARMED: each heartbeat heard is answered with HEARTBEAT SNR on a random free slot. Click to turn it off.
chinese: 心跳確認已就緒：每聽到一次心跳，就在隨機空閒時隙用 HEARTBEAT SNR 應答。點選關閉。

english: Heartbeat acknowledgements are on, but they answer only while heartbeat networking (HB NET) is on, as in JS8Call. HB NET sends nothing by itself.
chinese: 心跳確認已開啟，但與 JS8Call 一致，只有在心跳組網（HB NET）開啟時才會應答。HB NET 本身不傳送任何內容。

english: Heartbeat acknowledgements are on, but they answer only while AUTOREPLY is on, as in JS8Call. Turn AUTOREPLY on.
chinese: 心跳確認已開啟，但與 JS8Call 一致，只有在自動回覆開啟時才會應答。請開啟自動回覆。

english: Heartbeat acknowledgements are on, but they answer only while heartbeat networking (HB NET) and AUTOREPLY are both on, as in JS8Call. HB NET sends nothing by itself.
chinese: 心跳確認已開啟，但與 JS8Call 一致，只有心跳組網（HB NET）和自動回覆同時開啟時才會應答。HB NET 本身不傳送任何內容。

english: Two acts, where JS8Call has one: this switch is the second, the header’s TX pill is the first, and the chip reads ARMED only while both are on.
chinese: JS8Call 一步完成的事，這裡分兩步：該開關是第二步，頂欄的發射膠囊是第一步，只有兩者都開啟時才會顯示「已就緒」。

english: Not armed: nothing from you for {{min}} min, so the idle watchdog holds it. Your next send, switch, speed choice, or Read or Delete in the Inbox brings it back.
chinese: 未就緒：你已 {{min}} 分鐘無操作，空閒看門狗將其掛起。下一次傳送、切換開關、更改速率，或在收件箱中讀取/刪除，都會恢復它。

english: Would reply to {{to}} — TX is off, nothing keys: {{text}}
chinese: 本應回覆 {{to}} — 但發射已關閉，不會發射：{{text}}

english: JS8 idle watchdog: no operator activity for {{min}} min — HB, AUTOREPLY, RELAY, HB ACK and the repeating CQ are off. TX stays as you left it. Your next send, switch, speed choice, or Read or Delete in the Inbox brings back AUTOREPLY, RELAY and HB ACK as Settings has them; HB and the repeating CQ stay off until you switch them on.
chinese: JS8 空閒看門狗：操作員已 {{min}} 分鐘無操作 — HB、AUTOREPLY、RELAY、HB ACK 和迴圈 CQ 均已關閉。發射狀態保持你離開時的樣子。下一次傳送、切換開關、更改速率，或在收件箱中讀取/刪除，會按設定恢復 AUTOREPLY、RELAY 和 HB ACK；HB 和迴圈 CQ 需你手動開啟。
do_not_translate: JS8 | {{min}} | HB | AUTOREPLY | RELAY | HB ACK | CQ | TX

english: A transmission is queued for autoreply: {{text}} — would you like to send this transmission?
chinese: 有一條自動回覆的發射已排隊：{{text}} — 是否傳送？

english: Send it: it goes out in the next period, through every TX check.
chinese: 傳送：它將在下一週期發出，並透過全部發射檢查。

english: Do not send it. With no answer it is No when the count reaches 0, as in JS8Call.
chinese: 不傳送。與 JS8Call 一致，倒計時歸零仍無應答即視為「否」。

english: Queued frames — one leaves per period while TX is on. F/L mark the first and last frame of a message.
chinese: 已排隊的幀 — 發射開啟時每個週期發出一幀。F/L 標記一條訊息的首幀和末幀。

english: Drop every queued frame. Not a stop: a frame already on the air finishes — Stop TX cuts it.
chinese: 丟棄所有已排隊的幀。這不是停止：已在空中的幀仍會發完 —「停止發射」可直接切斷。

english: Idle watchdog tripped — your next send or switch brings back AUTOREPLY, RELAY and HB ACK; HB and the repeating CQ stay off until you switch them on
chinese: 空閒看門狗已觸發 — 下次傳送或切換會恢復 AUTOREPLY、RELAY 和 HB ACK；HB 和迴圈 CQ 需你手動開啟
do_not_translate: AUTOREPLY | RELAY | HB ACK | HB | CQ

english: Set your callsign in Settings before transmitting
chinese: 發射前請在設定中填寫你的呼號

english: The message could not be saved
TX locked — this frequency is outside your license privileges
chinese: 發射已鎖定 — 該頻率超出你的執照權限

english: A command needs a station — put a callsign, @ALLCALL or a group in To
chinese: 命令需要指定台站 — 請在收件框中填入呼號、@ALLCALL 或組名

english: What JS8Call shows in its RX pane: the traffic on your RX offset and what is addressed to you or your groups, each message on one line as its frames arrive, the end mark after its last frame and the missing-frame mark where one did not come. Every frame of every offset is in Band activity.
chinese: JS8Call 在其 RX 面板顯示的內容：你的接收偏移上的通訊，以及發給你的或你所在組的內容，每條訊息隨幀到達而佔一行，末幀後顯示結束標記，缺失幀處顯示缺失標記。每個偏移的所有幀都可在「波段活躍度」中檢視。

english: Listening… what is sent on your RX offset, and what is addressed to you, prints here
chinese: 監聽中… 在你接收偏移上發出的內容，以及發給你的內容，都會列印在這裡

english: One row per frequency offset in the passband, holding the frames heard there with the end mark after each message: its age, SNR, time delta and speed come from the newest. Read it to find a clear offset and to see who is in sync. Columns and order are in ⋯.
chinese: 通帶內每個頻率偏移佔一行，儲存該處收到的幀及每條訊息後的結束標記：其時齡、SNR、時間差和速率取自最新的一幀。可用它尋找空閒偏移，並檢視誰已同步。列與排序在 ⋯ 中。

english: Blocked: messages from this station are hidden in the RX pane (Settings ▸ JS8)
chinese: 已遮蔽：該台站的訊息在接收面板中隱藏（設定 ▸ JS8）
正聽到你的台站（{{since}} 前）

english: Unread message for {{group}}, in the Inbox
chinese: 發給 {{group}} 的未讀訊息，位於收件箱

english: {{name}} is not a valid callsign or group
chinese: {{name}} 不是有效的呼號或組名
清空所有 JS8 活動？

english: The RX pane, Band activity and the call list start empty and fill again as stations are heard, and the compose box is emptied, as in JS8Call. Your Inbox, your settings and the station’s own record of who it heard are kept.
chinese: 接收面板、波段活躍度和通聯清單會清空，並在聽到台站後重新填充，輸入框也會清空，與 JS8Call 一致。你的收件箱、設定以及台站自身記錄的通聯歷史都會保留。

english: The JS8 list was not saved
Put the path the message came by, MSG and [MESSAGE] in the compose box, as JS8Call does: type your message over [MESSAGE] and send it. Nothing is sent yet.
chinese: 把訊息來路、MSG 和 [MESSAGE] 填入輸入框，與 JS8Call 一致：在 [MESSAGE] 上寫出你的回覆並傳送。此時尚未傳送任何內容。

english: Delete the ticked messages (or press Delete)
chinese: 刪除已勾選的訊息（或按 Delete 鍵）
按 {{column}} 排序（再次點選反向）
選擇 {{from}} 於 {{time}} 發來的訊息

english: iPhone HEIC photos can't be read here — Nexus has no HEVC decoder. On the iPhone: Settings → Camera → Formats → Most Compatible (new photos are JPEG), or Settings → Photos → Transfer to Mac or PC → Automatic (converts on send). Then re-send this picture.
chinese: iPhone 的 HEIC 照片無法在此讀取 — Nexus 沒有 HEVC 解碼器。請在 iPhone 上操作：設定 → 相機 → 格式 → 相容性最佳（新照片即為 JPEG），或 設定 → 照片 → 傳輸到 Mac 或 PC → 自動（傳送時轉換）。然後重新傳送這張圖片。

english: That is an AVIF file. SSTV sends JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP or GIF — export or save-as one of those.
chinese: 這是 AVIF 檔案。SSTV 可傳送 JPEG、PNG、WebP、BMP 或 GIF — 請匯出或另存為其中一種。

english: That is a TIFF file. SSTV sends JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP or GIF — export or save-as one of those.
chinese: 這是 TIFF 檔案。SSTV 可傳送 JPEG、PNG、WebP、BMP 或 GIF — 請匯出或另存為其中一種。

english: That is a camera RAW file. SSTV sends JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP or GIF — export a JPEG from it first.
chinese: 這是相機 RAW 檔案。SSTV 可傳送 JPEG、PNG、WebP、BMP 或 GIF — 請先從中匯出 JPEG。

english: That is a Photoshop file. SSTV sends JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP or GIF — export or save-as one of those.
chinese: 這是 Photoshop 檔案。SSTV 可傳送 JPEG、PNG、WebP、BMP 或 GIF — 請匯出或另存為其中一種。

english: That is an SVG drawing, not a photo. SSTV sends JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP or GIF — export it as one of those.
chinese: 這是 SVG 圖形，不是照片。SSTV 可傳送 JPEG、PNG、WebP、BMP 或 GIF — 請匯出為其中一種。

english: Images on this band appear at {{freq}} {{mode}}.
The receiver is stopped — nothing is being decoded. Press Arm to start it.{{where}}
chinese: 接收機已停止 — 未在解碼。按「啟用」啟動。{{where}}

english: Listening, but no audio is reaching the decoder at all — the capture device is not delivering anything. Check that Input Device (RX) is the radio; hearing the signal on the speaker does not mean the app is capturing it.
chinese: 正在監聽，但完全沒有音訊到達解碼器 — 採集裝置沒有送出任何資料。請確認輸入裝置（接收）是電台；在揚聲器上聽到訊號並不代表應用正在採集它。

english: Receiver started — no audio has reached the decoder yet.{{where}}
chinese: 接收機已啟動 — 尚無音訊到達解碼器。{{where}}

english: Heard an SSTV header {{age}} ago in a mode this build cannot decode{{vis}}. The signal and the audio path are fine — Scottie, Martin, Robot and PD images all decode.
chinese: {{age}} 前聽到一個 SSTV 報頭，其模式本版本無法解碼{{vis}}。訊號和音訊鏈路都正常 — Scottie、Martin、Robot 和 PD 影像均可解碼。

english: {{count}} image decoded since arming, last one {{age}} ago. Listening for the next header.
chinese: 啟用以來已解碼 {{count}} 幅影像，最近一幅在 {{age}} 前。正在等待下一個報頭。

english: {{count}} images decoded since arming, last one {{age}} ago. Listening for the next header.
chinese: 啟用以來已解碼 {{count}} 幅影像，最近一幅在 {{age}} 前。正在等待下一個報頭。

english: {{count}} images decoded since arming, last one {{age}} ago. Listening for the next header.
chinese: 啟用以來已解碼 {{count}} 幅影像，最近一幅在 {{age}} 前。正在等待下一個報頭。

english: {{count}} images decoded since arming, last one {{age}} ago. Listening for the next header.
chinese: 啟用以來已解碼 {{count}} 幅影像，最近一幅在 {{age}} 前。正在等待下一個報頭。

english: Audio is arriving but it is silent. If you can hear the signal on the speaker, the app is on a different input — check Input Device (RX), and RX Gain if the level is just low.{{where}}
chinese: 音訊已到達，但內容是靜音。如果你能在揚聲器上聽到訊號，說明應用選錯了輸入 — 請檢查輸入裝置（接收），若電平只是偏低則檢查接收增益。{{where}}

english: Hearing audio, no SSTV header yet — a picture decodes automatically when one starts.{{where}}
chinese: 已收到音訊，但還沒有 SSTV 報頭 — 影像開始時會自動解碼。{{where}}

english: Cannot read the receiver state — the app is not answering. The decoder may still be running.
chinese: 無法讀取接收機狀態 — 應用沒有響應。解碼器可能仍在執行。

english: Between pictures this radio goes back to plain USB, and its data-mode filters go with it.
chinese: 影像之間，該電台會切回普通 USB，其資料模式濾波器也隨之失效。

english: Armed — any VIS header heard auto-decodes and auto-saves to the gallery (RX only). Click to disarm.
chinese: 已啟用 — 聽到任何 VIS 報頭即自動解碼並自動儲存到相簿（僅接收）。點選可停用。

english: Arm — auto-decode any VIS header heard on the receive audio (RX only, never transmits)
chinese: 啟用 — 對接收音訊中聽到的任何 VIS 報頭自動解碼（僅接收，絕不發射）

english: Could not switch the SSTV receiver
chinese: 無法切換 SSTV 接收機

english: Pick the mode, then press Start to decode a picture already on the air — for a transmission you tuned into late, or one whose header was lost. Nothing guesses the mode; this is your answer.
chinese: 先選模式，再按「開始」解碼已經在空中的影像 — 適用於你調諧較晚的發射，或報頭已丟失的情形。系統不會猜測模式，這裡由你指定。

english: Mode for a manual receive start
chinese: 手動開始接收所用的模式

english: Start decoding now in the mode chosen beside this, without waiting for a header. Arms the receiver if it is off. Receive only — this never transmits.
chinese: 立即以旁邊所選模式開始解碼，無需等待報頭。若接收機未啟用會自動啟用。僅接收 — 絕不發射。

english: Could not start the receiver in that mode
chinese: 無法以該模式啟動接收機

english: RF output power — set it against a Tune carrier, below ALC
chinese: 射頻輸出功率 — 在調諧載波下設定，保持在 ALC 以下

english: Detected SSTV mode — fills in (Martin / Scottie / Robot / PD) when the receiver hears a VIS header
chinese: 檢測到的 SSTV 模式 — 接收機聽到 VIS 報頭時會填入（Martin / Scottie / Robot / PD）

english: Showing the rig's current band — SSTV decodes wherever you're tuned
chinese: 顯示電台目前波段 — 你在哪個頻率上，SSTV 就在哪裡解碼

english: Slant trim — fine sample-clock correction. Auto-corrected by the decoder; the manual trim comes in a later build.
chinese: 傾斜校正 — 精細的取樣時鐘修正。解碼器會自動校正；手動微調將在後續版本提供。

english: SSTV slant trim (disabled — decoder not wired yet)
chinese: SSTV 傾斜校正（已禁用 — 解碼器尚未接入）

english: the band — a picture takes this space when one arrives
chinese: 波段 — 有影像到達時它會佔用此處空間

english: decoding {{mode}}… the picture lands when the transmission ends (≈{{clock}})
chinese: 正在解碼 {{mode}}… 影像將在發射結束時出現（約 {{clock}}）

english: Keyer speed — PgUp/PgDn to nudge (Shift = ±4) · on a Mac: Fn+↑/Fn+↓
chinese: 鍵控速度 — PgUp/PgDn 微調（Shift = ±4）· 在 Mac 上：Fn+↑/Fn+↓

english: CAT keyer — the rig generates CW (rig in CW). Zero extra hardware.
chinese: CAT 鍵控 — 由電台自行產生 CW（電台處於 CW 模式）。無需額外硬體。

english: Serial keyline — Nexus toggles DTR/RTS into the rig's KEY jack (rig in CW, rig shapes the signal). The clean method for rigs without CAT CW. Set the keyline port + line in Settings ▸ CW.
chinese: 串列埠鍵控線 — Nexus 透過翻轉 DTR/RTS 驅動電台的 KEY 插口（電台處於 CW 模式，波形由電台產生）。適用於不支援 CAT CW 的機型的乾淨方案。請在 設定 ▸ CW 中設定鍵控連線埠和訊號線。

english: K1EL WinKeyer — hardware keyer over serial (rig in CW). Set its port in Settings ▸ CW.
chinese: K1EL WinKeyer — 透過串列埠連線的硬體鍵控器（電台處於 CW 模式）。請在 設定 ▸ CW 中設定其連線埠。

english: Soundcard keyer — a keyed audio tone (this TAKES THE RADIO OUT OF CW, into a data mode like FT8 uses; CW mode returns when you pick another keyer). A workaround: works ONLY if Nexus's audio output is routed to the rig (like FT8) AND PTT works, and you must keep drive below ALC. WinKeyer or the serial keyline are the clean options.
chinese: 音效卡鍵控 — 以音訊音調模擬鍵控（這會讓電台離開 CW 模式，進入 FT8 所用的資料模式；換回其他鍵控方式即恢復 CW 模式）。屬於權宜方案：僅在 Nexus 的音訊輸出接到電台（如 FT8 那樣）且 PTT 可用時才有效，並且必須把驅動力保持在 ALC 以下。WinKeyer 或串列埠鍵控線才是乾淨的選擇。

chinese: 側音 / 零拍音調（Hz）— 即頻譜上的虛線標記

chinese: CW 宏方案 — 目前生效的 F 鍵組（在 設定 ▸ CW 中編輯）

english: Noise Reduction — pulls a tone out of broadband hiss (RX, DSP)
chinese: 降噪 — 從寬頻嘶聲中提取音調（接收，DSP）

chinese: 自動陷波（ANF）— 抑制競爭載波（接收，DSP）

chinese: 降噪深度 — 提高到噪底下降為止，若音調變得發飄則回撥

english: AGC time constant — Fast for CW/pileups, Slow for steady copy

chinese: 副接收機的靜噪。由 Nexus 設定；電台不會回報該值。

english: Not confirmed for the sub receiver: {{plates}}
Set from Nexus — the radio does not report the sub receiver’s levels back.
chinese: 已由 Nexus 設定 — 電台不會回報副接收機的電平。

english: Nexus could not set the sub receiver’s {{plate}}.
chinese: Nexus 無法設定副接收機的 {{plate}}。

english: Nexus could not set the monitor level.
chinese: Nexus 無法設定監聽音量。

english: Receiver chain — what you are hearing
chinese: 接收鏈路 — 你正在聽的內容

english: Transmitter chain — how your voice goes out
chinese: 發射鏈路 — 你的聲音如何送出

english: The input pad, in decibels — the front-end attenuator this radio publishes. Use it when a strong neighbour is pumping the AGC; it costs you weak signals too.
chinese: 輸入衰減，單位分貝 — 該電台公佈的前端衰減器。當強鄰台壓制 AGC 時使用；但它同樣會犧牲弱訊號。

english: The receive preamp, by the name this radio gives each position — on some rigs they are numbered rather than decibels. Worth it on a quiet band; on a noisy one it lifts the noise with the signal.
chinese: 接收前置放大器，按該電台為各檔給出的名稱顯示 — 有些機型用編號而非分貝。安靜波段值得開啟；雜訊大的波段會連雜訊一起放大。

english: How loud the radio plays your own voice back while you are transmitting. It is heard only on transmit, so turning it down can never silence a decoder — that is AF.
chinese: 發射時電台回放你自己聲音的音量。它只在發射時能聽到，因此調低絕不會讓解碼器靜音 — 那屬於音訊增益。

english: Transmit contract — what goes out when you key
chinese: 發射實況 — 你按鍵時真正發出的內容

english: The frequency your next over will actually be emitted on — the engine’s own answer, with any confirmed split and any XIT offset already in it. Under split this is NOT your receive dial.
chinese: 你下一次發段實際發射的頻率 — 由引擎自身給出，已計入確認的異頻和 XIT 偏移。異頻狀態下，這並非你的接收頻率。

english: Nexus worked this frequency out from what it commanded and cannot confirm all of it against the radio — either there is no CAT link, or XIT is in play and the clarifier is write-only, so an offset dialled at the radio would not show here.
chinese: Nexus 根據其下發的指令推算出該頻率，無法全部與電台核對 — 或者沒有 CAT 鏈路，或者啟用了 XIT 且 clarifier 只寫不讀，因此在電台上擰出的偏移不會顯示在這裡。

english: This station is not reporting a transmit frequency. Nexus will not print your receive dial in its place — under split they are unrelated numbers.
chinese: 該台站未報告發射頻率。Nexus 不會用你的接收頻率頂替 — 異頻狀態下二者是無關的數字。

english: Nexus cannot state your transmit frequency on FM through a repeater — the shift is applied by the radio and is not in the frequency the engine reports, so printing one here would be your listening frequency wearing a transmit label. Check the shift in Settings ▸ Radio, or read it off the radio.
chinese: 在 FM 中繼場景下，Nexus 無法給出你的發射頻率 — 頻移由電台施加，不在引擎報告的頻率中，因此在此列印只會是貼著發射標籤的接收頻率。請在 設定 ▸ 電台 中核對頻移，或直接在電台上檢視。

english: The mode your next over goes out in, and where Nexus got it. This is the same read-back the logbook writes, so what you see here and what gets recorded cannot disagree.
chinese: 你下一次發段所用的模式，以及 Nexus 的來源。這與日誌寫入的是同一次回讀，因此此處所見與記錄內容不會矛盾。

english: How far your transmit frequency sits from your receive dial (kHz)
chinese: 你的發射頻率相對接收頻率的偏移（kHz）

english: Nexus asked the radio for this split. The snapshot does not carry the radio’s own confirmation, so it is shown as commanded rather than read back — check the radio if the pile-up is not hearing you where you expect.
chinese: Nexus 向電台請求了該異頻。快照不包含電台自身的確認，因此這裡顯示的是下發值而非回讀值 — 若堆積中對方聽不到你，請在電台上核對。

english: Transmit incremental tuning — the offset added to your transmit frequency (Hz)
chinese: 發射微調 — 疊加到發射頻率上的偏移（Hz）

english: Nexus cannot read XIT back from any radio, so this is what Nexus commanded — not necessarily where the transmitter is. An offset set on the radio’s own clarifier knob will not appear here.
chinese: Nexus 無法從任何電台讀回 XIT，因此這裡顯示的是 Nexus 下發的值 — 未必是發射機的實際位置。在電台自身 clarifier 旋鈕上設定的偏移不會出現在這裡。

english: Your power setting, and the output the radio last actually measured. No mark: the setting is the radio’s read-back when CAT reports one and the last commanded value otherwise, and nothing says which.
chinese: 你的功率設定，以及電台最近一次實際測得的輸出。無標記時：若 CAT 有回報則為電台回讀值，否則為最後一次下發值，且無法區分是哪種。

english: VOX is on — the radio keys itself from the mic. Stop TX cannot unkey a VOX-held transmitter.
chinese: VOX 已開啟 — 電台由話筒自行觸發。對 VOX 保持的發射，「停止發射」無法解除。

english: As commanded — this radio does not report {{plate}} back over CAT, so this is what Nexus last sent.
chinese: 以下發值為準 — 該電台不會透過 CAT 回報 {{plate}}，因此這裡顯示的是 Nexus 最後下發的值。

english: AUTO — sideband by band (now {{sideband}}); a band change re-asserts this
chinese: 自動 — 按波段選擇邊帶（目前 {{sideband}}）；換波段會重新套用
60 m 波段僅允許 USB 語音

english: Flex native DAX audio is on, so the radio takes transmit audio from DAX and your microphone is disconnected — on every slice and in every program, SmartSDR included. Turn OFF Flex native DAX audio in Settings ▸ Radio ▸ Rig & CAT to use the mic.
chinese: 已開啟 Flex 原生 DAX 音訊，因此電台從 DAX 取發射音訊，你的話筒已斷開 — 對所有 slice 和所有程式生效，SmartSDR 也不例外。要使用話筒，請在 設定 ▸ 電台 ▸ 電台與 CAT 中關閉 Flex 原生 DAX 音訊。

english: Your rig is on {{rigMode}}, but Phone is set to {{mode}}. TX uses {{mode}} — turn the rig's mode knob (or re-pick the band) to match.
chinese: 你的電台處於 {{rigMode}}，但電話模式設為 {{mode}}。發射使用 {{mode}} — 請把電台的模式旋鈕轉過去（或重新選擇波段）以保持一致。

english: Split ON — TX {{freq}} MHz. Click for simplex.
chinese: 異頻已開 — 發射 {{freq}} MHz。點選切換到同頻。

english: Work split — TX off your RX frequency (e.g. up 5)
chinese: 異頻通聯 — 發射偏離接收頻率（例如上差 5）

english: TX offset from your RX dial (kHz)
chinese: 發射相對接收頻率的偏移（kHz）

english: No CAT link — set a rigctld/CAT rig in Settings so the app can switch the mode and follow the dial. On VOX/RTS-DTR PTT the rig has no command channel.
chinese: 無 CAT 鏈路 — 請在設定中配置 rigctld/CAT 電台，應用才能切換模式並跟隨頻率。使用 VOX/RTS-DTR PTT 時，電台沒有命令通道。

english: Microphone gain — raise it until SSB peaks tickle the ALC zone
chinese: 話筒增益 — 提高到 SSB 峰值剛觸及 ALC 區間

english: AF gain — the radio's own volume. If your soundcard is fed from the rig's speaker or headphone jack, this also sets the level the decoder hears, so turning it right down stops FT8, RTTY and PSK as well as the speaker. A rig with its own USB audio, or a fixed-level ACC/DATA jack, is not affected.
chinese: 音訊增益 — 電台自身音量。若你的音效卡取自電台揚聲器或耳機口，它也會決定解碼器聽到的電平，因此把它調到很低會同時停掉 FT8、RTTY、PSK 和揚聲器輸出。自帶 USB 音訊、或使用固定電平 ACC/DATA 介面的電台不受影響。
do_not_translate: DATA | RTTY | ACC | FT8 | PSK | USB | AF

english: AF is almost fully down. If the decoder listens through the rig’s speaker or headphone jack it has gone quiet too. Raise AF, or feed the soundcard from the USB codec or the rear ACC/DATA jack, which are not affected by this control.
chinese: 音訊增益幾乎調到最低。若解碼器透過電台揚聲器或耳機口收聽，它也已靜音。請提高音訊增益，或改用 USB 編解碼器或後部 ACC/DATA 介面供音效卡，這些不受此控制元件影響。

english: RF gain — the receiver front end, not transmit power. Back it off on a loud band to lift a signal out of the noise the AGC is riding on.
chinese: 射頻增益 — 控制接收前端，不是發射功率。在強訊號波段上把它調低，可把訊號從 AGC 正在壓著的雜訊中提出來。

english: Squelch — the level a signal must reach before you hear it. Normal on FM; on SSB, CW and the data modes leave it fully open, because a closed squelch mutes the audio the decoder listens to on most radios, including the USB feed.
chinese: 靜噪 — 訊號需達到的電平門檻。FM 下正常使用；在 SSB、CW 和資料模式下請完全開啟，因為多數電台（包括 USB 音訊通路）靜噪關閉時會同時靜音解碼器所聽的音訊。

english: The squelch is up outside FM. On most radios that mutes the audio the decoder hears as well as the speaker, so nothing will decode until a signal breaks it. Wind it fully down for SSB, CW and the data modes.
chinese: 在 FM 之外的模式下靜噪仍開著。多數電台此時會連同解碼器所聽的音訊一起靜音，因此在有訊號打破靜噪之前什麼都解不出來。SSB、CW 和資料模式下請把它完全關到底。
接收濾波器 / 通頻寬度（CAT）

english: Record the received audio to a WAV in the recordings folder
chinese: 把接收音訊錄成 WAV 存到錄音資料夾

english: Recording — click to stop recording this QSO
chinese: 正在錄音 — 點選停止錄製本次 QSO

english: TX locked — this frequency/mode is outside your license privileges
chinese: 發射已鎖定 — 該頻率/模式超出你的執照權限

english: TX locked — 60 m allows only USB phone. Pick USB or AUTO.
chinese: 發射已鎖定 — 60 m 僅允許 USB 語音。請選擇 USB 或「自動」。

english: TX was off — turned it back on. Press PTT again to talk.
chinese: 發射原本關閉 — 已重新開啟。請再次按 PTT 講話。

english: Lock (hands-free PTT) does not work over Remote. Untick Lock, then hold PTT or the Space bar to talk.
chinese: 「鎖定」（免手 PTT）在遠端模式下不可用。請取消勾選「鎖定」，然後按住 PTT 或空格鍵講話。

english: Still talking? Lock ends in {{seconds}} s.
chinese: 還在說嗎？鎖定將在 {{seconds}} 秒後結束。

english: Not keyed: a clock repair is running, and nothing starts transmitting until it finishes (two minutes at most).
chinese: 未發射：時鐘校正正在進行，完成前不會啟動任何發射（最多兩分鐘）。

english: Scroll here to tune the VFO
chinese: 在此捲動即可調節 VFO

english: Sweep width on the RADIO — the app draws what it reports back
chinese: 在電台上設定的掃寬 — 應用只繪製電台回報的內容

english: Where the sweep sits. FIX is derived from the band edge — the CAT protocol does not report the radio's own FIX window, so check it against the rig's scale.
chinese: 掃寬所處位置。FIX 由波段邊緣推算 — CAT 協議不回報電台自身的 FIX 視窗，請對照電台刻度核對。

english: Native RF panadapter — the real RF spectrum around your dial, not the demodulated audio passband.
chinese: 原生射頻全景 — 你頻率周邊的真實射頻頻譜，而非解調後的音訊通帶。

english: Receiver AUDIO spectrum on your rig’s axis: the centre line is your dial, and the passband sits on the side your sideband is on (USB above, LSB below) — the other half is quiet because an SSB receiver only hears one side. Not a band-wide RF panadapter, so a voice fills the passband rather than sliding across it as you tune.
chinese: 接收音訊頻譜，以電台座標顯示：中線是你的頻率，通帶位於你所用邊帶的一側（USB 在上，LSB 在下）— 另一半是安靜的，因為 SSB 接收機只接收一側。它不是全波段射頻全景，因此人聲會填滿通帶，而不是隨調諧在螢幕上滑過。

english: Follows the radio's filter — the scope shows what the rig can pass
chinese: 跟隨電台濾波器 — 頻譜只顯示電台能透過的部分

english: The whole captured passband — {{khz}} kHz of sideband from your dial
chinese: 整個採集通帶 — 你頻率一側 {{khz}} kHz 邊帶

english: Voice energy — {{khz}} kHz of sideband from your dial
chinese: 語音能量範圍 — 你頻率一側 {{khz}} kHz 邊帶

english: Zoomed — {{khz}} kHz of sideband from your dial
chinese: 縮放 — 你頻率一側 {{khz}} kHz 邊帶

english: Tight — {{hz}} Hz of sideband from your dial, for fine tuning
chinese: 精細 — 你頻率一側 {{hz}} Hz 邊帶，用於精細調諧

english: The rig's whole scope sweep (set the width on the radio)
chinese: 電台完整掃寬（寬度需在電台上設定）

english: The band you're tuned to, edge to edge with a little margin, at the finest resolution your scope can give it
chinese: 你目前調到的波段，從一端到另一端並留少量餘量，以頻譜能給出的最高解析度顯示

english: Your scope sweeps only part of this band
chinese: 你的頻譜只掃過該波段的一部分

english: These command the radio's own scope, not just the on-screen zoom
chinese: 這些控制元件操作的是電台自身的頻譜，而不只是螢幕上的縮放

english: Set the radio's scope span to {{span}}
Scope reference level — lower to lift weak signals out of the noise
chinese: 頻譜參考電平 — 調低可把弱訊號從雜訊中提出來

english: These command the FlexRadio's real SmartSDR panadapter, not just the on-screen zoom
chinese: 這些控制元件操作的是 FlexRadio 真實的 SmartSDR 全景，而不只是螢幕上的縮放

english: Set the Flex panadapter bandwidth to {{span}}
chinese: 把 Flex 全景頻寬設為 {{span}}

english: Panadapter reference level (dBm) — lower to lift weak signals out of the noise
chinese: 全景參考電平（dBm）— 調低可把弱訊號從雜訊中提出來
雜訊抑制 — 消除脈衝/點火雜訊（接收）

english: Noise Reduction — pulls voice out of broadband hiss (RX, DSP)
chinese: 降噪 — 從寬頻嘶聲中提取人聲（接收，DSP）
自動陷波（ANF）— 抑制載波/差拍嘯叫（接收，DSP）

english: Speech Compressor — more average talk power (TX)
chinese: 語音壓縮 — 提高平均話音功率（發射）

english: Manual notch — the one you place yourself on a whistle, using the notch frequency slider. Distinct from Auto notch, which hunts a carrier automatically.
chinese: 手動陷波 — 用陷波頻率滑桿自己對準嘯叫聲放置的那個。與自動陷波不同，後者會自動搜尋載波。
聲控發射 — 免手鍵控（發射）

english: Noise-reduction depth — raise until the noise floor drops, back off if audio gets watery
chinese: 降噪深度 — 提高到噪底下降為止，若聲音變得發飄則回撥

english: Speech processor depth — how hard the compressor works. Raise it for punch on a weak path; too much sounds harsh and splatters.
chinese: 語音處理深度 — 壓縮器的工作強度。弱路徑上提高可獲得穿透力；過量則聲音發硬併產生雜散。

english: Manual notch frequency — slide it onto the whistle you want gone. This is the notch you place yourself, not the automatic one.
chinese: 手動陷波頻率 — 把它滑到你想消除的嘯叫聲上。這是你自己放置的陷波，不是自動那個。

english: click a slot or press its F-key to send · Esc stops
chinese: 點選某個槽位或按對應 F 鍵傳送 · Esc 停止

english: click a slot or press Fn with its F-key to send · Esc stops
chinese: 點選某個槽位或按 Fn + 對應 F 鍵傳送 · Esc 停止

english: Contest: record a slot with your exchange “{{exchange}}” for one-key sends.
chinese: 競賽：把交換資訊 「{{exchange}}」 錄進一個槽位，即可一鍵傳送。

english: Flex radios transmit from their own mic in SSB unless DAX is on for voice. In SmartSDR's P/CW panel, turn on DAX so Nexus's voice messages go out.
chinese: 除非為語音開啟 DAX，否則 Flex 電台在 SSB 下使用自帶話筒發射。請在 SmartSDR 的 P/CW 面板中開啟 DAX，Nexus 的語音訊息才能發出。

english: Record F{{slot}}. Records from your INPUT DEVICE — often the rig's RX audio, not a mic. If it is, record the message elsewhere and use Import (⤓).
chinese: 錄製 F{{slot}}。錄音來自你的輸入裝置 — 往往不是話筒，而是電台接收音訊。若確實如此，請在別處錄好訊息再用「匯入」（⤓）。

english: F{{slot}} has no recording yet — record or import one
chinese: F{{slot}} 還沒有錄音 — 請錄製或匯入

english: Release PTT before sending a voice message
chinese: 傳送語音訊息前請先鬆開 PTT

english: TX is off — click PTT once to turn it back on, then play the message
chinese: 發射已關閉 — 請先點一次 PTT 重新開啟，然後再播放訊息

english: F{{slot}} was on the air — the voice keyer closed and stopped it
chinese: F{{slot}} 正在播出 — 語音鍵控已關閉並停止播放

english: Recording for F{{slot}} discarded — the voice keyer closed
chinese: F{{slot}} 的錄音已丟棄 — 語音鍵控已關閉

english: Could not stop the recorder for F{{slot}} — it may still be running. Reopen the voice keyer.
chinese: 無法停止 F{{slot}} 的錄音器 — 它可能仍在執行。請重新開啟語音鍵控。
TempoDeep — 穩健弱訊號檔（15 秒）

english: TX drive (Pwr) — trim down until your rig's ALC is just zero
chinese: 發射驅動力（Pwr）— 逐步調低，直到電台 ALC 剛好為零

english: Start a CQ run — keep calling CQ every idle TX slot until someone answers
chinese: 開始迴圈 CQ — 在每個空閒發射時隙持續呼叫 CQ，直到有人應答

english: CQ run paused (you are in a conversation) — click to stop the run
chinese: 迴圈 CQ 已暫停（你正在對話中）— 點選可停止迴圈

english: Calling CQ every idle TX slot — click to stop
chinese: 正在每個空閒發射時隙呼叫 CQ — 點選停止

english: Resume calling CQ now (it auto-resumes after the conversation goes quiet)
chinese: 立即恢復呼叫 CQ（對話安靜下來後也會自動恢復）

english: Your radio does not report {{meter}} over CAT — the bar stays empty.
chinese: 你的電台不透過 CAT 回報 {{meter}} — 該條形圖將保持空白。

english: the centre of {{country}}: no grid known for them

chinese: 旋轉器指向真方位 {{deg}}° · 磁方位 {{mag}}°（WMM）

english: Point the antenna at {{call}} the long way round (reciprocal heading)
chinese: 把天線按長路徑指向 {{call}}（反向方位）

english: Stop rotation NOW (mid-pass: stops the satellite track too)
chinese: 立即停止轉動（過境中：也會停止衛星跟蹤）

english: A satellite transponder holds the dial
chinese: 某個衛星轉發器佔用著頻率

english: {{bird}} holds the dial — picked in Satellites; the dial stays on the bird through section changes. ■ releases the hold and hands the dial back
chinese: {{bird}} 佔用著頻率 — 在衛星模組中選定；切換模組時頻率仍停留在該衛星上。■ 可解除佔用並交還頻率

english: {{bird}} holds the dial — picked in Satellites; the dial stays on the bird through section changes. Release it there or with the strip's ■
chinese: {{bird}} 佔用著頻率 — 在衛星模組中選定；切換模組時頻率仍停留在該衛星上。可在那裡或用本條的 ■ 解除

english: Release the transponder NOW — the dial is yours again
chinese: 立即解除轉發器佔用 — 頻率重新歸你掌握
衛星多普勒佔用著頻率

english: Satellite Doppler owns the TX VFO
chinese: 衛星多普勒佔用著發射 VFO

english: Satellite Doppler is {{what}} for {{bird}} ({{state}}) — ■ stops the track and hands the dial back
chinese: 衛星多普勒正為 {{bird}} {{what}}（{{state}}）— ■ 停止跟蹤並交還頻率

english: Satellite Doppler is {{what}} for {{bird}} ({{state}}) — ■ stops the track and releases the split

english: Not while you are transmitting. Changing band or mode on a keyed amplifier can damage it.

chinese: 相對地平線的仰角 · 該旋轉器可達 {{min}}–{{max}}°

該旋轉器的仰角範圍為 {{min}}–{{max}}°

english: Operate your station from an approved browser. The shack PC keeps the radio and stays in charge: what you click and type here goes to the station, and this page shows what the station reports back.
chinese: 在已批准的瀏覽器中操作你的台站。台站電腦持有電台並保持掌控：你在此點選和輸入的內容會傳送到台站，本頁顯示台站回報的狀態。

english: Operate your station from any browser you approve, while the radio stays at the shack.
chinese: 在任何你批准的瀏覽器中操作台站，而電台仍留在台站機房。

english: New here? Create an account, then enter the six-digit code we email you. After that you are signed in.
chinese: 第一次來？建立一個帳戶，然後輸入我們郵件發給你的六位驗證碼。之後即完成登入。

english: Free during the beta. Paid plans for use over the internet come later.
chinese: 測試期間免費。透過網際網路使用的付費方案稍後推出。

english: In Nexus at the shack, open Settings → Remote. Press “Sign in to Nexus Remote” and sign in, or make an account.
chinese: 在台站電腦的 Nexus 中開啟 設定 → 遠端。按「登入 Nexus Remote」並登入，或建立一個帳戶。

english: Press “Turn on Remote”, then turn on “Stream this station from my browser”.
chinese: 按「開啟遠端」，然後開啟「從我的瀏覽器串流該台站」。

english: Sign in on this page with the same account. Your station is listed here. Press Stream.
chinese: 在本頁用同一帳戶登入。你的台站會列在此處。按「串流」。

english: To transmit from here, approve this browser at the shack, under Remote access. Approve it only if the key there matches the one this page shows.
chinese: 要從此處發射，需在台站的「遠端訪問」中批准此瀏覽器。僅當那裡的金鑰與本頁顯示的一致時才批准。

english: Stream shows the shack’s Nexus window. Click and type over it as you would at the shack.
chinese: 串流會顯示台站上的 Nexus 視窗。可像在台站現場一樣在其上點選和輸入。

english: Listen plays the receive audio. In Phone, turn on the microphone and hold PTT to talk.
chinese: 「收聽」會播放接收音訊。在電話模式下，開啟話筒並按住 PTT 講話。

english: In a phone’s browser, {{stop}} and a large PTT sit within reach of your thumb.
chinese: 在手機瀏覽器中，{{stop}} 和大號 PTT 都在拇指可及範圍內。

english: Streaming needs Nexus on Windows at the shack.
chinese: 串流需要台站上的 Nexus 執行在 Windows。

english: No phone apps yet. Use your phone’s web browser.
chinese: 暫無手機應用。請使用手機的網頁瀏覽器。

english: After 15 minutes with no click, key or PTT, the page asks “Still there?” and ends the stream a minute later.
chinese: 15 分鐘無點選、按鍵或 PTT 後，頁面會詢問「還在嗎？」，一分鐘後再結束串流。

english: Nexus at the shack decides who can transmit. Approving and pairing happen there and nowhere else.
chinese: 由台站上的 Nexus 決定誰可以發射。批准與配對只在那裡進行。

english: A browser that signs in over the internet cannot transmit until you approve it at the shack.
chinese: 透過網際網路登入的瀏覽器，在你於台站批准之前無法發射。

english: {{stop}} stays on screen and is never held. Esc over the stream stops a transmission too.
chinese: {{stop}} 始終顯示在螢幕且需按住，絕不會被固定。在串流上按 Esc 也能停止發射。

english: If this browser’s connection drops, the station stops transmitting within 5 seconds.
chinese: 若此瀏覽器的連線中斷，台站會在 5 秒內停止發射。

english: Nexus at the shack checks the licence class set there, whoever is operating.
chinese: 無論誰在操作，台站上的 Nexus 都會檢查那裡設定的執照等級。

english: Email <mail>{{email}}</mail>, or ask in the <chat>Discord beta channel</chat>. Say what you saw, what rig, and whether you were in a browser or on a second PC.
chinese: 發郵件至 <mail>{{email}}</mail>，或在 <chat>Discord 測試頻道</chat> 提問。請說明你看到的現象、使用的機型，以及你是在瀏覽器還是另一台電腦上操作。

english: Attach {{file}} from the shack PC. On Windows it is in {{folder}}.
chinese: 附上台站電腦上的 {{file}}。在 Windows 上它位於 {{folder}}。
瞭解 Nexus Remote 的更多內容

english: In Nexus at the shack, open Settings → Remote.
chinese: 在台站電腦的 Nexus 中開啟 設定 → 遠端。

english: Press “Sign in to Nexus Remote” and sign in with this same account.
chinese: 按「登入 Nexus Remote」，並用同一帳戶登入。

english: Press “Turn on Remote”, and turn on “Stream this station from my browser”.
chinese: 按「開啟遠端」，並開啟「從我的瀏覽器串流該台站」。

english: Your station appears here a few seconds later.
chinese: 幾秒後你的台站會出現在這裡。

english: The Remote service has not been configured yet.

Approving a browser gives it station controls: supported receiver, radio and amplifier controls, and Stop TX, which stops any transmission at the station. With streaming on, they also let it stream this window and use Nexus as you would here, transmit included. To limit a browser, revoke them here, which also ends its stream.
chinese: 批准瀏覽器即授予其台站控制權：受支援的接收機、電台與功放控制元件，以及「停止發射」，可在台站立即停止任何發射。開啟串流後，還可串流此視窗並像在本地一樣使用 Nexus，包括發射。若要限制某個瀏覽器，在此撤銷授權即可，其串流也會隨之結束。

english: End remote control: everyone off until Remote is turned on again
chinese: 結束遠端控制：在再次開啟遠端之前，所有人都會被斷開

english: The request could not be completed. Check the connection and your service access, then try again.
chinese: 請求未能完成。請檢查連線與服務權限，然後重試。

english: Match this account ID on both screens:
chinese: 請在兩處核對並確認該帳戶 ID 一致：

english: Your account is ready. Sign your station in from the shack to start.
chinese: 你的帳戶已就緒。請從台站登入你的電台以開始。

english: Trial access is running. Days remaining: {{days}}. Started {{from}}, ends {{until}} UTC.
chinese: 試用訪問進行中。剩餘天數：{{days}}。開始於 {{from}}，結束於 UTC {{until}}。

english: Free during the beta. Paid plans for use over the internet come later.
chinese: 測試期間免費。透過網際網路使用的付費方案稍後推出。

english: Trial access is running until {{until}} UTC. This account predates the trial clock, so its start date is not recorded.
chinese: 試用訪問將持續到 UTC {{until}}。該帳戶早於試用計時機制，因此未記錄開始日期。

english: Your trial ended {{until}} UTC. Nothing at your station has changed — Nexus on your PC is unaffected.
chinese: 你的試用已於 UTC {{until}} 結束。台站上的任何內容都未改變 — 你電腦上的 Nexus 不受影響。

english: Attach “{{station}}” to your account? Approving at the radio starts your 14-day trial, and it can only be started once.
chinese: 把「{{station}}」關聯到你的帳戶？在電台側批准後將開始你的 14 天試用，且試用只能開始一次。

english: Attach “{{station}}” to your account? Remote is free during the beta.
chinese: 把「{{station}}」關聯到你的帳戶？測試期間遠端功能免費。

english: Only continue if this code came from your own copy of Nexus. A code somebody sent you attaches their station, not yours.
chinese: 僅當此驗證碼來自你自己的 Nexus 副本時才繼續。別人發給你的驗證碼關聯的是他們的台站，不是你的。

english: Service access for this account has been switched off. This is not the same as the trial running out.
chinese: 該帳戶的服務訪問已被關閉。這與試用到期不是一回事。

english: Remote on the shack's own network stays free: Stream and Listen work when this device is on the same network as the station.
chinese: 台站區域網內的遠端功能始終免費：當本裝置與台站在同一網路時，串流和收聽均可用。

english: Ask about access in the beta channel
chinese: 在測試頻道諮詢訪問權限

english: The plan renews every month or every year, as you choose, at the price shown at checkout, until you cancel. Cancel any time with Manage subscription: the plan ends at the end of the period paid for, and nothing more is charged.
chinese: 方案將按你選擇的週期（每月或每年）續訂，價格以結帳時顯示為準，直至你取消。可隨時透過「管理訂閱」取消：方案在已付費週期結束時終止，不再收取費用。

english: Subscribing now keeps the rest of your trial: the first payment is taken when the trial ends.
chinese: 現在訂閱會保留試用期的剩餘時間：首次付款將在試用結束時扣取。

english: Your trial has less than 48 hours left, so subscribing now takes the first payment at once and the plan starts now.
chinese: 你的試用期不足 48 小時，因此現在訂閱會立即扣除首次款項，方案即刻開始。

english: Change plan, change the card, read invoices or cancel, on the payment provider's page.
chinese: 在支付服務商的頁面上更改方案、更換銀行卡、檢視發票或取消。

english: This account already has a subscription. Use Manage subscription to change it.
chinese: 該帳戶已有訂閱。請用「管理訂閱」進行更改。

english: This account has no subscription to manage yet.
chinese: 該帳戶尚無訂閱可管理。

english: Download a copy of what Nexus Remote holds about your account: your trial and plan, your stations, their devices and your invitations, as a JSON file.
chinese: 以 JSON 檔案下載 Nexus Remote 持有的帳戶相關資料副本：你的試用與方案、你的台站及其裝置，以及你的邀請。

english: Deleting your account removes it, your stations with their devices and the invitations made there, and your devices at other people's stations. Every one of them is disconnected at once, and people you invited lose access. Nexus at your shack keeps working.
chinese: 刪除帳戶會移除帳戶本身、你的台站及其裝置和在那裡發出的邀請，以及你在他人台站上的裝置。它們會立即全部斷開，你邀請的人也會失去訪問權限。你台站上的 Nexus 仍可正常使用。

english: We keep only what stops a second free trial (fingerprints of your address, callsign and shack computer, and your trial dates) and the billing records the law requires.
chinese: 我們僅保留用於阻止二次免費試用的資訊（你地址、呼號與台站電腦的指紋，以及試用日期）和法律要求的帳單記錄。

english: Deleting your account cancels your subscription at once: access ends now and the unused part of the period is not refunded. If you are within 14 days of your first payment, ask for your refund before you delete.
chinese: 刪除帳戶會立即取消你的訂閱：訪問即刻終止，未使用部分不予退款。若你在首次付款後 14 天內，請在刪除前申請退款。

english: Your subscription could not be cancelled, so nothing was deleted. Try again in a few minutes.
chinese: 訂閱未能取消，因此未刪除任何內容。請幾分鐘後重試。

english: This account already has two stations. Revoke one you are not using before pairing another.
chinese: 該帳戶已有兩個台站。請先復原一個不用的台站，再配對其他台站。

english: That pairing code has expired or has already been used. Get a fresh one from Nexus at the shack.
chinese: 該配對碼已過期或已被使用。請從台站上的 Nexus 獲取新的配對碼。

english: A pairing code is sixteen characters, digits 0-9 and letters a-f only. Check for a letter O where a zero should be.
chinese: 配對碼為十六個字元，僅含數字 0-9 和字母 a-f。請檢查是否把數字零誤寫成了字母 O。

english: This station already has as many approved browsers as it allows. Forget one you no longer use, then try again.
chinese: 該台站已達批准的瀏覽器數量上限。請忘記一個不再使用的瀏覽器後重試。

english: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again to carry on.
chinese: 登入狀態已過期。請重新登入以繼續。

english: Sign-in was refused. If you have just created an account, confirm your email with the code or link we sent, then sign in again.
chinese: 登入被拒絕。若你剛建立帳戶，請用我們傳送的驗證碼或連結確認信箱後再登入。

english: Your sign-up worked, but the email address is not confirmed yet. Enter the six-digit code we emailed you on the sign-up screen, or if you received a link, click it. Then come back here and continue. If you land back on this page, the email is not confirmed yet.
chinese: 註冊成功，但信箱地址尚未確認。請在註冊頁面輸入我們郵件傳送的六位驗證碼，若收到的是連結則點選它。然後回到此處繼續。若你又回到本頁，說明信箱尚未確認。

english: Nothing after a few minutes? Check your spam or junk folder for an email from Nexus Remote. A code works for fifteen minutes, and a link for five days.
chinese: 幾分鐘後仍無郵件？請檢查垃圾郵件資料夾中來自 Nexus Remote 的郵件。驗證碼有效期十五分鐘，連結有效期五天。
我已確認信箱 — 繼續

english: This email address already has a Remote trial running under a different sign-in, such as Google instead of a password. Sign out, then sign in the way you did the first time.
chinese: 該信箱地址已在另一種登入方式（例如 Google 而非密碼）下執行了遠端試用。請退出登入，然後用首次登入時的方式重新登入。

english: Too many tries. Wait up to ten minutes, then try again.
chinese: 嘗試次數過多。請等待最多十分鐘後重試。

english: That station is not reachable. Check that Nexus is running at the shack, that Remote is on there (Settings → Remote), and that the computer is awake and online.
chinese: 無法連線該台站。請確認台站上的 Nexus 正在執行、遠端已在那裡開啟（設定 → 遠端），並且電腦處於喚醒且聯網狀態。

english: Remote access to this station ended, so this browser was disconnected. Check your trial and your stations below.
chinese: 對該台站的遠端訪問已結束，因此此瀏覽器被斷開。請在下方檢視你的試用狀態與台站。
