english: Remote access to this station ended, so this browser was disconnected. Check your stations below.
chinese: 對該台站的遠端訪問已結束，因此此瀏覽器被斷開。請在下方檢視你的台站。

english: Each station approves its browsers separately, so this browser needs approving for this station too.
chinese: 每個台站分別批准其瀏覽器，因此此瀏覽器也需要為該台站單獨批准。

english: Signing out keeps this browser approved. On a shared computer, press “Remove this browser’s approval” for each station before you sign out.
chinese: 退出登入不會取消此瀏覽器的批准。在共用電腦上，請在退出前為每個台站按「移除此瀏覽器的批准」。

english: This browser is approved until {{until}} UTC.
chinese: 此瀏覽器已獲批准，有效期至 UTC {{until}}。

english: This browser is approved until you remove it in Nexus at the shack.
chinese: 此瀏覽器已獲批准，直到你在台站上的 Nexus 中移除它。

english: This browser is approved until {{until}} UTC. Using the station from here keeps it approved, up to {{limit}} UTC.
chinese: 此瀏覽器已獲批准，有效期至 UTC {{until}}。從此處使用台站會持續延長批准，最長至 UTC {{limit}}。

english: This browser’s approval ends {{until}} UTC. To keep using it, approve it again in Nexus at the shack.
chinese: 此瀏覽器的批准將於 UTC {{until}} 結束。要繼續使用，請在台站上的 Nexus 中重新批准。

english: This station’s key has changed: the Remote service now lists a different key for it than the one this browser kept. Nothing connects until you accept the new key. Compare it with “This station’s key” in Nexus at the shack, and accept it only if they match.
chinese: 此台站的金鑰已變更：遠端服務現在為其列出的金鑰與此瀏覽器儲存的不一致。在你接受新金鑰之前不會建立連線。請與台站 Nexus 中的「此台站的金鑰」比對，僅在一致時接受。

english: Revoking access disconnects this station and removes the approval of every browser that used it. To use it again, pair it again at the shack and approve your browsers there again.
chinese: 復原訪問會斷開該台站，並移除所有曾使用它的瀏覽器的批准。若要再次使用，需在台站重新配對並重新批准你的瀏覽器。

english: In Nexus at the shack, open Settings → Remote and press “Pair a station”. Enter the code shown there.
chinese: 在台站電腦的 Nexus 中開啟 設定 → 遠端 並按「配對其他台站」。輸入那裡顯示的驗證碼。

english: "{{station}}" is linked to your account and waiting for approval in Nexus at the shack. Match the account ID there and approve it. The code is good for about {{minutes}} more minutes.
chinese: 「{{station}}」已關聯到你的帳戶，正在等待台站上的 Nexus 批准。請在那裡核對帳戶 ID 並批准。該驗證碼還可使用約 {{minutes}} 分鐘。

english: Pair this station with your Remote account. Approving the pairing turns Remote on and approves the browser you paired from; approve any other browser here. While Remote is on, approved browsers receive your station, contact, radio and amplifier data.
chinese: 將此台站與你的遠端帳戶配對。批准配對會開啟遠端，並批准你發起配對的瀏覽器；其他瀏覽器請在此單獨批准。遠端開啟期間，已批准的瀏覽器會接收你的台站、聯絡、電台與功放資料。

english: Your current contact draft is unchanged. Start a new contact with {{call}} when ready.
chinese: 你目前的聯絡草稿未改動。準備好後可用 {{call}} 開始新的聯絡。

english: This is not available from the browser right now. Open it in Nexus at the shack.
chinese: 該功能目前無法在瀏覽器中使用。請在台站上的 Nexus 中開啟。

english: Journey, confirmation diagnostics and uploads are not available remotely yet.
chinese: 歷程、確認診斷與上傳功能暫不支援遠端使用。

english: Audio gap - the link is losing packets
chinese: 音訊中斷 — 鏈路正在丟包

english: Audio stalled - the link, not the band
chinese: 音訊停滯 — 是鏈路問題，不是波段

english: This browser cannot play station audio. Chrome, Edge, Firefox on a computer, or Safari 26 can.
chinese: 此瀏覽器無法播放台站音訊。電腦上的 Chrome、Edge、Firefox，或 Safari 26 可以。

english: The station changed its audio device. Press Listen again.
chinese: 台站更換了音訊裝置。請再次按「收聽」。

english: Another browser is listening to this station.
chinese: 另一個瀏覽器正在收聽該台站。

english: Audio stopped because station control was lost.
chinese: 音訊已停止，因為失去了台站控制權。

english: Copy the file from the station into this computer’s Downloads folder
chinese: 把台站上的檔案複製到本機「下載」資料夾

english: Could not save the station’s file to this computer
chinese: 無法把台站上的檔案儲存到本機

english: {{name}} is not a recording, an SSTV picture or ALL.TXT
chinese: {{name}} 不是錄音、SSTV 影像或 ALL.TXT
台站上的 SSTV 影像

english: Could not list the station’s files
chinese: 無法列出台站上的檔案

english: The station has accepted the Stop. It is not off the air until the station reports the transmitter free.
chinese: 台站已接受停止請求。在台站報告發射機空閒之前，它仍未離開空中。

english: The station reports the transmitter free.
chinese: 台站報告發射機已空閒。

english: The station has no audio to send right now.
chinese: 台站目前沒有可傳送的音訊。

english: Nexus at the shack. Click it, then use your mouse and keyboard to operate it. Tab leaves the picture.
chinese: 台站上的 Nexus。點選它，然後用滑鼠和鍵盤操作。Tab 鍵可離開畫面。

english: Fill the screen with the stream, Stop TX included. Esc still stops transmitting.
chinese: 讓串流鋪滿螢幕，含「停止發射」。Esc 仍可停止發射。

english: Type here for the field selected at the shack
chinese: 在此輸入，內容會送到台站目前選中的控制元件

english: Turn the phone on its side for a bigger picture.
chinese: 把手機橫過來可獲得更大畫面。

english: Hold to talk: the rig keys when your microphone's audio arrives, and unkeys when you let go or the picture stops.
chinese: 按住說話：你的話筒音訊到達時電台開始發射，鬆開或畫面停止時解除發射。

english: Station control is off for this browser. Allow it in Nexus at the shack (Settings → Remote → Advanced), then try again.
chinese: 此瀏覽器的台站控制已關閉。請在台站上的 Nexus 中開啟（設定 → 遠端 → 進階），然後重試。

english: Another browser is using this station. You can start once it lets go.
chinese: 另一個瀏覽器正在使用該台站。對方釋放後你即可開始。

english: Ready. Start the stream to see and operate Nexus at the shack.
chinese: 已就緒。開始串流即可檢視並操作台站上的 Nexus。

english: The stream is the Nexus window as Windows draws it at the shack, so Nexus there must stay open, and not minimized.
chinese: 串流顯示的是台站上 Windows 繪製的 Nexus 視窗，因此那裡的 Nexus 必須保持開啟且未最小化。

english: The station couldn't start the stream just now. Start the stream again.
chinese: 台站剛才無法啟動串流。請重新開始串流。
正在串流台站上的 Nexus

english: The picture has stopped updating. The station will not transmit for this browser until it moves again.
chinese: 畫面已停止更新。在畫面恢復之前，台站不會為此瀏覽器發射。

english: The station is holding off transmitting for this browser until its picture here catches up.
chinese: 台站正在暫緩為此瀏覽器發射，直到這裡的畫面跟上。

english: Your microphone, for talking on the rig. It stays off until you turn it on, and your browser asks first. Then hold PTT and talk: the rig keys when your audio arrives.
chinese: 你的話筒，用於透過電台上話。它預設關閉，開啟前瀏覽器會先詢問。然後按住 PTT 說話：音訊到達時電台開始發射。

english: How loud your voice goes to the rig, over your microphone's own level. Talk as you would on the air and raise it until your loudest words reach the end of the bar. Peaks are held 3 dB under full scale, so it never clips. This browser remembers it.
chinese: 你的聲音送到電台的音量，疊加在話筒自身電平之上。按平時上機的音量說話，並提高它直到最響的字達到整條末端。峰值會壓在滿刻度以下 3 dB，因此永不削波。此瀏覽器會記住該設定。

english: The rig must take its SSB audio from USB (its menu for the transmit audio source). Most radios come set to the front microphone, and then an over sends the shack's microphone instead of you.
chinese: 電台必須從 USB 取 SSB 音訊（其發射音訊源選單）。多數電台出廠設為前面板話筒，那樣一個發段送出的會是台站的話筒而不是你。

english: The microphone is blocked for this site. Allow it in the browser's settings for this site (the icon at the left of the address bar), then turn the microphone on again.
chinese: 本站點的話筒權限被阻止。請在瀏覽器針對本站點的設定中允許（位址列左側的圖示），然後重新開啟話筒。

english: Your computer's privacy settings are blocking the microphone for the browser. On Windows, open Settings ▸ Privacy & security ▸ Microphone and turn on microphone access, including for desktop apps. On a Mac, open System Settings ▸ Privacy & Security ▸ Microphone, turn the browser on, and reopen it. Then turn the microphone on again.
chinese: 你電腦的隱私設定阻止了瀏覽器使用話筒。在 Windows 上，開啟 設定 ▸ 隱私和安全性 ▸ 麥克風 並開啟麥克風訪問（含桌面應用）。在 Mac 上，開啟 系統設定 ▸ 隱私與安全性 ▸ 麥克風，開啟該瀏覽器並重新開啟它。然後重新開啟話筒。

english: The browser's question about the microphone was closed without an answer. Turn the microphone on again and choose Allow.
chinese: 瀏覽器關於話筒的詢問被關閉且未作答。請重新開啟話筒並選擇「允許」。

english: No microphone was found on this computer. Plug one in, then turn the microphone on again.
chinese: 本機未找到話筒。請接入一個，然後重新開啟話筒。

english: The microphone was found but could not start. Another program may be using it: close that program, then turn the microphone on again.
chinese: 找到了話筒但無法啟動。可能有其他程式正在使用：請關閉該程式，然後重新開啟話筒。

english: The browser could not get the microphone ({{name}}). Check the browser's settings for this site and the computer's microphone settings, then turn the microphone on again.
chinese: 瀏覽器無法獲取話筒（{{name}}）。請檢查瀏覽器針對本站點的設定與電腦的麥克風設定，然後重新開啟話筒。

english: This browser cannot send the microphone on this stream.
chinese: 此瀏覽器無法在此串流中傳送話筒音訊。

english: The browser is still processing the microphone (echo cancellation, noise suppression or automatic gain), which can make your voice sound worse on the air.
chinese: 瀏覽器仍在處理話筒音訊（回聲消除、雜訊抑制或自動增益），這可能讓你在空中的聲音變差。

english: PTT is held but your microphone is off, so nothing is transmitted. Turn the microphone on to talk.
chinese: PTT 已按住但話筒未開，因此沒有發射。請開啟話筒後再講話。

english: The rig shows no power out while your voice is arriving. Set its SSB audio source to USB (its menu for the transmit audio source).
chinese: 你的聲音已到達，但電台顯示無輸出功率。請把其 SSB 音訊源設為 USB（其發射音訊源選單）。

english: Your connection stalled, so the transmission stopped.
chinese: 你的連線中斷，發射已停止。

english: Your audio stopped arriving, so the transmission stopped.
chinese: 你的音訊中斷，發射已停止。

english: Control was lost, so the transmission stopped.
chinese: 控制權已丟失，發射已停止。

english: The transmission ended at its 10-minute limit. Press PTT again to carry on.
chinese: 發射已達到 10 分鐘上限並結束。請再次按 PTT 繼續。

english: The TX watchdog stopped the transmission.
chinese: 發射看門狗停止了發射。

english: The station's audio changed, so the transmission stopped. Press PTT again.
chinese: 台站的音訊發生變化，發射已停止。請再次按 PTT。

english: Time to give your call sign.
Remember to give your call sign at the end of the contact.
chinese: 記得在聯絡結束時報出你的呼號。

english: Still there? The stream ends in a minute unless you click.
chinese: 還在嗎？若你不點選，串流將在一分鐘後結束。

english: Nobody answered “Still there?”, so the stream ended.
chinese: 無人回應「還在嗎？」，串流已結束。

english: The stream ended because station control was lost.
chinese: 串流已結束，因為失去了台站控制權。

english: This station can't stream yet. Update Nexus at the shack and turn streaming on there.
chinese: 該台站暫時無法串流。請更新台站上的 Nexus 並在那裡開啟串流。

english: Your Remote access has ended, so the stream can't start.
chinese: 你的遠端訪問已結束，因此無法開始串流。

english: Remote access was switched off for this account, so the stream ended.
chinese: 該帳戶的遠端訪問已被關閉，串流隨之結束。

english: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then start the stream again.
chinese: 嘗試次數過多。請等待一分鐘後重新開始串流。

english: Your Remote access over the internet has ended, so the stream works only on the shack's own network. Connect this device to the same network as the station, then start the stream again.
chinese: 你透過網際網路的遠端訪問已結束，因此串流僅在台站區域網內可用。請把本裝置接入與台站相同的網路，然後重新開始串流。

english: Streaming on the shack's own network needs a newer Nexus at the shack. Update Nexus there, then start the stream again.
chinese: 在台站區域網內串流需要台站上更新版本的 Nexus。請在那裡更新 Nexus，然後重新開始串流。

english: The station's reply was not encrypted end to end, so the stream was refused.
chinese: 台站的回覆未經端到端加密，因此串流被拒絕。

english: This browser can't show the stream. Use a current Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
chinese: 此瀏覽器無法顯示串流。請使用較新的 Chrome、Edge、Firefox 或 Safari。

english: The stream stops while this tab is in the background. Start it again when you're back.
chinese: 此標籤頁處於後台時串流會停止。回來後再重新開始。

english: The connection to the station was lost. Start the stream again.
chinese: 與台站的連線已斷開。請重新開始串流。

english: Streaming is off at the shack. In Nexus there, turn on “Stream this station from my browser” (Settings → Remote), then start the stream again.
chinese: 台站上的串流已關閉。請在台站的 Nexus 中開啟「從我的瀏覽器串流該台站」（設定 → 遠端），然後重新開始串流。

english: Another browser is streaming this station. You can stream once it ends.
chinese: 另一個瀏覽器正在串流該台站。對方結束後你即可串流。

english: The station could not use this browser's stream request. Use a current Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
chinese: 台站無法使用此瀏覽器的串流請求。請使用較新的 Chrome、Edge、Firefox 或 Safari。

english: Nexus at the shack is asking you to approve this browser. Approve it there if it shows this browser’s key, below, then start the stream again.
chinese: 台站上的 Nexus 正在請求你批准此瀏覽器。若那裡顯示的金鑰與下方一致，請在那裡批准，然後重新開始串流。

english: This browser’s key has changed, so Nexus at the shack asks you to approve it again. Approve it there if it shows this browser’s key, below, then start the stream again.
chinese: 此瀏覽器的金鑰已變更，因此台站上的 Nexus 要求你重新批准。若那裡顯示的金鑰與下方一致，請在那裡批准，然後重新開始串流。

english: This reply was not signed with your station's key, so it may not have come from your station. Nothing was connected.
chinese: 該回復未用你台站的金鑰簽名，因此可能並非來自你的台站。未建立任何連線。

english: Nexus at the shack did not sign its reply, so this browser can't tell it came from your station. Update Nexus at the shack, then start the stream again.
chinese: 台站上的 Nexus 未對回覆簽名，因此此瀏覽器無法確認它來自你的台站。請更新台站上的 Nexus，然後重新開始串流。

english: This station’s key has changed, so nothing was connected. Return to your stations to compare the new key with “This station’s key” in Nexus at the shack.
chinese: 此台站的金鑰已變更，因此未建立任何連線。請返回台站清單，將新金鑰與台站 Nexus 中的「此台站的金鑰」比對。

english: The station isn't online. Check that Nexus is running at the shack with Remote turned on, and that the computer is awake.
chinese: 台站不線上。請確認台站上的 Nexus 正在執行且已開啟遠端，並且電腦處於喚醒狀態。

english: Ready. Press Listen to hear the station's receive audio.
chinese: 已就緒。按「收聽」即可聽到台站的接收音訊。

english: The station couldn't start just now. Press Listen again.
chinese: 台站剛才無法啟動。請再次按「收聽」。

english: Nexus at the shack is asking you to approve this browser. Approve it there if it shows this browser’s key, below, then press Listen again.
chinese: 台站上的 Nexus 正在請求你批准此瀏覽器。若那裡顯示的金鑰與下方一致，請在那裡批准，然後再次按「收聽」。

english: This browser’s key has changed, so Nexus at the shack asks you to approve it again. Approve it there if it shows this browser’s key, below, then press Listen again.
chinese: 此瀏覽器的金鑰已變更，因此台站上的 Nexus 要求你重新批准。若那裡顯示的金鑰與下方一致，請在那裡批准，然後再次按「收聽」。

english: This station isn't sending its receive audio. Check that Nexus at the shack is up to date and has the radio's audio input set.
chinese: 該台站未傳送其接收音訊。請確認台站上的 Nexus 已更新，且已設定電台的音訊輸入。

english: Ready. Stream to see and operate Nexus at the shack, or Listen for its audio only.
chinese: 已就緒。串流可檢視並操作台站上的 Nexus，收聽則僅接收其音訊。

english: This browser isn't approved for this station yet. Press Stream, and Nexus at the shack asks you to approve it.
chinese: 此瀏覽器尚未獲準訪問該台站。請按「串流」，台站上的 Nexus 會請求你批准。

english: Waiting for approval at the shack: Nexus there asks whether to let “{{browser}}” stream. Approve it if it shows this key: {{key}}.
chinese: 正在等待台站批准：那裡的 Nexus 會詢問是否允許「{{browser}}」串流。若顯示的金鑰為此值，請批准：{{key}}。

english: Waiting for approval at the shack: Nexus there asks whether to let “{{browser}}” stream. Approve it there.
chinese: 正在等待台站批准：那裡的 Nexus 會詢問是否允許「{{browser}}」串流。請在那裡批准。

english: Remote streaming is a beta feature. Access could be revoked at any time.
chinese: 遠端串流為測試功能。訪問權限可能隨時被復原。

english: Station data unavailable. Refresh or reconnect.
chinese: 台站資料不可用。請重新整理或重新連線。

english: Click a signal to tune it
chinese: 點選某個訊號即可調諧到它

english: Waiting for the account to claim this station
chinese: 正在等待該帳戶認領此台站
帳戶已關聯 — 需要本地批准
正在重新連線遠端服務

english: Confirm this station in your browser first — the Remote page is asking whether to attach it. Then approve here again.
chinese: 請先在瀏覽器中確認此台站 — 遠端頁面正在詢問是否關聯它。然後在此再次批准。

english: The Remote service holds a different key for this station than the one it signs its stream with, so browsers refuse its stream. Use Revoke station access, then pair this station again.
chinese: 遠端服務為該台站儲存的金鑰，與其簽署串流所用的金鑰不一致，因此瀏覽器會拒絕其串流。請使用「復原台站訪問」，然後重新配對該台站。

english: Unlock your operating system’s credential store and try again. Remote stays disabled if its credential cannot be stored securely.
chinese: 請先解鎖作業系統的憑據儲存後重試。若憑據無法安全儲存，遠端功能將保持禁用。

english: This station's access was revoked from a browser, so it has stopped connecting. Nothing here is broken — pair it again below when you want it back.
chinese: 該台站的訪問已從某個瀏覽器復原，因此它已停止連線。此處並無故障 — 需要恢復時在下方重新配對即可。

english: Your Remote trial has ended, so this station could not be added to the account. Your radio, your log and your settings are untouched.
chinese: 你的遠端試用已結束，因此該台站未能加入帳戶。你的電台、日誌和設定均未改動。

english: Remote access for this account has been switched off, so this station could not be added to it. This is not the trial running out. Your radio, your log and your settings are untouched.
chinese: 該帳戶的遠端訪問已被關閉，因此該台站未能加入。這與試用到期不同。你的電台、日誌和設定均未改動。

english: A Remote trial is one per callsign, so set your station callsign in Settings → Station first, then pair this station again. Your radio, your log and your settings are untouched.
chinese: 遠端試用按呼號計算，一個呼號一次，因此請先在 設定 → 電台 中填寫你的台站呼號，然後重新配對該台站。你的電台、日誌和設定均未改動。

english: The callsign in Settings → Station is not an active US licence in the FCC's licence list, so this station could not be added. Check it for a typo. A new licence takes about a day to appear there. Your radio, your log and your settings are untouched.
chinese: 設定 → 電台 中的呼號在 FCC 執照清單中不是有效執照，因此該台站未能加入。請檢查是否有筆誤。新執照約需一天才會出現在清單中。你的電台、日誌和設定均未改動。

english: This callsign has already had a Remote trial under another account, so this station could not be added. If this is your callsign, write to support from the email address on your licence. Your radio, your log and your settings are untouched.
chinese: 該呼號已在另一帳戶下使用過遠端試用，因此該台站未能加入。若這是你的呼號，請用執照上登記的信箱聯絡支援。你的電台、日誌和設定均未改動。

english: This computer has already had a Remote trial under another account, so this station could not be added. Your radio, your log and your settings are untouched.
chinese: 此電腦已在另一帳戶下使用過遠端試用，因此該台站未能加入。你的電台、日誌和設定均未改動。

english: Adding a station to Remote needs a newer Nexus. Update Nexus, then pair this station again. Your radio, your log and your settings are untouched.
chinese: 向遠端功能新增台站需要更新版本的 Nexus。請更新 Nexus，然後重新配對該台站。你的電台、日誌和設定均未改動。

english: This email address already has a Remote trial running under a different sign-in, such as Google instead of a password, so this station could not be added. In your browser, sign out, sign in the way you did the first time, then pair this station again. Your radio, your log and your settings are untouched.
chinese: 該信箱地址已在另一種登入方式（例如 Google 而非密碼）下執行了遠端試用，因此該台站未能加入。請在瀏覽器中退出登入，用首次登入時的方式重新登入，然後重新配對該台站。你的電台、日誌和設定均未改動。

english: Enter a name for this station to sign in or pair.
chinese: 輸入該台站的名稱以便登入或配對。

english: This code expires after ten minutes.
chinese: 該驗證碼十分鐘後失效。

english: Remote stays on when Nexus restarts: if it was on when Nexus closed, it turns itself back on and reconnects. Approved browsers keep what you allowed. Turn off Remote only disconnects: turning it back on restores what each approved browser had.
chinese: Nexus 重啟後遠端功能會保持開啟：若 Nexus 關閉時它是開啟的，會自動重新開啟並重連。已批准的瀏覽器保留你授予的權限。關閉遠端只會斷開連線：再次開啟時會恢復各已批准瀏覽器原有的權限。

english: Remote can only come back after this computer restarts if Nexus starts too. Start Nexus when you sign in to this computer?
chinese: 只有當 Nexus 也隨開機啟動時，遠端功能才能在電腦重啟後恢復。登入此電腦時要啟動 Nexus 嗎？

english: Start Nexus when I sign in
This computer did not let Nexus start at sign-in. You can try again in Settings.
chinese: 此電腦不允許 Nexus 在登入時啟動。可在設定中重試。
已批准，直到你將其移除。

english: Approved until {{until}} UTC. Using the station from this browser keeps it approved, up to {{limit}} UTC.
chinese: 已批准，有效期至 UTC {{until}}。從此瀏覽器使用台站會持續延長批准，最長至 UTC {{limit}}。

english: This approval ends {{until}} UTC. Approve the browser again to keep it.
chinese: 該批准將於 UTC {{until}} 結束。請重新批准該瀏覽器以保留它。

english: This browser can’t stream until you approve it again here. First check this key matches the one the browser shows.
chinese: 此瀏覽器需在此重新批准後才能串流。請先確認該金鑰與瀏覽器顯示的金鑰一致。

english: Asks to operate this station over the internet.
chinese: 請求透過網際網路操作該台站。

english: This computer can’t connect until you approve it again here. First check this key matches the one Nexus shows on it.
chinese: 此電腦需在此重新批准後才能連線。請先確認該金鑰與那台電腦上 Nexus 顯示的金鑰一致。

english: Sign in with your Nexus Remote account in the browser that opens. There is no code: each of your other devices is then added when you sign in on it.
chinese: 在開啟的瀏覽器中用你的 Nexus Remote 帳戶登入。此過程不需要驗證碼：之後你在其他裝置上登入時會自動新增該裝置。

english: Waiting for you to sign in, in the browser that opened…
chinese: 正在等待你在已開啟的瀏覽器中登入…

english: Signing in to Nexus Remote is not available in this build yet. Pair with a code instead.
chinese: 此版本尚不支援登入 Nexus Remote。請改用驗證碼配對。

english: The sign-in did not finish. Try again.
Another sign-in is already open on this computer. Finish or close it, then try again.
chinese: 此電腦已有另一個登入處於開啟狀態。請完成或關閉它後重試。

english: Your account already has two stations. Remove one on the Remote page first.
chinese: 你的帳戶已有兩個台站。請先在遠端頁面移除一個。

english: Sign in again to keep adding devices: the key your station's sign-in was checked with has been retired.
chinese: 請重新登入以繼續新增裝置：驗證你台站登入所用的金鑰已作廢。

english: Nexus could not read its list of computers removed here, so it adds no device by its sign-in and takes no computer on this network. Press Reset network identity under Network identity below. A reset removes every paired computer, so each one has to be paired again.
chinese: Nexus 無法讀取其「已在此移除的電腦」清單，因此不會透過登入新增任何裝置，也不會接收此網路上的任何電腦。請按下方「網路身份」中的「重設網路身份」。重設會移除所有已配對電腦，因此每台都需要重新配對。

english: Sign in with the account this station belongs to.
chinese: 請用該台站所屬的帳戶登入。

english: Added by signing in as you: {{name}} ({{what}}), key {{key}}.
chinese: 透過以你身份登入而新增：{{name}}（{{what}}），金鑰 {{key}}。

english: Added for someone you invited ({{role}}): {{name}} ({{what}}), key {{key}}.
chinese: 為你邀請的人（{{role}}）新增：{{name}}（{{what}}），金鑰 {{key}}。

english: Waiting for you to allow it to transmit.
chinese: 正在等待你允許其發射。

english: That device is no longer waiting to transmit. It was removed, or it was not added by signing in.
chinese: 該裝置已不再等待發射。它已被移除，或並非透過登入新增。

english: The Remote service says this device is yours, but Nexus could not confirm it. Approve it only if you added it yourself.
chinese: 遠端服務聲稱該裝置屬於你，但 Nexus 無法確認。僅當你親自新增時才批准。

english: Removed here. The Remote service hears of it when this station is back online.
chinese: 已在此移除。待該台站重新上線後，遠端服務會獲知此事。

english: Removed. Nexus could not confirm whether this computer also shows as another row under Devices. Check the list, and remove it there too if it does.
chinese: 已移除。Nexus 無法確認此電腦是否也作為另一行出現在「裝置」中。請檢查清單，若有則一併移除。

english: Every computer, phone and browser that can reach this station, under whoever it belongs to.
chinese: 所有能訪問該台站的電腦、手機和瀏覽器，歸在各自所屬人名下。

english: Added by signing in, not yet known whose
chinese: 透過登入新增，尚不知歸屬

english: Listening and tuning only. Transmit waits for you to press Allow to transmit, or about {{minutes}} min.
chinese: 僅收聽與調諧。發射需你按「允許發射」，或等待約 {{minutes}} 分鐘。

english: Invite someone by the address they sign in with. Their devices are added when they sign in. Someone invited to operate transmits with your station, under your callsign: you stay responsible as its licensee.
chinese: 用對方的登入信箱邀請。對方登入後其裝置會被新增。被邀請「操作」的人會以你的呼號、用你的台站發射：作為執照持有人，你仍需負責。

english: Someone invited to operate can do all you can from another computer: transmit under your callsign, edit, export or delete your log, upload with your saved logins (LoTW signed with your certificate), spot under your call and read your Winlink mail. Invite to operate only someone you would hand the shack to.
chinese: 被邀請「操作」的人可在另一台電腦上做你能做的一切：以你的呼號發射、編輯/匯出/刪除你的日誌、用你儲存的登入上傳（LoTW 用你的證書籤名）、以你的呼號發台站報告，以及讀取你的 Winlink 郵件。只把「操作」權限邀請給你願意把台站交給的人。

english: Also taken off this network, since Nexus could not tell whose they were: {{names}}. Whoever uses them signs in on them again to come back.
chinese: 同時已從此網路移除，因為 Nexus 無法判斷其歸屬：{{names}}。使用者在其上重新登入即可恢復。

english: This station has invited as many people as it can. Remove someone first.
chinese: 該台站已達邀請人數上限。請先移除某人。

english: A browser signed in to your Remote account asks to stream this station and operate it as you would here, transmit included. Approve it only if this key matches the one the browser shows: {{key}}.
chinese: 一個登入了你遠端帳戶的瀏覽器請求串流該台站，並像你在此一樣操作它，包括發射。僅當該金鑰與瀏覽器顯示的金鑰一致時才批准：{{key}}。

english: This browser was approved before, but it can’t stream until you approve it again here. When it streams, it can operate this station as you would here, transmit included. Approve it only if this key matches the one the browser shows: {{key}}.
chinese: 此瀏覽器此前已獲批准，但需在此重新批准後才能串流。串流時它可像你在此一樣操作該台站，包括發射。僅當該金鑰與瀏覽器顯示的金鑰一致時才批准：{{key}}。

english: Nexus on {{platform}}, signed in to your Remote account, asks to operate this station over the internet as you would here, transmit included. Approve it only if this key matches the one Nexus shows on that computer: {{key}}.
chinese: {{platform}} 上登入了你遠端帳戶的 Nexus 請求透過網際網路像你在此一樣操作該台站，包括發射。僅當該金鑰與那台電腦上 Nexus 顯示的金鑰一致時才批准：{{key}}。

english: Nexus on {{platform}} was approved before, but it can’t connect until you approve it again here. Connected, it can operate this station as you would here, transmit included. Approve it only if this key matches the one Nexus shows on that computer: {{key}}.
chinese: {{platform}} 上的 Nexus 此前已獲批准，但需在此重新批准後才能連線。連線後它可像你在此一樣操作該台站，包括發射。僅當該金鑰與那台電腦上 Nexus 顯示的金鑰一致時才批准：{{key}}。

english: A browser signed in to your Remote account. It can listen and tune now, and transmit waits for you. Allow it only if this key matches the one the browser shows: {{key}}.
chinese: 一個登入了你遠端帳戶的瀏覽器。它現在可以收聽和調諧，發射則等待你的許可。僅當該金鑰與瀏覽器顯示的金鑰一致時才允許：{{key}}。

english: Nexus on {{platform}} signed in to your Remote account. It can listen and tune now, and transmit waits for you. Allow it only if this key matches the one Nexus shows on that computer: {{key}}.
chinese: {{platform}} 上登入了你遠端帳戶的 Nexus。它現在可以收聽和調諧，發射則等待你的許可。僅當該金鑰與那台電腦上 Nexus 顯示的金鑰一致時才允許：{{key}}。

english: Lets Nexus on another computer on this network operate this station, with no internet needed. Pair each computer here once; it keeps access until you remove it.
chinese: 允許此網路上的另一台電腦上的 Nexus 操作該台站，無需網際網路。每台電腦在此配對一次；在你移除之前會一直保持訪問權。

english: Listening at {{address}}. Only computers paired here can connect.
chinese: 正在 {{address}} 上監聽。只有在此配對的電腦才能連線。

english: Off: this station has no network key it can read. Press Reset network identity under Network identity below, then turn this on again. A reset removes every paired computer, so each one has to be paired again.
chinese: 關閉：該台站沒有可讀取的網路金鑰。請按下方「網路身份」中的「重設網路身份」，然後重新開啟。重設會移除所有已配對電腦，因此每台都需要重新配對。

english: Off: remote control was ended here. Turn this on again when you want it.
chinese: 關閉：遠端控制已在此結束。需要時再重新開啟。

english: Not listening: {{address}} is not this computer’s address right now. Nexus listens there again when it is back, or choose another network.
chinese: 未在監聽：{{address}} 目前不是此電腦的地址。它恢復後 Nexus 會重新在那裡監聽，或請另選網路。

english: Not listening: choose which of this computer’s networks to listen on.
chinese: 未在監聽：請選擇在此電腦的哪個網路上監聽。

english: Not listening: another program is using its port.
chinese: 未在監聽：其連線埠正被其他程式佔用。

english: Not listening: this computer is not on a private network.
chinese: 未在監聽：此電腦不在專用網路上。

english: Not listening: it could not start on this computer.
chinese: 未在監聽：它無法在此電腦上啟動。

english: Type this code in Nexus on the other computer. It works once, within ten minutes.
chinese: 在另一台電腦的 Nexus 中輸入該驗證碼。它只能使用一次，有效期十分鐘。

english: Whoever types it in time can operate this station, transmit included, so keep it to yourself.
chinese: 任何及時輸入它的人都能操作該台站，包括發射，因此請勿外傳。

english: Only at the station itself: this can’t be done through a stream.
chinese: 僅能在台站本機操作：此功能無法透過串流完成。

english: Eight computers are paired already. Remove one to pair another.
chinese: 已配對八台電腦。請移除一台後再配對。

english: Nexus could not read or keep this station’s network key and paired computers in your operating system’s credential store. Press Reset network identity under Network identity below. A reset removes every paired computer, so each one has to be paired again.
chinese: Nexus 無法在作業系統的憑據儲存中讀取或儲存該台站的網路金鑰與已配對電腦。請按下方「網路身份」中的「重設網路身份」。重設會移除所有已配對電腦，因此每台都需要重新配對。

english: Nexus could not do that. Try again.
chinese: Nexus 無法完成該操作。請重試。

english: Resetting makes a new network key and removes every paired computer. Use it if this computer’s key may have been copied, then pair your computers again.
chinese: 重設會生成新的網路金鑰並移除所有已配對電腦。若懷疑此電腦的金鑰已被複制，請使用此項，然後重新配對你的電腦。

english: This station and the other computer both need Windows, for now.
chinese: 目前該台站與另一台電腦都必須執行 Windows。

english: The first time this is turned on, Windows asks whether Nexus may use networks. Allow Private networks only.
chinese: 首次開啟時，Windows 會詢問 Nexus 是否可以使用網路。請僅允許「專用網路」。

english: Virtual adapters and VPNs are not offered: other computers on this network can’t reach this one through them.
chinese: 不會列出虛擬網路卡與 VPN：該網路上的其他電腦無法透過這些介面訪問本機。

english: Windows won’t let other computers find this station by name here, so type its address on the other computer.
chinese: Windows 不允許其他電腦在此按名稱發現該台站，請在另一台電腦上輸入其地址。

english: A guest network, or one that keeps its devices apart, stops other computers reaching this one, and Nexus can’t tell that from here.
chinese: 訪客網路或隔離裝置的網路會阻止其他電腦訪問本機，而 Nexus 在此無法判斷這種情況。

english: When Windows asks whether Nexus may use this network, allow Private networks only.
chinese: 當 Windows 詢問 Nexus 是否可以使用此網路時，請僅允許「專用網路」。

english: Windows calls this network Public, so its firewall keeps other computers out. If this is your own network, make it Private in Windows Settings ▸ Network & internet.
chinese: Windows 將此網路標記為「公用」，因此其防火牆會阻止其他電腦訪問。若這是你自己的網路，請在 Windows 設定 ▸ 網路和 Internet 中改為「專用」。

english: Windows Firewall blocks Nexus on this network, as it does after its question is cancelled. Allow Nexus on Private networks in Windows Security ▸ Firewall & network protection ▸ Allow an app through firewall.
chinese: Windows 防火牆在此網路上阻止了 Nexus，取消其詢問後即會如此。請在 Windows 安全中心 ▸ 防火牆和網路保護 ▸ 允許應用透過防火牆 中允許 Nexus 使用專用網路。

english: Windows Firewall blocks every incoming connection on this network, so no other computer can reach this station.
chinese: Windows 防火牆阻止了此網路上的所有入站連線，因此任何其他電腦都無法訪問該台站。

english: This computer’s firewall is set by an administrator’s policy, which may keep other computers out. Ask whoever manages it to allow Nexus.
chinese: 此電腦的防火牆由管理員策略設定，可能會阻止其他電腦訪問。請讓管理者允許 Nexus。

english: Windows Firewall blocks new programs on this network without asking. Allow Nexus on Private networks in Windows Security ▸ Firewall & network protection ▸ Allow an app through firewall.
chinese: Windows 防火牆在此網路上會不經詢問地阻止新程式。請在 Windows 安全中心 ▸ 防火牆和網路保護 ▸ 允許應用透過防火牆 中允許 Nexus 使用專用網路。

english: That address isn’t on this computer’s network. Join the station’s network, or check the address the station shows.
chinese: 該地址不在此電腦的網路上。請接入台站所在的網路，或核對台站顯示的地址。

english: The station’s computer answered, but nothing listens at that port: Remote over this network is off there, or on another port. Check the address the station shows.
chinese: 台站電腦有響應，但該連線埠沒有程式監聽：那裡的「經此網路使用遠端」已關閉，或使用了其他連線埠。請核對台站顯示的地址。

english: No answer from the station. Remote over this network may be off there, its firewall may be blocking Nexus (allow it on Private networks at the station), the network may keep its devices apart (guest Wi-Fi often does), or the station may be asleep. Nexus can’t tell which from here.
chinese: 台站沒有回應。那裡的「經此網路使用遠端」可能已關閉、其防火牆可能阻止了 Nexus（請在台站允許其使用專用網路）、網路可能隔離了裝置（訪客 Wi-Fi 常常如此），或者台站處於休眠。Nexus 在此無法判斷是哪一種。

english: Finding stations by name doesn’t work on this computer. Type the address the station shows.
chinese: 此電腦無法按名稱查詢台站。請輸入台站顯示的地址。

english: No station answered by name on this network. Type the address the station shows.
chinese: 此網路上沒有按名稱響應的台站。請輸入台站顯示的地址。

english: Type the address the station shows, like {{address}} or {{withPort}}.
chinese: 請輸入台站顯示的地址，例如 {{address}} 或 {{withPort}}。

english: This window lost touch with Nexus. Close it, then open it again from Settings.
chinese: 此視窗與 Nexus 失去聯絡。請關閉後從設定中重新開啟。

english: No station is on this computer yet. Sign in to add yours.
chinese: 此電腦上還沒有台站。請登入以新增你的台站。

english: Forget this station? This computer’s keys for it are deleted, and using it from here again needs a new sign-in (or a new code, for a station paired with one). If the station still lists this computer, remove it there too.
chinese: 忘記該台站？此電腦為其儲存的金鑰將被刪除，要從此處再次使用需重新登入（若該台站是透過驗證碼配對的，則需新的驗證碼）。若台站仍列出此電腦，請在那裡一併移除。

english: Pair with a station on this network
chinese: 與此網路上的台站配對

english: At the station, press Pair a computer under Remote over this network. It shows its address and a code that works once, within ten minutes.
chinese: 在台站上按「經此網路使用遠端」中的「配對其他電腦」。它會顯示地址和一個只能使用一次、有效期十分鐘的驗證碼。

english: As the station shows it, like {{example}}.
chinese: 按台站顯示的樣子輸入，例如 {{example}}。

english: Looking for stations on this network…
chinese: 正在此網路上查詢台站…

english: Found by name on this network. Press one to use its address.
chinese: 已在此網路上按名稱找到。點選一個即可使用其地址。

english: The sixteen characters the station shows. Capitals or not, spaces or not.
chinese: 台站顯示的十六個字元。大小寫、空格均可。

english: The station shows it beside this computer’s key.
chinese: 台站會在該電腦金鑰旁顯示此名稱。

english: Paired. Press Operate from this computer to work the station from here.
chinese: 已配對。從此電腦按「操作」即可在這裡操作該台站。

english: That is not a station’s address. Type it as the station shows it, on this network.
chinese: 這不是台站地址。請按台站在此網路上顯示的樣子輸入。

english: The code is sixteen characters, 0 to 9 and a to f. Check it against the station’s screen.
chinese: 驗證碼為十六個字元，由 0-9 和 a-f 組成。請與台站螢幕核對。

english: Give this computer a name of 1 to 32 characters.
chinese: 請為此電腦起一個 1 到 32 個字元的名稱。

english: Nothing answered. Check that the station is on, that Remote over this network is on there, and that this computer is on the same network.
chinese: 沒有回應。請確認台站已開機、那裡的「經此網路使用遠端」已開啟，且此電腦與台站在同一網路。

english: The station is not pairing now. Press Pair a computer at the station, then type the new code within ten minutes.
chinese: 台站目前未處於配對狀態。請在台站按「配對其他電腦」，然後在十分鐘內輸入新驗證碼。

english: The station refused the code. Check it against the station’s screen. After three wrong codes the station needs a new one.
chinese: 台站拒絕了該驗證碼。請與台站螢幕核對。連續三次錯誤後，台站需要生成新的驗證碼。

english: The code does not match the station’s. Check the code and the address. If both are right, something else on this network may be answering in the station’s place.
chinese: 該驗證碼與台站不匹配。請核對驗證碼和地址。若兩者都正確，可能有此網路上的其他程式冒用台站身份響應。

english: The station has eight computers paired already. Remove one there, then try again.
chinese: 該台站已配對八台電腦。請在那裡移除一台後重試。

english: The station could not keep the pairing. Check its credential store, then pair again with a new code.
chinese: 台站無法儲存配對資訊。請檢查其憑據儲存，然後用新驗證碼重新配對。

english: This computer’s Nexus is newer than the station’s. Update Nexus at the station, then try again.
chinese: 此電腦的 Nexus 比台站的新。請更新台站上的 Nexus 後重試。

english: The station’s Nexus is newer than this computer’s. Update Nexus on this computer, then try again.
chinese: 台站的 Nexus 比此電腦的新。請更新此電腦上的 Nexus 後重試。

english: This computer is paired with eight stations already. Forget one, then try again.
chinese: 此電腦已與八個台站配對。請忘記一個後重試。

english: This computer’s credential store did not answer. Unlock it, then try again.
chinese: 此電腦的憑據儲存沒有響應。請解鎖後重試。

english: Something answered there that is not a Nexus station. Check the address.
chinese: 該地址響應的不是 Nexus 台站。請核對地址。

english: Nexus could not do that on this computer. Try again.
chinese: Nexus 無法在此電腦上完成該操作。請重試。

english: This station’s key has changed. If Nexus was reinstalled at the station, or its network identity reset, pair this computer again.
chinese: 該台站的金鑰已變更。若台站重灌了 Nexus 或重設了網路身份，請重新配對此電腦。

english: A station answered by name, but it is not the one this computer paired with, so Nexus did not connect to it. Check that the station is on and that Remote over this network is on there, or type the address it shows.
chinese: 按名稱響應的台站並非此電腦所配對的那個，因此 Nexus 未與之連線。請確認該台站已開機且那裡的「經此網路使用遠端」已開啟，或輸入其顯示的地址。

english: The station no longer knows this computer. It may have been removed there: pair it again.
chinese: 該台站已不再認識此電腦。可能已在那裡被移除：請重新配對。

english: This computer is no longer paired with that station.
chinese: 此電腦已不再與該台站配對。

english: The station ended the connection. Remote over this network may have been turned off there, or this computer removed.
chinese: 台站結束了連線。那裡的「經此網路使用遠端」可能已關閉，或此電腦已被移除。

english: The connection to the station was lost.
Operate this station from here? Nexus closes and starts again driving it over this network, and this computer’s own station stays off until you press Leave.
chinese: 要從此處操作該台站？Nexus 將關閉並重新啟動，改為經此網路驅動該台站；在你按「離開」之前，此電腦自身的台站會保持關閉。

english: As the station shows it, like {{example}}, or its computer’s name, like {{name}}.
chinese: 按台站顯示的樣子輸入，例如 {{example}}，或其電腦名稱，例如 {{name}}。

english: No computer on this network answers to that name. Check the name, or type the station’s address as it shows it.
chinese: 此網路上沒有電腦響應此名稱。請核對名稱，或輸入台站顯示的地址。

english: Operate runs Nexus here and works the radio from your own clicks and pop-outs. Streaming only shows a picture of the station’s screen.
chinese: 「操作」會在此處執行 Nexus，用你自己的點選和彈窗來操作電台。「串流」只顯示台站螢幕的影像。

english: Nexus is closing, to start again driving the station…
chinese: Nexus 正在關閉，以便重新啟動並驅動該台站…

english: Internet road added (Beta): Operate from this computer uses it when this station is not on this network.
chinese: 已新增網際網路通路（測試版）：當該台站不在此網路時，「從此電腦操作」會使用它。

english: Sign in to Nexus Remote in your web browser, so Operate from this computer can reach this station over the internet when it is not on this network.
chinese: 在你的網頁瀏覽器中登入 Nexus Remote，這樣當該台站不在此網路時，「從此電腦操作」可以透過網際網路訪問它。

english: Finish signing in to Nexus Remote in your web browser, then come back here.
chinese: 請在你的網頁瀏覽器中完成 Nexus Remote 登入，然後回到此處。

english: Internet road added. Approve this computer at the station, under Remote access, before you use it, and only if the station shows this computer’s key: {{key}}.
chinese: 已新增網際網路通路。使用前請先在台站的「遠端訪問」中批准此電腦，且僅當台站顯示的金鑰與此一致時才批准：{{key}}。

english: This computer’s key for the internet road: {{key}}
chinese: 此電腦在網際網路通路上的金鑰：{{key}}

english: This station’s key for the internet road: {{key}}
chinese: 該台站在網際網路通路上的金鑰：{{key}}

english: Check this key before the internet road carries anything. At the station, under Remote access, “This station’s key” must show the same groups. Until you say it matches, Operate from this computer does not use the internet road.
chinese: 在網際網路通路傳輸任何資料前請核對金鑰。在台站的「遠端訪問」下，「該台站的金鑰」必須顯示相同的分組。在你確認一致之前，「從此電腦操作」不會使用網際網路通路。

english: Check this key before the internet road carries anything. At the station, under Remote access, “This station’s key” must show the same groups. Until you say it matches, Operate from this computer does not use the internet road. Operating from this computer on the station’s own network checks it too: when the station shows this same key there, the internet road comes on by itself.
chinese: 在網際網路通路傳輸任何資料前請核對金鑰。在台站的「遠端訪問」下，「該台站的金鑰」必須顯示相同的分組。在你確認一致之前，「從此電腦操作」不會使用網際網路通路。若在台站自身網路上從此電腦操作，也會自動核對：當台站顯示相同金鑰時，網際網路通路會自動啟用。

english: The service gave a different key for this station than the station itself. This internet road is off. Forget the station here and add it again.
chinese: 服務為該台站給出的金鑰與台站自身的不一致。該網際網路通路已關閉。請在此忘記該台站後重新新增。

english: Remove this station’s internet road? Its pairing on this network stays, so Operate from this computer still works here. To add the internet road again later, use “Sign in…” on this row.
chinese: 移除該台站的網際網路通路？它在此網路上的配對會保留，因此「從此電腦操作」仍可在此使用。日後若需重新新增網際網路通路，請使用該行的「登入…」。

english: The service gave a different key for this station than the station itself. Nothing was added.
chinese: 服務為該台站給出的金鑰與台站自身的不一致。未新增任何內容。

english: The internet road is part of Nexus Remote’s paid service, and your account does not include it now. Operating on this network stays free.
chinese: 網際網路通路屬於 Nexus Remote 的付費服務，你的帳戶目前不包含它。在此網路上操作仍免費。

english: Nexus Remote does not take sign-ins from Nexus yet. Try again after an update.
chinese: Nexus Remote 尚不接受來自 Nexus 的登入。請在更新後重試。

english: Another program is using port 42078, which Nexus signs in through. Close it, then try again.
chinese: 另一個程式正在使用連線埠 42078，而 Nexus 透過它登入。請關閉它後重試。

english: The sign-in was not finished within five minutes. Try again.
chinese: 登入未在五分鐘內完成。請重試。

english: Confirm your email address with the link Nexus Remote sent you, then sign in again.
chinese: 請用 Nexus Remote 傳送的連結確認你的信箱地址，然後重新登入。

english: The sign-in did not finish. Try again.
A sign-in is already waiting in your web browser.
chinese: 已有一個登入正在你的網頁瀏覽器中等待。

english: No station was picked, so the internet road was not added.
chinese: 未選擇台站，因此未新增網際網路通路。

english: Your Nexus Remote account has more than one station. Pick the one you paired with here.
chinese: 你的 Nexus Remote 帳戶有多個台站。請選擇在此配對的那個。

english: Forgotten on this computer, but Nexus Remote could not be told. At the station, remove this computer under Remote access ▸ Devices.
chinese: 已在此電腦上忘記，但未能通知 Nexus Remote。請在台站的「遠端訪問」▸「裝置」下移除此電腦。

english: The internet road was removed on this computer and the pairing on this network was kept, but Nexus Remote could not be told. At the station, remove this computer under Remote access ▸ Devices.
chinese: 已在此電腦上移除網際網路通路並保留了此網路上的配對，但未能通知 Nexus Remote。請在台站的「遠端訪問」▸「裝置」下移除此電腦。

english: The station has eight devices already. Remove one at the station, then try again.
chinese: 該台站已有八台裝置。請在台站移除一台後重試。

english: Your Remote account has no station that can take this computer. Check that the station is linked to your account.
chinese: 你的遠端帳戶沒有可接收此電腦的台站。請確認該台站已關聯到你的帳戶。

english: The station has not given Nexus Remote its key yet. Turn Remote on at the station, then try again.
chinese: 該台站尚未將其金鑰提供給 Nexus Remote。請在台站開啟遠端後重試。

english: Nexus Remote did not answer. Check this computer’s internet connection, then try again.
chinese: Nexus Remote 沒有響應。請檢查此電腦的網際網路連線後重試。

english: Nexus Remote asked to wait. Try again in a minute.
chinese: Nexus Remote 要求稍候。請一分鐘後重試。

english: Nexus Remote refused this sign-in. Sign in with the account the station is linked to.
chinese: Nexus Remote 拒絕了此次登入。請用該台站所關聯的帳戶登入。

english: That station is on this computer already, paired with a code. Sign in once more to link it to your account.
chinese: 該台站已在此電腦上，且是透過驗證碼配對的。請再登入一次以將其關聯到你的帳戶。

english: The station did not take this computer last time. Pair it again: at the station, press Pair a computer, then type the code it shows here.
chinese: 上次台站未接收此電腦。請重新配對：在台站按「配對其他電腦」，然後在此輸入它顯示的驗證碼。

english: Nexus looks for your station on this network first. If it isn’t here, sign in with your Nexus Remote account to reach it over the internet.
chinese: Nexus 會先在此網路上查詢你的台站。若不在，請用你的 Nexus Remote 帳戶登入以透過網際網路訪問它。

english: Looking for your station on this network…
chinese: 正在此網路上查詢你的台站…

english: Found {{name}} at {{address}}. This computer isn’t paired with it yet: at the station, press Pair a computer, then type the code it shows here.
chinese: 在 {{address}} 找到 {{name}}。此電腦尚未與其配對：請在台站按「配對其他電腦」，然後在此輸入它顯示的驗證碼。

english: More than one station answered on this network. Which one is yours?
chinese: 此網路上有多個台站響應。哪個是你的？

english: Your station did not answer on this network.
chinese: 你的台站未在此網路上響應。

english: Sign in to reach it over the internet
chinese: 登入以透過網際網路訪問

english: Advanced: the stations on this computer, an address, a code
chinese: 進階：此電腦上的台站、地址、驗證碼

english: Sign in with the Nexus Remote account your station is linked to, or one its owner invited to operate it. The station is then on this computer, on its network and over the internet, with no code to type.
chinese: 用你台站所關聯的 Nexus Remote 帳戶登入，或用其所有者邀請來操作它的帳戶。之後該台站就會出現在此電腦上，既在其網路中也可經網際網路訪問，無需輸入驗證碼。

english: For a station whose owner has not signed in to Nexus Remote at the station yet.
chinese: 適用於所有者尚未在台站上登入 Nexus Remote 的情況。

english: Your Nexus Remote account has more than one station. Pick the one to add to this computer.
chinese: 你的 Nexus Remote 帳戶有多個台站。請選擇要新增到本機的那個。

english: Nexus did not find the station on this network. Type its address as the station shows it under Remote over this network, or its computer’s name.
chinese: Nexus 未在此網路上找到台站。請按台站在「經此網路使用遠端」下顯示的地址輸入，或輸入其電腦名稱。

english: Signed in. Operate from this computer reaches the station on its network, and over the internet when it is not there.
chinese: 已登入。「從此電腦操作」可在台站所在網路上訪問它，不在同一網路時則經網際網路訪問。

english: Signed in with your Nexus Remote account. The station takes this computer on its network until {{date}}.
chinese: 已用你的 Nexus Remote 帳戶登入。台站會在其網路上接收此電腦，有效期至 {{date}}。

english: Sign in again by {{date}} to keep operating this station on its network.
chinese: 請在 {{date}} 前重新登入，以便繼續在台站網路上操作它。

english: That station is on this computer already. To link it to your account, press Link to your account on its row.
chinese: 該台站已在此電腦上。要關聯到你的帳戶，請在其行上按「關聯到你的帳戶」。

english: You were invited to listen only. Nexus on this computer would operate the station, so it was not added. Listen in your web browser instead.
chinese: 你被邀請的權限僅為收聽。此電腦上的 Nexus 會操作該台站，因此未新增。請改用網頁瀏覽器收聽。

english: Your station has not signed in to Nexus Remote yet. At the station, press Sign in to Nexus Remote (Settings → Remote), then try again here.
chinese: 你的台站尚未登入 Nexus Remote。請在台站按「登入 Nexus Remote」（設定 → 遠端），然後在此重試。

english: Nexus could not confirm that the station Nexus Remote lists is yours, so it was not added. Sign in again at the station, then try again here.
chinese: Nexus 無法確認 Nexus Remote 列出的該台站屬於你，因此未新增。請在台站重新登入，然後在此重試。

english: The station was not found on this network, so it was not added. Sign in again from a computer on the station’s network.
chinese: 未在此網路上找到該台站，因此未新增。請在台站所在網路中的電腦上重新登入。

english: The station is not taking sign-ins on its network. At the station, check that it is signed in to Nexus Remote and that Remote over this network is on.
chinese: 該台站未在其網路上接受登入。請在台站確認它已登入 Nexus Remote，且「經此網路使用遠端」已開啟。

english: The station did not take this sign-in. Sign in with the account the station belongs to, or ask its owner to invite you.
chinese: 台站未接受此次登入。請用該台站所屬的帳戶登入，或請其所有者邀請你。

english: The station could not check this sign-in. Make sure the station and this computer run the same Nexus, then try again.
chinese: 台站無法核驗此次登入。請確認台站與此電腦執行相同版本的 Nexus 後重試。

english: The station could not keep this computer. Check the station’s credential store, then try again.
chinese: 台站無法儲存此電腦資訊。請檢查台站的憑據儲存後重試。

english: Another computer answered at that address, not your station. Check the address.
chinese: 該地址響應的是另一台電腦，不是你的台站。請核對地址。

english: Not reached on its own network yet: Operate from this computer uses the internet (Beta). On the station’s network, press Sign in on this network once to use it there too.
chinese: 尚未在其自身網路上訪問到：「從此電腦操作」將使用網際網路（測試版）。在台站所在網路上按一次「在此網路上登入」即可在那裡也使用。

english: Signed in. The station was not found on this network, so it is added over the internet: Operate from this computer uses the internet (Beta) until you sign in here on the station’s network.
chinese: 已登入。此網路上未找到該台站，因此經網際網路新增：「從此電腦操作」將使用網際網路（測試版），直到你在台站所在網路上在此登入。

english: The station was not found on this network, so it stays on this computer over the internet.
chinese: 此網路上未找到該台站，因此它在本次電腦上仍經網際網路使用。

english: Operate this station from here? Nexus closes and starts again driving it over the internet, and this computer’s own station stays off until you press Leave.
chinese: 要從此處操作該台站？Nexus 將關閉並重新啟動，改為經網際網路驅動該台站；在你按「離開」之前，此電腦自身的台站會保持關閉。
正在連線 {{station}} 上的台站…

english: Operating the station at {{station}} over this network.
chinese: 正在經此網路操作 {{station}} 上的台站。

english: Not live: the link to the station at {{station}} dropped. The screens show it as it last was, and Nexus connects again by itself.
chinese: 未連通：與 {{station}} 上台站的鏈路已中斷。介面顯示的是它最後的狀態，Nexus 會自動重連。

english: Another device is operating the station at {{station}}.
chinese: 另一台裝置正在操作 {{station}} 上的台站。

english: The station at {{station}} did not take this computer. {{reason}}
chinese: {{station}} 上的台站未接收此電腦。{{reason}}

english: Start Nexus again as this computer’s own station
chinese: 重新啟動 Nexus，作為此電腦自身的台站

english: Leave, and open Stations on this network to pair this computer with the station again
chinese: 離開，並開啟「此網路上的台站」以將此電腦與該台站重新配對

english: Nexus here and at the station are two builds of the same version. Install the same build on both computers.
chinese: 此處與台站上的 Nexus 是同一版本的兩個不同構建。請在兩台電腦上安裝相同的構建。

english: This computer runs Nexus {{computer}} and the station runs Nexus {{station}}. Update Nexus at the station to {{computer}}, and this computer connects again by itself.
chinese: 此電腦執行 Nexus {{computer}}，台站執行 Nexus {{station}}。請把台站上的 Nexus 更新為 {{computer}}，此電腦會自動重連。

english: This computer runs Nexus {{computer}} and the station runs Nexus {{station}}. Update Nexus on this computer to {{station}}, and it connects again by itself.
chinese: 此電腦執行 Nexus {{computer}}，台站執行 Nexus {{station}}。請把此電腦上的 Nexus 更新為 {{station}}，它會自動重連。

english: This computer runs Nexus {{computer}} and the station runs Nexus {{station}}: two builds of the same version. Install the same build on both computers.
chinese: 此電腦執行 Nexus {{computer}}，台站執行 Nexus {{station}}：同一版本的兩個不同構建。請在兩台電腦上安裝相同的構建。

english: Nexus at the station has not given this computer control. Allow it there.
chinese: 台站上的 Nexus 尚未授予此電腦控制權。請在那裡允許。

english: Nexus at the station gave a reason this computer cannot read.
chinese: 台站上的 Nexus 給出的原因此電腦無法讀取。

english: Operating the station over the internet (Beta).
chinese: 正在經網際網路操作該台站（測試版）。

english: Not live: the internet link to the station dropped. The screens show it as it last was, and Nexus connects again by itself.
chinese: 未連通：與台站的網際網路鏈路已中斷。介面顯示的是它最後的狀態，Nexus 會自動重連。

english: Another device is operating the station.
chinese: 另一台裝置正在操作該台站。

english: Connecting to the station over the internet (Beta)…
chinese: 正在經網際網路連線台站（測試版）…

english: The station did not take this computer over the internet. {{reason}}
chinese: 台站未接收此電腦的網際網路連線。{{reason}}

english: Another computer took control of the station. Nothing here is transmitting.
chinese: 另一台電腦接管了該台站。此處沒有任何發射。

english: This ends the other computer’s operating: anything it is transmitting stops now.
chinese: 這會結束另一台電腦的操作：它正在進行的任何發射會立即停止。

english: Still there? The internet link ends in a minute unless you click.
chinese: 還在嗎？若你不點選，網際網路鏈路將在一分鐘後結束。

english: This network lets no audio or second Stop road through: you can watch, tune and log, and transmitting from here is off.
chinese: 此網路不允許音訊或第二條停止通路透過：你可以檢視、調諧和記日誌，但從此處發射已關閉。

english: Signing in again, so this computer keeps operating the station on its network: finish in your web browser.
chinese: 正在重新登入，以便此電腦繼續在其網路上操作該台站：請在網頁瀏覽器中完成。

english: Sign in again by {{date}} in Stations on this network to keep operating this station on its network.
chinese: 請在 {{date}} 前於「此網路上的台站」中重新登入，以便繼續在台站網路上操作它。

english: Nobody answered “Still there?”, so the internet link ended.
chinese: 無人回應「還在嗎？」，網際網路鏈路已結束。

english: The internet road is part of Nexus Remote’s paid service, and your account does not include it now. Operating on the station’s own network stays free.
chinese: 網際網路通路屬於 Nexus Remote 的付費服務，你的帳戶目前不包含它。在台站自身網路上操作仍免費。

english: The station has not approved this computer for the internet road, or removed it. Approve it there, or add the road again.
chinese: 台站未批准此電腦使用網際網路通路，或已將其移除。請在那裡批准，或重新新增通路。

english: The internet road waits until you check the station’s key. In Stations on this network, compare it with the station’s screen.
chinese: 在你核對台站金鑰之前，網際網路通路會等待。請在「此網路上的台站」中與台站螢幕比對。

english: The service gave a different key for this station than the station itself, so its internet road is off.
chinese: 服務為該台站給出的金鑰與台站自身的不一致，因此其網際網路通路已關閉。

english: This computer waits for approval at the station, under Remote access.
chinese: 此電腦正在等待台站的批准，位於「遠端訪問」下。

english: Nexus Remote cannot take this computer yet.
chinese: Nexus Remote 尚無法接收此電腦。

english: Nexus Remote no longer has this station on your account.
chinese: Nexus Remote 的你的帳戶中已無此台站。

english: Nexus Remote did not answer. Nexus tries again by itself.
chinese: Nexus Remote 沒有響應。Nexus 會自動重試。

english: Nexus Remote asked to wait. Nexus tries again by itself.
chinese: Nexus Remote 要求稍候。Nexus 會自動重試。
Nexus Remote 拒絕了此電腦。

english: The internet link closed. Nexus tries again by itself.
chinese: 網際網路鏈路已關閉。Nexus 會自動重試。
空中斷開 {{count}} 次，共 {{seconds}} 秒
空中斷開 {{count}} 次，共 {{seconds}} 秒
空中斷開 {{count}} 次，共 {{seconds}} 秒
空中斷開 {{count}} 次，共 {{seconds}} 秒

english: No word from the station: your over may have ended.
chinese: 台站沒有回饋：你的發段可能已結束。

english: The station isn't in a phone mode.
Transmit isn't switched on at the station.
This frequency is outside your licence.
chinese: 該頻率超出你的執照範圍。

english: Another device is holding the transmitter.
chinese: 另一台裝置正佔用發射機。

english: The station is fixing its clock.
Listening and tuning only. Transmit waits for you to press Allow to transmit at the shack.
chinese: 僅收聽與調諧。發射需你在台站按「允許發射」。

english: Listening and tuning only. Transmit waits for you to press Allow to transmit at the shack, or about {{minutes}} min.
chinese: 僅收聽與調諧。發射需你在台站按「允許發射」，或等待約 {{minutes}} 分鐘。

english: The link to the station dropped.
No microphone is set on this computer.
No microphone audio is reaching the station.
chinese: 沒有話筒音訊到達台站。

english: Your over ended: your audio did not reach the station for 0.2 s.
chinese: 你的發段已結束：音訊有 0.2 秒未到達台站。

english: Your over ended: your PTT did not reach the station for 0.2 s.
chinese: 你的發段已結束：PTT 有 0.2 秒未到達台站。

english: Your over ended: it was stopped at the station.
chinese: 你的發段已結束：在台站被停止。

english: Your over ended: the station stopped hearing from this computer.
chinese: 你的發段已結束：台站不再收到此電腦的訊息。

english: Your over ended: it reached the 10-minute limit.
chinese: 你的發段已結束：達到 10 分鐘上限。

english: Your over ended: the station's TX watchdog stopped it.
chinese: 你的發段已結束：台站的發射看門狗將其停止。

english: Your over ended: the station's transmit audio changed.
chinese: 你的發段已結束：台站的發射音訊發生變化。

english: The station did not take your PTT.
Test build: this computer is blocking its command link to the station.
chinese: 測試構建：此電腦正在阻斷其到台站的命令鏈路。

english: Test build: this computer is blocking its Stop road to the station.
chinese: 測試構建：此電腦正在阻斷其到台站的停止通路。

english: This computer's own, for the station it operates over this network: kept here, never sent to the station.
chinese: 此電腦自身的設定，用於其經此網路操作的台站：儲存在本機，絕不傳送到台站。

english: Where you hear the station's receiver.
chinese: 你收聽台站接收機的地方。

english: The audio output would not open: {{why}}
How loud the station is heard here, over the level it keeps for its decoders. It changes nothing at the station.
chinese: 此處聽到台站的音量，疊加在台站為其解碼器保留的電平之上。不會改變台站的任何設定。

english: What you talk into when you transmit from here. Nexus opens it only while it is needed.
chinese: 從此處發射時你講話所用的話筒。Nexus 僅在需要時開啟它。

english: Speak normally: the bar should move well into the middle.
chinese: 正常說話：條形圖應明顯進入中段。

english: The test tone could not play.
This computer's audio did not start, so the station's audio cannot be heard here.
chinese: 此電腦的音訊未能啟動，因此此處聽不到台站音訊。

english: This computer could not keep that choice. Try again.
chinese: 此電腦無法儲存該選擇。請重試。

english: This build has no place for that command, so nothing was sent to the station.
chinese: 此版本沒有該命令的處理位置，因此未向台站傳送任何內容。

english: That runs on this computer, not at the station.
chinese: 該操作在此電腦上執行，不在台站上。

english: That can only be done at the station, on its own screen.
chinese: 該操作只能在台站本機的螢幕上完成。

english: That transmission is not available from this computer yet.
chinese: 該發射操作暫不支援從此電腦進行。

english: This computer’s PTT reaches the station another way. Nothing was sent.
chinese: 此電腦的 PTT 透過另一條通路到達台站。未傳送任何內容。

english: Transmitting from here needs the second Stop link to the station, and this connection has none. Nothing was sent.
chinese: 從此處發射需要到台站的第二條停止鏈路，而目前連線沒有。未傳送任何內容。

english: The station has not heard this computer’s Stop link in the last 5 seconds, so it takes no transmission from here. Nothing was sent.
chinese: 台站在最近 5 秒內未收到此電腦的停止鏈路，因此不接受來自此處的發射。未傳送任何內容。

english: What this screen shows of the station is more than 2 seconds old, so the station takes no transmission from here until it catches up. Nothing was sent.
chinese: 此螢幕顯示的台站狀態已超過 2 秒未更新，因此在其跟上之前台站不接受來自此處的發射。未傳送任何內容。

english: Your PTT press has ended. Let go of PTT and press again to talk.
chinese: 你的 PTT 按壓已結束。請鬆開 PTT 後再次按下講話。

english: Lock ended at its time limit: nobody answered “Still talking?”. Click PTT to let go, then again to talk.
chinese: 鎖定已達時間上限：無人回應「還在說嗎？」。請點選 PTT 鬆開，再次點選以講話。

english: A voice message is being recorded on this computer. Stop the recording, then press PTT.
chinese: 此電腦正在錄製語音訊息。請停止錄音後再按 PTT。

english: The PTT is held on this computer. Let go of PTT, then record.
chinese: 此電腦的 PTT 處於按住狀態。請鬆開 PTT 後再錄製。

english: A password typed here is never sent: the station uses the one it has stored.
chinese: 在此輸入的密碼絕不會被發送：台站使用其已儲存的密碼。

english: Another device has control of the station.
chinese: 另一台裝置控制著該台站。

english: The station is busy with this computer’s other requests. Try again.
chinese: 台站正忙於此電腦的其他請求。請重試。

english: Too many requests at once for the station. Try again.
chinese: 對台站的請求過於頻繁。請重試。

english: The station had that request already, and did not run it again.
chinese: 台站已收到過該請求，未再次執行。

english: Changed at the station. Reload and save again.
chinese: 已在台站更改。請重新載入後再儲存。

english: The station could not read that request.
Transmit was stopped after you pressed this, so the station did not do it. Press it again if you still want it.
chinese: 你按下此操作後發射被停止，因此台站未執行它。若仍需要，請再按一次。

english: That is too large to send to the station.
chinese: 內容過大，無法傳送到台站。

english: The link to the station dropped before it answered. Check at the station whether it happened.
chinese: 台站尚未回應，與它的鏈路就已中斷。請在台站核實該操作是否已發生。

english: This network blocks the roads Stop and audio need, so transmitting from here is off. Nothing was sent.
chinese: 此網路阻斷了「停止」和音訊所需的通路，因此此處發射已關閉。未傳送任何內容。

english: What you typed on this card has not been saved.
chinese: 你在該卡片上輸入的內容尚未儲存。

english: {{label}} cannot be emptied here: the log keeps the stored value when the box is empty. Type a new value, or put the old one back.
chinese: {{label}} 無法在此清空：當輸入框為空時，日誌會保留已存的值。請輸入新值，或把原值填回。

english: The date and start time must be a UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD) and a 24-hour time (HH:MM or HH:MM:SS).
chinese: 日期和開始時間必須是 UTC 日期（YYYY-MM-DD）與 24 小時制時間（HH:MM 或 HH:MM:SS）。

english: The end time must be a 24-hour UTC time (HH:MM or HH:MM:SS).
chinese: 結束時間必須是 24 小時制 UTC 時間（HH:MM 或 HH:MM:SS）。

english: The frequency must be a number of MHz.
chinese: 頻率必須是 MHz 數值。

english: TX power must be a number of watts.
{{tag}} is not an ADIF field name: use capitals, digits and _ only.
chinese: {{tag}} 不是 ADIF 欄位名：只能使用大寫字母、數字和 _。

english: {{tag}} is part of this contact's contest exchange, shown below: exports, uploads and awards read it from there, so it cannot be changed here.
chinese: {{tag}} 屬於本次聯絡的競賽交換資訊，見下方：匯出、上傳和獎項都從那裡讀取，因此不能在此修改。

english: Imported with a date only: no time of day was recorded. Leave the box empty to keep it that way.
chinese: 匯入時只有日期：未記錄具體時刻。留空可保持原樣。

english: Every other ADIF field this contact carries. The satellite, the DXCC entity, the station callsign and the operator are changed from the list (SAT, the country, Bulk edit); confirmations and uploads are the services'.
chinese: 本次聯絡攜帶的其他所有 ADIF 欄位。衛星、DXCC 實體、台站呼號和操作員請從清單修改（SAT、國家、批次編輯）；確認與上傳屬於各服務。

english: Open this contact on the card
Read only here: contacts are edited at the station.
chinese: 此處只讀：聯絡需在台站編輯。

english: Saving takes off what belonged to {{old}}: {{fields}}. Undo puts it back.
chinese: 儲存會移除原屬於 {{old}} 的內容：{{fields}}。復原可恢復。

english: Already uploaded to LoTW — not sent again: {{fields}}
chinese: 已上傳至 LoTW — 不再重複傳送：{{fields}}

english: Only this contact’s {{award}} status changes (CREDIT_SUBMITTED / CREDIT_GRANTED). Nothing is sent. Undo it from the History below.
chinese: 只改變本次聯絡的 {{award}} 狀態（CREDIT_SUBMITTED / CREDIT_GRANTED）。不會傳送任何內容。可在下方「歷史」中復原。

english: Marked {{freq}} for {{call}} on the band map
chinese: 已在波段圖上為 {{call}} 標記 {{freq}}

english: Frequency markers belong to a contest: turn Contest mode on to mark a frequency.
chinese: 頻率標記屬於競賽功能：請開啟競賽模式後再標記頻率。

english: Not while transmitting: tuning now would move your signal on the air. Try again when the over ends.
chinese: 發射期間不可操作：此時調諧會把你的訊號在空中的位置移走。請在發段結束後再試。

english: Not marked: the dial is outside the amateur bands.
chinese: 未標記：目前頻率不在業餘波段內。

english: That marker is gone: its call was logged on this band, or it was removed.
chinese: 該標記已不存在：其呼號已在本波段記錄，或標記已被移除。

english: No activation running. Start one on the POTA / SOTA view.
chinese: 沒有進行中的啟用。請在 POTA / SOTA 檢視中啟動一個。

english: At 0000Z the counts start again at 0 for the new UTC day. The activation keeps running.
chinese: 到 0000Z 時，新 UTC 日的計數會從 0 重新開始。啟用仍會繼續執行。

english: Paused: nothing is tagged with the park until you press Still activating on the POTA / SOTA view.
chinese: 已暫停：在你於 POTA / SOTA 檢視按「仍在啟用」之前，不會有聯絡被標記為該公園。

english: Contacts per hour since the oldest of your last ten, as the contest rate meter reads it: it falls while nothing is logged.
chinese: 自你最近十次聯絡中最早的那次起每小時聯絡數，與競賽速率表讀法一致：沒有記錄時會下降。
本次啟用的聯絡，最新在前

english: The newest {{shown}} of {{total}}; the Logbook has them all.
chinese: 共 {{total}} 次，顯示最新 {{shown}} 次；完整記錄在日誌簿中。

english: Open the activation’s counts, rate and contacts in a window of their own
chinese: 在獨立視窗中開啟本次啟用的計數、速率和聯絡

english: Before {{reference}} ends: tick what to do. Nothing is ticked until you tick it; nothing is uploaded.
chinese: 在 {{reference}} 結束前：勾選要執行的操作。不勾選則什麼也不做，也不會有什麼被上傳。

english: Export the ADIF files for POTA: {{count}} (one per park per UTC day), to Downloads
chinese: 匯出 POTA 所需的 ADIF 檔案：{{count}} 個（每個公園每個 UTC 日一個），儲存到「下載」

english: Couldn’t read this activation’s files from the log: export them from the Logbook.
chinese: 無法從日誌中讀取本次啟用的檔案：請在日誌簿中匯出。

english: The files are written at the station: export them from the Logbook there.
chinese: 檔案寫在台站上：請在台站的日誌簿中匯出。

english: Your contacts carried no grid (MY_GRIDSQUARE): the park had none and none was typed.
chinese: 你的聯絡未攜帶網格（MY_GRIDSQUARE）：該公園沒有網格，也沒有手動輸入。

english: The park is on a state line and no state was picked: your contacts carry no MY_STATE.
chinese: 該公園位於州界上且未選擇州：你的聯絡未攜帶 MY_STATE。

english: Upload the files yourself at pota.app (My Log Uploads): Nexus does not send them.
chinese: 請自行在 pota.app（My Log Uploads）上傳檔案：Nexus 不會代為傳送。

english: Keep this window in front of Nexus and your other programs, even while you work in another one. Press again to let it stack as an ordinary window.
chinese: 讓此視窗始終位於 Nexus 和其他程式之前，即使你在別的視窗工作。再次按下則按普通視窗層疊。

english: Could not change whether this window stays in front
chinese: 無法更改此視窗的置前設定

english: Show only the entry in this window: the call, the exchange and the dupe warning, without the last contacts and the contest screen. Press again for the whole window.
chinese: 此視窗只顯示錄入區：呼號、交換資訊和重複提示，不含最近聯絡與競賽面板。再次按下顯示整個視窗。

english: Open this entry alone in a window of its own, without the rest of the contest screen. It shares the contact with this entry, and Enter in either logs it once.
chinese: 把該錄入區單獨放到一個視窗，不含競賽面板的其他內容。它與本錄入區共享同一聯絡，任一處按 Enter 都只會記錄一次。

english: {{bird}} is picked on the Satellites screen. Log its pass contacts there: this window logs them as ordinary contacts.
chinese: {{bird}} 在衛星頁面選定。請在那裡記錄其過境聯絡：此視窗會將其記為普通聯絡。

english: Open the Contest screen in its own window, to put on another monitor: the contest switch, the controls, the club board, the score, the sections, the bonuses and the log. While a contest runs, its log line and your last contacts stay here.
chinese: 在獨立視窗中開啟競賽面板，可放到另一台顯示器：競賽開關、各控制元件、俱樂部榜、比分、分區、獎勵分和日誌。競賽進行中時，其日誌行和你最近的聯絡會留在此處。

english: The rest of the Contest screen is in its own window.
chinese: 競賽面板的其餘部分在它自己的視窗中。

english: Close that window and show it here again
chinese: 關閉那個視窗並在此重新顯示

english: Save a picture of these stats to your Downloads folder, to share where you like. Nothing is posted.
chinese: 把這些統計儲存為圖片到「下載」資料夾，便於在你想要的地方分享。不會發布任何內容。

english: Could not save the stats picture: {{detail}}

chinese: 最佳 60 分鐘：自 UTC {{time}} 起。

english: Breaks of {{minutes}} minutes or more between two contacts count as off time, as this contest’s rules set.
chinese: 按本競賽規則，兩次聯絡之間 {{minutes}} 分鐘及以上的間斷計為離開時間。

english: Breaks of {{minutes}} minutes or more between two contacts count as off time. No off-time minimum is on record for this contest, so Nexus uses {{minutes}} minutes.
chinese: 兩次聯絡之間 {{minutes}} 分鐘及以上的間斷計為離開時間。本競賽未記錄離開時間下限，因此 Nexus 使用 {{minutes}} 分鐘。

english: Countries and distances are not available here.
chinese: 此處無法提供國家與距離資料。

english: Logged outside the contest window, not shown: {{count}}
chinese: 記錄在競賽時段之外，未顯示：{{count}}

english: Measured from your grid to the grid a contact sent, or else to the centre of its country.
chinese: 從你的網格量到聯絡方發來的網格；若未傳送網格，則量到其國家中心。

english: Set your grid square in Settings to see distances.
chinese: 請在設定中填寫網格，即可檢視距離。

english: This contest’s exchange carries no grid.
chinese: 本競賽的交換資訊不含網格。

english: Not placed by the country file: {{count}}
Open the Stats tab. Contest mode stays on until you turn it off.
chinese: 開啟「統計」頁。競賽模式會一直保持開啟，直到你關閉。

english: Contest mode goes off when you press Turn off. Tick what you want done first: nothing is done that you have not ticked.
chinese: 按下「關閉」時競賽模式會關閉。請先勾選你要完成的操作：未勾選的都不會執行。

english: Export the Cabrillo log to Downloads
chinese: 匯出 Cabrillo 日誌到「下載」

english: Put back what the contest changed
Before is how each one was the first time it changed for this contest, or when Contest mode went on.
chinese: 「之前」指每項在本競賽中首次變更時的值，或競賽模式開啟時的值。

english: {{count}} contact from this laptop is not in the club's log yet. It still goes to the host when this laptop is back with it, Contest mode on or off. Leave Nexus open, with club sync on, until then.
chinese: 本機有 {{count}} 次聯絡尚未進入俱樂部日誌。待本機回到主機附近時會照常上傳，無論競賽模式開啟與否。在此之前請保持 Nexus 開啟且俱樂部同步開啟。

english: {{count}} contacts from this laptop are not in the club's log yet. They still go to the host when this laptop is back with it, Contest mode on or off. Leave Nexus open, with club sync on, until then.
chinese: 本機有 {{count}} 次聯絡尚未進入俱樂部日誌。待本機回到主機附近時會照常上傳，無論競賽模式開啟與否。在此之前請保持 Nexus 開啟且俱樂部同步開啟。

english: {{count}} contacts from this laptop are not in the club's log yet. They still go to the host when this laptop is back with it, Contest mode on or off. Leave Nexus open, with club sync on, until then.
chinese: 本機有 {{count}} 次聯絡尚未進入俱樂部日誌。待本機回到主機附近時會照常上傳，無論競賽模式開啟與否。在此之前請保持 Nexus 開啟且俱樂部同步開啟。

english: {{count}} contacts from this laptop are not in the club's log yet. They still go to the host when this laptop is back with it, Contest mode on or off. Leave Nexus open, with club sync on, until then.
chinese: 本機有 {{count}} 次聯絡尚未進入俱樂部日誌。待本機回到主機附近時會照常上傳，無論競賽模式開啟與否。在此之前請保持 Nexus 開啟且俱樂部同步開啟。

english: Lines {{contest}} requires that the Cabrillo log leaves out
chinese: {{contest}} 要求而 Cabrillo 日誌未包含的行

english: What you fill in here is saved and written into the Cabrillo log when it is exported.
chinese: 在此填寫的內容會被儲存，並在匯出時寫入 Cabrillo 日誌。

english: Read when Contest mode turned on. To set it, choose Not now, set it under Settings ▸ Contesting ▸ Your entry, then turn Contest mode off and on again before you export.
chinese: 在競賽模式開啟時讀取。要設定它，請選擇「稍後」，在 設定 ▸ 競賽 ▸ 你的參賽 中設定，然後關閉並重新開啟競賽模式，再匯出。

english: Send the Cabrillo log to {{contest}} at:
chinese: 把 Cabrillo 日誌傳送到 {{contest}}：

english: Nexus does not send it for you.
Contests running now or this week come first. Times are UTC.
chinese: 正在進行或本週舉行的排在前面。時間為 UTC。

english: {{running}} is running now. Starting {{contest}} ends it, and its contacts stay apart from the new contest's.
chinese: {{running}} 正在進行。開始 {{contest}} 會結束它，其聯絡會與新競賽的聯絡分開儲存。

english: Filled in from Settings. Change anything that is different for this contest.
chinese: 已從設定填入。若本競賽有不同之處，請直接修改。

english: This contest sends nothing you need to fill in.
chinese: 本競賽不需要你填寫任何傳送內容。

english: What your Cabrillo log declares, for the lines {{contest}} writes.
chinese: 你的 Cabrillo 日誌為 {{contest}} 所寫各行宣告的內容。

english: Operator category, Power category and Spotting assistance are read when the contest starts: a change here reaches the log after you stop the contest and start it again.
chinese: 操作員類別、功率類別和 spotting 輔助會在競賽開始時讀取：此處更改需要在你停止並重新開始競賽後才會進入日誌。

english: Battery or other natural power, no mains and no generator
chinese: 電池或其他自然能源，無市電、無發電機

english: QRP on mains or generator power scores ×2.
chinese: 使用市電或發電機的 QRP 按 ×2 計分。

english: Nothing here stops you starting. Fix what you want first.
chinese: 這裡的任何一項都不會阻止你開始。請先修好你想修的。

english: The radio is not answering. Check Settings ▸ Radio before the contest.
chinese: 電台沒有響應。請在競賽前檢查 設定 ▸ 電台。

english: No radio control is set up. You can still log by hand.
chinese: 未配置電台控制。你仍可手動記錄。

english: {{contest}} does not allow {{mode}}: contacts in it are logged but score nothing. Work it in CW or Phone instead.
chinese: {{contest}} 不允許 {{mode}}：該模式的聯絡會被記錄但不計分。請改用 CW 或電話。

english: {{contest}} does not allow {{mode}}: contacts in it are logged but score nothing. Work it in RTTY instead.
chinese: {{contest}} 不允許 {{mode}}：該模式的聯絡會被記錄但不計分。請改用 RTTY。

english: Start turns the contest on in S&P. The setup never calls CQ: Running is your own press, on the Contest screen or a cockpit.
chinese: 開始後競賽以搜尋呼叫（S&P）模式開啟。設定流程從不主動呼叫 CQ：需要「主叫」時請在競賽面板或駕駛艙自行按下。

english: One save, with Contest mode on. You can change any of this later with Change setup… on the Contest screen.
chinese: 一次儲存，並開啟競賽模式。之後可在競賽面板用「更改設定…」修改以上任何內容。

english: Nexus sends nothing until you call a station or press Running.
chinese: 在你呼叫某台站或按「主叫」之前，Nexus 不會傳送任何內容。

english: The station did not enter {{contest}}: {{reason}} Contest mode is off again.
chinese: 台站未進入 {{contest}}：{{reason}} 競賽模式已重新關閉。

english: The station did not enter {{contest}}. Contest mode is off again.
chinese: 台站未進入 {{contest}}。競賽模式已重新關閉。

english: A change here is "I moved": it takes effect on your next contact.
chinese: 此處的修改屬於「我已改頻」：從你的下一次聯絡起生效。

english: Read when the contest starts: {{fields}}. To change them, stop the contest, then start it again.
chinese: 在競賽開始時讀取：{{fields}}。要修改它們，請停止競賽後重新開始。

english: Read when the contest starts: {{fields}}. To change it, stop the contest, then start it again.
chinese: 在競賽開始時讀取：{{fields}}。要修改它，請停止競賽後重新開始。

english: The station did not enter {{contest}}: {{reason}} Your answers were put back, and {{running}} is on again.
chinese: 台站未進入 {{contest}}：{{reason}} 你的填寫已還原，{{running}} 已重新開啟。

english: The station did not enter {{contest}}. Your answers were put back, and {{running}} is on again.
chinese: 台站未進入 {{contest}}。你的填寫已還原，{{running}} 已重新開啟。

english: The station did not enter {{contest}}, and putting the earlier settings back failed: {{error}}. Contest mode may still be saved on: check Settings ▸ Contesting.
chinese: 台站未進入 {{contest}}，且還原先前設定失敗：{{error}}。競賽模式可能仍處於儲存開啟狀態：請檢查 設定 ▸ 競賽。

english: {{contest}} is not running now. It was stopped while this setup was open.
chinese: {{contest}} 目前未進行。它在此設定開啟期間被停止了。

english: The running contest changed while this setup was open. Check it here, then go on.
chinese: 此設定開啟期間進行中的競賽已變化。請在此核對後再繼續。

english: Nothing was saved: the station could not say whether a contest is running now. Try again.
chinese: 未儲存任何內容：台站無法說明目前是否有競賽進行。請重試。

english: The station did not enter {{contest}}: {{reason}} Your answers were put back. Contest mode was already saved on, so the station tries again at the next save.
chinese: 台站未進入 {{contest}}：{{reason}} 你的填寫已還原。競賽模式此前已儲存為開啟，因此台站會在下次儲存時重試。

english: The station did not enter {{contest}}. Your answers were put back. Contest mode was already saved on, so the station tries again at the next save.
chinese: 台站未進入 {{contest}}。你的填寫已還原。競賽模式此前已儲存為開啟，因此台站會在下次儲存時重試。

english: The station could not check this exchange. Change a field to try again.
chinese: 台站無法校驗該交換資訊。請修改某個欄位後重試。

english: Your move took effect: you send {{exchange}}. Saving the other changes failed: {{error}}.
chinese: 你的改頻已生效：你傳送 {{exchange}}。其他更改儲存失敗：{{error}}。

english: Post ONE spot of your call on this frequency to the DX cluster, with the comment beside it. Once per press; then a {{secs}} s wait.
chinese: 把你在該頻率上的呼號作為一條台站報告發到 DX 叢集，附上旁邊的備註。每次按下僅發一條，之後需等待 {{secs}} 秒。
已播報到 DX 叢集：{{line}}

english: Not spotted: set your callsign in Settings first.
chinese: 未播報：請先在設定中填寫你的呼號。

english: Not spotted: no DX cluster is connected. Set a cluster in Settings ▸ Logging & Connectors ▸ Integrations & Feeds ▸ Spot Sources.
chinese: 未播報：未連線任何 DX 叢集。請在 設定 ▸ 日誌與聯結器 ▸ 整合與資料來源 ▸ 台站報告源 中配置叢集。

english: Not spotted again yet: one spot a minute. {{secs}} s to go.
chinese: 暫不能再次播報：每分鐘一條。還需 {{secs}} 秒。

english: Not spotted: the dial is outside the amateur bands.
chinese: 未播報：目前頻率不在業餘波段內。

english: Not spotted: Contest mode is off.
chinese: 未播報：競賽模式已關閉。

english: Not spotted: this contest's rules allow no spotting.
chinese: 未播報：本競賽規則不允許播報。

english: Not spotted: this contest allows spotting only over amateur radio while it runs.
chinese: 未播報：本競賽在比賽期間僅允許透過業餘無線電播報。

english: Not spotted: the DX cluster did not take the spot.
chinese: 未播報：DX 叢集未接受該報告。

english: This contest may not allow self-spotting. Press Spot anyway within {{secs}} s to post.
chinese: 本競賽可能不允許自我播報。若仍要播報，請在 {{secs}} 秒內按「仍然播報」。
顯示已發 RST 輸入框

english: Adds an RST sent box to the contest entry, beside the received report. It shows the report each contact logs as sent (59 on phone, 599 on CW and digital), and a report typed there is logged for that contact only. Space and Tab skip it. It shows only in contests whose exchange sends a report.
chinese: 在競賽錄入區、接收報告旁邊增加一個已發 RST 輸入框。它顯示每次聯絡記錄為已傳送的報告（電話 59，CW 與數字 599）；在此輸入的只會記入該次聯絡。空格和 Tab 可跳過它。僅在交換資訊包含訊號報告的競賽中顯示。

english: Which contest you are entering. It decides the exchange, what counts as a duplicate, and how the log is scored — so the setup below belongs to the one you pick.
chinese: 你參加的是哪個競賽。它決定交換資訊、何為重複，以及日誌如何計分 — 因此下方設定都屬於你所選的那個。

english: Contest mode is on for {{contest}}. Saving a different pick ends it and starts the new one at once, without calling CQ. Each contest keeps its own contacts.
chinese: {{contest}} 的競賽模式已開啟。儲存其他選擇會立即結束它並開始新的競賽，且不會呼叫 CQ。每個競賽的聯絡各自儲存。

english: Your station is {{role}}. Your location decides this, so moving across the line changes it.
chinese: 你的台站角色為 {{role}}。這由你的位置決定，跨過州界即會改變。

english: This contest works the same way for everyone, so there is no role to choose. Contests with an in-state and an out-of-state side will show yours here.
chinese: 本競賽對所有參與者規則相同，因此無需選擇角色。含州內與州外兩方的競賽會在此顯示你的角色。

english: How many operators are at this station
What your Cabrillo log declares about the station. Pick CHECKLOG if you are sending the log to help the sponsor check others rather than to be scored.
chinese: 你的 Cabrillo 日誌對台站的宣告。若你提交日誌只是為幫助主辦方核查他人而不參與評比，請選擇 CHECKLOG。

english: Which power category you are entering
Whether your entry uses spotting assistance
chinese: 你的參賽是否使用播報輔助

english: Your log declares NON-ASSISTED, but Unassisted entry is off.
chinese: 你的日誌宣告為 NON-ASSISTED，但「無輔助參賽」未開啟。

english: Whether this is a school club station
chinese: 是否為學校俱樂部台站

english: The rest of what your Cabrillo log declares about the entry. Sweepstakes also sends these on the air, as the precedence letter, so it will not start until you have picked one of each: ARRL counts 5 watts or less as QRP, 100 watts or less as low power, and anything above that as high power, and an entry using spots, a skimmer or a cluster is Single Operator Unlimited.
chinese: 你的 Cabrillo 日誌對參賽組別宣告的其餘內容。Sweepstakes 還會把它作為優先順序字母在空中傳送，因此在你為每一項都選定之前不會開始：ARRL 將 5 瓦及以下計為 QRP、100 瓦及以下計為低功率、超過則計為高功率；使用台站報告、skimmer 或叢集的參賽組別為Single Operator Unlimited。
do_not_translate: Single Operator Unlimited | Single Operator | Sweepstakes | Cabrillo | ARRL | QRP

english: Winter Field Day takes QRP or LOW (its limit is 100 W PEP), and HIGH writes no CATEGORY-POWER line.
chinese: 冬季野外日僅接受 QRP 或 LOW（上限 100 W PEP），HIGH 不會寫出 CATEGORY-POWER 行。

english: Goes on the EMAIL line of the Cabrillo log you export for a contest whose log has one (the CQ contests), so the sponsor can reach you about your entry. The NAME line is your operator name from the Station tab. Leave it blank to leave the line out.
chinese: 寫入你匯出的 Cabrillo 日誌的 EMAIL 行（適用於日誌含該行的競賽，即 CQ 系列），便於主辦方就你的參賽聯絡你。NAME 行取自「台站」頁的操作員姓名。留空則省略該行。

english: The class the sponsor scores your entry in, from this contest's own rules, written on the ENTRY-CLASS line of the Cabrillo log. In the Illinois QSO Party a club running more than one transmitter at once enters UNLIMITED, and the high and low power classes split at 100 watts PEP. To certify a QRP entry, pick QRP under Power category.
chinese: 主辦方按本競賽自身規則為你評比的等級，寫入 Cabrillo 日誌的 ENTRY-CLASS 行。在伊利諾伊 QSO 聚會中，同時使用多部發射機的俱樂部參加 UNLIMITED，高功率與低功率等級以 100 瓦 PEP 為界。要證明 QRP 參賽，請在功率類別中選擇 QRP。

english: Your contest club, for the CLUB line of the Cabrillo log when the contest's rules have one (the CQ contests, the Illinois QSO Party). Spell out the club's full name, as CQ asks. Leave it blank to leave the line out.
chinese: 你的競賽俱樂部，用於競賽規則含該行的 Cabrillo 日誌 CLUB 行（CQ 系列、伊利諾伊 QSO 聚會）。請按 CQ 要求寫出俱樂部全名。留空則省略該行。

english: The OPERATORS line of the Cabrillo log lists everyone who was set as Operator at the key when they logged a contact. Add anyone else here, as callsigns separated by spaces or commas.
chinese: Cabrillo 日誌的 OPERATORS 行會列出記錄聯絡時被設為「操作員」的所有人。此處可補充其他人，呼號之間用空格或逗號分隔。

english: Which multi-operator class you are entering

How many signals your multi-operator entry puts on the air at once, in the classes this contest's sponsor scores: ONE is one at a time (Multi-One, Multi-Single), TWO is Multi-Two, UNLIMITED is Multi-Multi, and LIMITED is the ARRL VHF contests' Limited Multioperator. It goes on the CATEGORY-TRANSMITTER line of the Cabrillo log, with the OPERATORS line the sponsor needs from a multi-operator entry. Nexus marks every contact as transmitter 0, so add the second transmitter's contacts to a Multi-Two log before you send it.
chinese: 你的多人參賽同時在空中的訊號數，按本競賽主辦方評比的類別：ONE 為同時一個（多人單機、多人單發射機），TWO 為多人雙機，UNLIMITED 為多人多機，LIMITED 為 ARRL VHF 競賽的受限多人。它寫入 Cabrillo 日誌的 CATEGORY-TRANSMITTER 行，同時附上主辦方要求多人參賽提供的 OPERATORS 行。Nexus 會把所有聯絡標記為發射機 0，因此在提交多人雙機日誌前，請自行補入第二台發射機的聯絡。

english: Which overlay category you are also entering

An extra category the sponsor scores beside your entry, for the CATEGORY-OVERLAY line, if you qualify under its rules (CQ's overlays are for single operators). For Rookie and Youth, CQ asks for the date you were first licensed or your birth year in the soapbox.
chinese: 在你參賽組別之外、主辦方另行評比的附加類別，寫入 CATEGORY-OVERLAY 行 — 前提是你符合其規則（CQ 的附加類別面向單人操作）。對 Rookie 與 Youth，CQ 要求在 soapbox 中寫明首次獲照日期或出生年份。

english: Where the sponsor can mail a certificate or plaque, for the ADDRESS lines of the Cabrillo log: the street here, one line each, and the rest in the boxes below. A part the sponsor's template has no line for goes on one more ADDRESS line, the way its template writes it. Leave it blank to leave the address out. Remote never sees it.
chinese: 主辦方寄送證書或獎牌所用的地址，寫入 Cabrillo 日誌的 ADDRESS 行：街道在此，每行一條，其餘填入下方各框。主辦方模板中沒有對應行的部分會再寫一行 ADDRESS，按其模板的寫法。留空則省略地址。遠端功能永遠不會看到它。

english: Which band category you are entering

ALL for an all-band entry, or the one band a single-band entry is entered on, for the CATEGORY-BAND line of the Cabrillo log. A single-band entry still logs every contact, other bands included, and the sponsor scores only the band named here. In the CQ contests a multi-operator entry is ALL. Leave it unset to leave the line out.
chinese: 全波段參賽選 ALL，單波段參賽選其所用的那一個波段，寫入 Cabrillo 日誌的 CATEGORY-BAND 行。單波段參賽仍會記錄所有聯絡（含其他波段），主辦方只評比此處指定的波段。在 CQ 系列中，多人參賽為 ALL。留空則省略該行。

english: Your comments on the contest, for the SOAPBOX lines of the Cabrillo log. Each line you type is a line there, and a long one is wrapped to fit. The California QSO Party asks for its award lines here (YL, YOUTH, MOBILE, NEW CONTESTER…). Leave it blank to leave it out.
chinese: 你對本競賽的評論，寫入 Cabrillo 日誌的 SOAPBOX 行。你輸入的每一行就是那裡的一行，過長會自動折行。加州 QSO 聚會的評獎行（YL、YOUTH、MOBILE、NEW CONTESTER…）也在此填寫。留空則省略。

english: What your station sends when a contest asks for it. Fill in the ones your contest uses — a QSO party wants your county or your state, Sweepstakes wants your check. Nothing here is guessed: an exchange that goes on the air has to be one you typed.
chinese: 競賽需要時你的台站所傳送的內容。請填寫你參加的競賽會用到的項 — QSO 聚會需要你的縣或州，Sweepstakes 需要你的 check。這裡絕不猜測：要發到空中的交換資訊必須是你親手輸入的。

english: Your county, abbreviated the way the QSO party abbreviates it (Franklin is FRAN). Only in-state entries send this.
chinese: 你所在的縣，按 QSO 聚會的縮寫方式（Franklin 寫作 FRAN）。僅州內參賽者傳送此項。

english: Where your station is for this contest: your state, province or territory, two letters.
