This is not your ARRL section — Western New York is WNY as a section and NY as a state, and a QSO party wants the state. It is separate from the Station tab's State, the one your everyday macros send, so a portable or mobile entry can put here where it is operating.
chinese: 本競賽中你的台站所在地：你的州、省或屬地，兩個字母。這不是你的 ARRL 分區 — 西紐約作為分區是 WNY、作為州是 NY，而 QSO 聚會要的是州。它獨立於「台站」頁的「州」（你日常宏所傳送的那個），因此便攜或移動參賽可在此填寫實際作業地。

english: The last two digits of the year you were first licensed. Sweepstakes asks for it, and you send the same two digits all contest.
chinese: 你首次獲照年份的後兩位。Sweepstakes 要求此項，整個比賽中傳送相同的兩位數字。

english: Your CQ zone, 1 to 40. CQ WW asks for it. Leave it at 0 if you do not know it yet.
chinese: 你的 CQ 分區，1 至 40。CQ WW 要求此項。若尚不清楚可保持 0。

english: Your ITU zone, 1 to 90. IARU asks for it. Leave it at 0 if you do not know it yet.
chinese: 你的 ITU 分區，1 至 90。IARU 要求此項。若尚不清楚可保持 0。

english: The power you send as part of this contest’s exchange, in the sponsor’s own words (KW, 500, 5). It goes on the air exactly as you type it; the power your log declares is Power category, under Your entry.
chinese: 作為本競賽交換資訊一部分傳送的功率，用主辦方的原話（KW、500、5）。它會按你輸入的原文發到空中；你的日誌宣告的功率則是「你的參賽」下的功率類別。

english: This score leaves out the bonus points this contest works out from your log — this build does not compute them, so what the sponsor credits you will be higher. Everything the log needs to be accepted is here; the number is not your claimed score.
chinese: 該比分未計入本競賽依據你的日誌計算出的獎勵分 — 此版本不計算這些分數，因此主辦方給你的分數會更高。日誌被接受所需的全部內容都已在此；但這個數字不是你的申報總分。

english: Turns off the CW decoder (AI and classic), DX cluster / RBN spots, the PSK Reporter needs feed, Super Check Partial and call history together, and records the change with a timestamp. Takes effect at once. Your own settings for each of those are left alone and come back when you switch this off.
chinese: 一次性關閉 CW 解碼器（AI 與傳統）、DX 叢集 / RBN 台站報告、PSK Reporter 所需資料來源、Super Check Partial 和呼號歷史，並帶時間戳記錄該變更。立即生效。你對各項的自有設定保持不變，關閉本項後恢復。
do_not_translate: PSK Reporter | PSK | RBN | CW | DX

english: Kept in assistance_journal.json beside your settings, so it survives restarts. Newest first.
chinese: 儲存在設定旁的 assistance_journal.json 中，重啟後依然保留。最新的在前。

english: Super Check Partial and call history
chinese: Super Check Partial 與呼號歷史

english: Lists the calls active in recent contests that match what you type in the contest strip’s Call box. Nexus downloads the list (MASTER.SCP, about 360 KB of callsigns) from supercheckpartial.com, which W9KKN maintains, the first time a contest starts with this on. It is never shipped with Nexus.
chinese: 列出近期競賽中活躍、且與你輸入到競賽條 Call 框的呼號相匹配的台站。開啟本項後首次開始競賽時，Nexus 會從 supercheckpartial.com（由 W9KKN 維護）下載該清單（MASTER.SCP，約 360 KB 呼號）。它絕不隨 Nexus 一起分發。

english: Check for a newer list once a day
While a contest runs, Nexus asks the site at most once a day whether the list has changed, and downloads it only if it has. Off keeps the list you have; Update now still checks.
chinese: 競賽進行期間，Nexus 每天最多向該站點詢問一次清單是否有變化，僅在變化時下載。關閉則保留現有清單；「立即更新」仍會檢查。

english: No list yet. It downloads the first time a contest starts.
chinese: 尚無清單。首次開始競賽時會自動下載。

english: The last check failed: {{error}}. The list you have is still used.
chinese: 上次檢查失敗：{{error}}。仍使用現有清單。

english: Unassisted mode is on, so Super Check Partial and call history are off until it ends.
chinese: 無輔助模式已開啟，因此 Super Check Partial 與呼號歷史在被關閉期間不可用。

english: A call-history file you choose, in N1MM’s format. As you type a call that is in it, Nexus fills the exchange boxes it can check (a county, state, section or zone the contest accepts) and marks them; what you type always wins. A file is used only for the contest it was imported for, and never leaves this computer.
chinese: 你自行選擇的呼號歷史檔案，採用 N1MM 格式。當你輸入的呼號在其中時，Nexus 會填入它可核驗的交換資訊框（本競賽接受的縣、州、分區或區域）並加以標記；你輸入的內容始終優先。檔案僅用於匯入時指定的競賽，且絕不離開本機。

english: Fill the exchange from call history
chinese: 用呼號歷史填充交換資訊

english: The file will be used for the contest picked above: {{contest}}.
chinese: 該檔案將用於上方選定的競賽：{{contest}}。
已為 {{contest}} 匯入 {{count}} 個呼號。

english: That file could not be imported: {{error}}
This file is for {{contest}}, not the contest picked above, so it is not used now.
chinese: 該檔案屬於 {{contest}}，不是上方選定的競賽，因此目前未使用。

english: With ESM on, Enter in the contest log strip sends the contact’s next message from your F-keys, and the contact logs at its last step. ESM is off until you turn it on, in each cockpit separately. Enter never turns TX on, and nothing is sent by a timer.
chinese: 開啟 ESM 後，在競賽日誌條中按 Enter 會透過你的 F 鍵傳送該聯絡的下一條訊息，聯絡在其最後一步被記錄。ESM 預設關閉，需在各駕駛艙中分別開啟。Enter 絕不會開啟發射，也不會由定時器觸發任何傳送。

english: Enter plays the voice keyer’s recordings. When you are running, you say his call and your exchange yourself: a recording cannot say a callsign.
chinese: Enter 會播放語音鍵控中的錄音。主叫時，對方的呼號和你的交換資訊需要你自己說出：錄音無法念出呼號。

english: In search and pounce, your call goes once per station. The next Enter asks for a repeat instead of sending your call again.
chinese: 在搜尋呼叫中，對每個台站只傳送一次你的呼號。下一次按 Enter 會請求對方重複，而不是重發你的呼號。

english: This profile uses the built-in sets, so its steps in a contest are theirs. To map your own keys, customize the profile in Settings ▸ CW.
chinese: 該方案使用內建按鍵組，因此競賽中的步驟即為內建步驟。要自訂按鍵對映，請在 設定 ▸ CW 中定製該方案。

english: Saved with this profile. A step with no key sends nothing, and the strip names it.
chinese: 隨該方案儲存。未指定按鍵的步驟不傳送任何內容，日誌條會標出該步驟。

english: Each set keeps its own mapping. A key you changed in the cockpit keeps its place, so its step sends your text.
chinese: 每個按鍵組儲存各自的對映。你在駕駛艙中修改過的按鍵會保留其位置，因此對應步驟會傳送你的文字。

english: Record a slot for each step you want Enter to play. An empty slot plays nothing.
chinese: 為每個希望 Enter 播放的步驟錄製一個槽位。空槽位不播放任何內容。

english: For {{contest}}, the contest picked above. Start contest… walks you through its setup and turns Contest mode on; Stop contest… offers the end-of-contest checklist and turns it off. Both take effect at once. When it is on, the log strips in every mode, the Contest screen and the exports follow its rules.
chinese: 針對上方選定的競賽 {{contest}}。「開始競賽…」會引導你完成設定並開啟競賽模式；「停止競賽…」會提供賽後清單並將其關閉。兩者立即生效。開啟後，各模式的日誌條、競賽面板與匯出都會遵循其規則。

english: Set your Class + Section to start operating. Contest mode is on, but the station won't enter {{contest}} until both are filled in below.
chinese: 設定你的等級 + 分區後才能開始操作。競賽模式已開啟，但在下方兩項都填好之前，台站不會進入 {{contest}}。

english: Number of transmitters + class letter: A=club/group portable, B=1–2 person portable, C=mobile, D=home (mains power), E=home (emergency power), F=EOC. E.g. 3A = 3 transmitters, club portable.
chinese: 發射機數量 + 等級字母：A=俱樂部/團體便攜，B=1–2 人便攜，C=移動，D=居家（市電），E=居家（應急電源），F=應急指揮中心。例如 3A = 3 部發射機、俱樂部便攜。

english: The number of transmitters (your class), then your category letter: H=Home, I=Indoor, O=Outdoor, M=Mobile (e.g. 2O = 2 transmitters, outdoor).
chinese: 發射機數量（即你的等級），然後是類別字母：H=在家、I=室內、O=室外、M=移動（例如 2O = 2 台發射機、室外）。

english: “{{section}}” isn't a known ARRL/RAC section — pick one from the list.
chinese: 「{{section}}」 不是已知的 ARRL/RAC 分區 — 請從清單中選擇一個。

english: “{{section}}” ({{name}}) is no longer an ARRL/RAC section — it was replaced by {{successors}}. Pick the one you operate from.
chinese: 「{{section}}」（{{name}}）已不再是 ARRL/RAC 分區 — 它已被 {{successors}} 取代。請選擇你實際操作的地區。

english: Your ARRL / RAC section (e.g. WI, ENY, ONN). Start typing the code or a state name and pick from the list — validated against all {{count}} sections. Required for the Cabrillo log.
chinese: 你的 ARRL / RAC 分區（例如 WI、ENY、ONN）。開始輸入程式碼或州名，然後從清單中選擇 — 會對照全部 {{count}} 個分區進行校驗。Cabrillo 日誌必填。

english: Runs entirely on battery or other natural power, ≤5W output
chinese: 完全依靠電池或其他自然能源執行，輸出 ≤5W

english: 100W or less from any power source

chinese: 超過 100W — 市電/發電機供電

english: Multiplies your QSO points. QRP/battery = ×5 (ARRL bonus for going off-grid). Choose before the event.
chinese: 乘以你的 QSO 得分。QRP/電池 = ×5（ARRL 對離網執行的加分）。請在活動開始前選好。

english: Rules data downloaded — applies at next launch (data {{date}}).
chinese: 規則資料已下載 — 下次啟動時生效（資料 {{date}}）。
規則資料已是最新（資料 {{date}}）。

english: Update downloaded (data {{date}}) — applies at next launch.
chinese: 更新已下載（資料 {{date}}）— 下次啟動時生效。

english: Rules data is from {{year}} — check for updates before the event.
chinese: 規則資料來自 {{year}} 年 — 請在活動前檢查更新。
正在使用內建規則資料。

english: Scoring, dates, exchanges and multipliers for every contest in the Contest list above. Checked on demand; a downloaded update applies at the next launch.
chinese: 上方競賽清單中每項競賽的計分、日期、交換資訊與倍數規則。按需檢查；下載的更新在下次啟動時生效。

english: Three names, three different jobs — the club call goes on the air, the position is which tent you are sitting in, and the operator is whoever is at the key right now. Changing one of them here changes it everywhere in Nexus: the callsign and the operator are the same two boxes the Station tab holds.
chinese: 三個名稱，三項不同的職責 — 上天的是呼號，位置名錶示你坐在哪個帳篷裡，操作員則是此刻正按著電鍵的那個人。在這裡改動其中一項，Nexus 全域性都會同步：呼號與操作員就是「電台」標籤頁裡的那兩個輸入框。

english: The call that goes on the air and onto every contact you log — at a club event that is the club's call, the same one at every position on site.
chinese: 上天並寫入你每一份聯絡記錄的呼號 — 在俱樂部活動中就是俱樂部的呼號，場地內每個位置都用同一個。

english: Which tent, trailer or table this station is — it names you on the club band board so everyone can see which position is on which band, and it never goes on the air.
chinese: 這個電台在哪個帳篷、拖車或桌前 — 它會在俱樂部的波段板上標出你，讓所有人看到哪個位置在哪個波段上，並且它從不上天。
留空 = 使用上方呼號

english: Whoever is running this position right now — change it every time someone takes the seat, and their contacts are stamped with it (ADIF OPERATOR) so the club can split the log by operator afterwards.
chinese: 此刻正在操作這個位置的人 — 每次換人都要更新，其聯絡會打上此標記（ADIF OPERATOR），便於俱樂部事後按操作員拆分日誌。

english: Merges every position's contacts into one club log on this PC — and opens a port on your local network (the only time Nexus listens beyond this computer).
chinese: 把每個位置的聯絡合併成本機上的同一份俱樂部日誌 — 並在你的區域網上開一個連線埠（這是 Nexus 唯一一次在本機之外監聽）。

english: A club event uses TCP {{host}} (the Host port), UDP {{search}} (Find club events) and TCP {{board}} (the club TV scoreboard). A firewall that is on must let Nexus in on them.
chinese: 俱樂部活動使用 TCP {{host}}（主機連線埠）、UDP {{search}}（查詢俱樂部活動）和 TCP {{board}}（俱樂部電視比分板）。已開啟的防火牆必須放行 Nexus 使用這些連線埠。
允許 Nexus 透過 Windows 防火牆
移除 Nexus 的防火牆規則

english: Nexus could not read Windows Firewall on this laptop.
chinese: Nexus 無法讀取本機的 Windows 防火牆。

english: Windows Firewall is off on this laptop for Private and Public networks, so there is nothing to allow.
chinese: 本機的 Windows 防火牆在專用和公用網路上均已關閉，因此無需放行。

english: Nexus has no club sync rule in Windows Firewall on this laptop yet.
chinese: Nexus 在本機的 Windows 防火牆中還沒有俱樂部同步規則。

english: Nexus's club sync rules in Windows Firewall are out of date (made for another port, or another copy of Nexus). Press Allow Nexus through Windows Firewall again.
chinese: Nexus 在 Windows 防火牆中的俱樂部同步規則已過期（為其他連線埠或另一個 Nexus 副本建立）。請再次點選「允許 Nexus 透過 Windows 防火牆」。

english: Nexus's club sync rules are in Windows Firewall for Private and Public networks: TCP {{host}}, UDP {{search}} and TCP {{board}}.
chinese: Nexus 的俱樂部同步規則已在 Windows 防火牆的專用和公用網路中生效：TCP {{host}}、UDP {{search}} 和 TCP {{board}}。

english: Windows also blocks Nexus on Private networks with a rule of its own (what Cancel at its question leaves), and a block wins over every allow. Delete it in Windows Defender Firewall ▸ Advanced settings ▸ Inbound Rules: the Nexus rules with a block sign.
chinese: Windows 還會用自己的規則在專用網路上阻止 Nexus（即在其詢問時點「取消」所留下的那條），而阻止優先於任何放行。請到「Windows Defender 防火牆 ▸ 進階設定 ▸ 入站規則」中刪除帶阻止標誌的 Nexus 規則。

english: Windows also blocks Nexus on Public networks with a rule of its own (what Cancel at its question leaves), and a block wins over every allow. Delete it in Windows Defender Firewall ▸ Advanced settings ▸ Inbound Rules: the Nexus rules with a block sign.
chinese: Windows 還會用自己的規則在公用網路上阻止 Nexus（即在其詢問時點「取消」所留下的那條），而阻止優先於任何放行。請到「Windows Defender 防火牆 ▸ 進階設定 ▸ 入站規則」中刪除帶阻止標誌的 Nexus 規則。

english: Windows also blocks Nexus on Private and Public networks with rules of its own (what Cancel at its question leaves), and a block wins over every allow. Delete them in Windows Defender Firewall ▸ Advanced settings ▸ Inbound Rules: the Nexus rules with a block sign.
chinese: Windows 還會用自己的規則在專用和公用網路上阻止 Nexus（即在其詢問時點「取消」所留下的那些），而阻止優先於任何放行。請到「Windows Defender 防火牆 ▸ 進階設定 ▸ 入站規則」中刪除帶阻止標誌的 Nexus 規則。

english: Windows Firewall blocks every incoming connection on Private networks, whatever is allowed. Turn that off under Windows Security ▸ Firewall & network protection ▸ Private network.
chinese: Windows 防火牆阻止專用網路上的所有入站連線，無論放行了什麼。請在「Windows 安全中心 ▸ 防火牆和網路保護 ▸ 專用網路」中關閉該設定。

english: Windows Firewall blocks every incoming connection on Public networks, whatever is allowed. Turn that off under Windows Security ▸ Firewall & network protection ▸ Public network.
chinese: Windows 防火牆阻止公用網路上的所有入站連線，無論放行了什麼。請在「Windows 安全中心 ▸ 防火牆和網路保護 ▸ 公用網路」中關閉該設定。

english: Windows Firewall blocks every incoming connection on Private and Public networks, whatever is allowed. Turn that off for each under Windows Security ▸ Firewall & network protection.
chinese: Windows 防火牆阻止專用和公用網路上的所有入站連線，無論放行了什麼。請在「Windows 安全中心 ▸ 防火牆和網路保護」中分別關閉這兩項。

english: Windows did not add Nexus's rules: its administrator prompt was declined, or a step failed.
chinese: Windows 未新增 Nexus 的規則：管理員提示被拒絕，或某一步失敗。

english: Windows did not remove Nexus's rules: its administrator prompt was declined, or a step failed.
chinese: Windows 未移除 Nexus 的規則：管理員提示被拒絕，或某一步失敗。

english: Not while transmitting: Windows' administrator prompt takes the whole screen, Stop with it. Press again when the over ends.
chinese: 發射時不可操作：Windows 的管理員提示會佔據整個螢幕，請隨它一起停止發射，本次發射結束後再按。

english: Windows is still asking about the last press.
chinese: Windows 仍在處理上一次的請求。

english: Nexus cannot name its own program in a rule from the folder it runs from (a % in its name, or a character Windows' command line would misread). Allow Nexus by hand under Windows Security ▸ Firewall & network protection ▸ Allow an app through firewall, on Private and Public networks.
chinese: Nexus 無法在其執行所在的資料夾中用規則命名自己的程式（名稱中含 %，或含 Windows 命令列會誤讀的字元）。請手動放行：在「Windows 安全中心 ▸ 防火牆和網路保護 ▸ 允許應用透過防火牆」中，於專用和公用網路上勾選 Nexus。

english: A rule cannot name port 0: set the Host port and the scoreboard's port first.
chinese: 規則無法指定連線埠 0：請先設定主機連線埠和比分板連線埠。

english: Positions on this network can now find and join this event. There is no join password — a club site LAN is trusted, and anyone on it could add rows to the club log, which you will see. If this PC dies, enable hosting on any other position: everyone re-joins and nothing is lost.
chinese: 本網路上的位置現在可以發現並加入此活動。沒有加入密碼 — 俱樂部場地區域網是可信的，網路上的任何人都能向俱樂部日誌新增記錄，你會看到。如果這台電腦掛了，在任一其他位置啟用主辦即可：大家重新加入，什麼都不會丟。

english: Shown to joining positions and in discovery.
chinese: 顯示給加入的位置以及在發現清單中。

english: TCP port for the club sync (default 42073).
chinese: 俱樂部同步使用的 TCP 連線埠（預設 42073）。

english: host:port of the club host — use Find club events, or type it from the host's screen.
chinese: 俱樂部主機的 host:port — 可用「查詢俱樂部活動」，或照主機螢幕上顯示的地址輸入。

english: Hosting — this position joins its own event automatically.
chinese: 正在主辦 — 此位置會自動加入自己的活動。

english: Nothing heard in {{secs}} s. Check that the host has Host a club event on, that both laptops are on the same network (some Wi-Fi keeps laptops apart), and, on Windows, that this laptop's firewall lets Nexus hear the host: press Allow Nexus through Windows Firewall, above. Or type the address the host shows after “Positions join at” into Join event at.
chinese: {{secs}} 秒內沒有聽到任何響應。請確認主機已開啟「主辦俱樂部活動」，兩台電腦在同一網路上（有些 Wi-Fi 會把電腦彼此隔開），並且在 Windows 上本機防火牆允許 Nexus 聽到主機：點選上方的「允許 Nexus 透過 Windows 防火牆」。或者，把主機在「位置加入地址」後顯示的地址填入「加入活動地址」。

english: Join the event at {{host}} now. This saves only the join address; other changes here still need Save.
chinese: 立即加入 {{host}} 處的活動。此處只儲存加入地址；其他改動仍需點選儲存。

english: Serves a read-only scoreboard page for a TV or projector on this network — nothing to install on the TV, and viewers can only look. The first enable may pop a Windows Firewall prompt; allow it or viewers see nothing.
chinese: 為本網路上的電視或投影儀提供一個只讀比分板頁面 — 電視上無需安裝任何東西，觀眾只能看。首次啟用可能彈出 Windows 防火牆提示；請允許，否則觀眾什麼也看不到。

english: TCP port the scoreboard page is served on (default 7373).
chinese: 提供比分板頁面的 TCP 連線埠（預設 7373）。

english: Starting up — save settings, then this row shows the address.
chinese: 正在啟動 — 儲存設定後，此行會顯示地址。

english: When this station is a position, its TV shows the board of the host it joined, so the host needs Spectator scoreboard on too, on the same port. With no club at all, the TV says so and what to do.
chinese: 當此電台是某個位置時，它的電視顯示所加入主機的比分板，因此主機也需在同一連線埠上開啟「觀眾比分板」。若完全沒有俱樂部，電視會說明這一點以及該怎麼辦。
根據呼號歷史預測（縣界 {{line}}）：{{rule}} {{value}}

english: This build does not carry the license texts. An installed Nexus has them in resources/ui/THIRD-PARTY.txt and resources/rust/THIRD-PARTY.txt.

chinese: 用於電台控制的 COM / 串列埠裝置 — 或用「自動測試」來查詢。

english: Xiegu: the radio makes two serial ports — CAT is on the SERIAL-B one{{note}}.
chinese: Xiegu：該電台會生成兩個串列埠 — CAT 在 SERIAL-B 那個上{{note}}。
（通常是 COM 號較大的那個）

english: Icom: this radio makes two /dev/cu.* ports and only one speaks CI-V — with the Silicon Labs VCP driver it is usually the first of the pair (plain cu.SLAB_USBtoUART; the dead twin gets a numeric suffix). The other one never answers.
chinese: Icom：該電台會生成兩個 /dev/cu.* 連線埠，只有一個說 CI-V — 用 Silicon Labs VCP 驅動時通常是兩者中的第一個（純 cu.SLAB_USBtoUART；那個不通的會帶數字字尾）。另一個永遠不響應。

english: Icom: this radio makes two COM ports and only one speaks CI-V — in Device Manager it is the CP210x port marked Enhanced (Icom's driver: “Serial Port A (CI-V)”). The “Standard” / “Serial Port B” one never answers.
chinese: Icom：該電台會生成兩個 COM 口，只有一個說 CI-V — 在裝置管理器中是標為 Enhanced 的 CP210x 連線埠（Icom 驅動中名為「Serial Port A (CI-V)」）。「Standard」/「Serial Port B」那個永遠不響應。

english: Serial baud rate — match your rig's CAT setting (most modern rigs: 38,400 or 115,200). Native Icom CI-V scope needs 115,200 here and on the rig.
chinese: 串列埠波特率 — 與電台的 CAT 設定一致（多數現代電台：38,400 或 115,200）。Icom 原生 CI-V 頻譜需要此處和電台上都設為 115,200。

english: Keeps your transmitted audio between 1500–2000 Hz by shifting the TX dial in 500 Hz steps, so audio harmonics fall outside the transmit filter — cleaner signal. Rig = uses VFO B split. Fake It = retunes the VFO around each over (works on any CAT rig). None = stock WSJT-X default, transmits at the raw audio offset.
chinese: 以 500 Hz 步進移動發射頻率，把你的發射音訊保持在 1500–2000 Hz 之間，使音訊諧波落在發射濾波器之外 — 訊號更乾淨。電台 = 使用 VFO B 異頻。偽異頻 = 每次發射前後重新調諧 VFO（適用於任何 CAT 電台）。無 = WSJT-X 原始預設，按原始音訊偏移發射。

english: Nexus reads the radio’s split, so a split you set at the radio is the one it checks your licence privileges against; if the radio says it is split but not where it transmits, Nexus will not transmit. A radio whose split can only be read by moving it is never asked. Off by default.
chinese: Nexus 讀取電台的異頻狀態，因此你在電台上設定的異頻就是它用來核對你執照權限的那個；如果電台說處於異頻、卻讀不出它在哪裡發射，Nexus 將不發射。只能透過移動頻率才讀得出異頻狀態的電台，Nexus 不會去問。預設關閉。

english: How far the dial moves per mouse-wheel notch. Lower it if a high-resolution or free-spin mouse tunes too far per flick; raise it to tune faster. Applies to the frequency readout and the Phone/CW scope wheel.
chinese: 滑鼠滾輪每格移動多少頻率。若高解析度或自由滾輪滑鼠一動就跑太遠，請調低；想調得更快就調高。適用於頻率讀數以及話音/CW 頻譜上的滾輪。

english: Tells Nexus what your cable actually does, instead of letting it guess. Leave it on Auto unless you have a rig that keys at launch — Auto changes nothing about how your station works today. If you change it and CAT stops working, put it back on Auto: on some rigs Hamlib quietly refuses the setting and then answers without ever having opened the radio, so you get a CAT light and a rig that ignores you.
chinese: 告訴 Nexus 你的線纜實際做什麼，而不是讓它猜。除非你有一部啟動就發射的電台，否則保持「自動」— 自動不會改變你台站今天的工作方式。若改了之後 CAT 失效，請改回自動：在某些電台上，Hamlib 會默默拒絕該設定，然後在你根本沒開啟電台的情況下照常應答，於是你看到 CAT 指示燈亮著，電台卻對你的指令毫無反應。

english: For the one fault this exists to fix: a rig that keys at launch, before you have touched anything. Leave it on Auto unless that is happening to you — Auto changes nothing about how your station works today. If you change it and CAT stops working, put it back on Auto. Only you can see whether the rig unkeys; nobody can test this from our end, so treat it as something to try on a rig you are watching.
chinese: 專為一種故障而存在：電台在你還沒碰任何東西之前就啟動發射。除非你正遇到這種情況，否則保持「自動」— 自動不會改變你台站今天的工作方式。若改了之後 CAT 失效，請改回自動。只有你能看到電台是否停止發射；這一點我們這邊無法測試，所以請把它當作在你正盯著的那部電台上試試看的選項。

english: The power a tune-up keys at — leave it empty and Nexus never touches your power, which is what it does today. It can only turn the rig DOWN, never up: it keys at whichever is lower, this or the power you are already running, so 50 % here while you run 25 % still tunes at 25 %. On a 100 W rig, 10 % is about 10 W — enough for an antenna tuner, kind to a loop.
chinese: 調諧時使用的功率 — 留空則 Nexus 從不觸碰你的功率，也就是現在的行為。它只能把電台調低，絕不會調高：取此值與目前功率中較低的那個，所以此處設 50% 而你正跑 25% 時，仍以 25% 調諧。在 100W 電台上，10% 約 10W — 足夠驅動天調，對環形天線也溫和。

english: With the Flex native client, Tune is the radio's own carrier at the tune power set in SmartSDR ({{pct}} % now). Nexus writes no power for it, so this setting does not apply there.
chinese: 使用 Flex 原生使用者端時，「調諧」是電台自身的載波，功率為 SmartSDR 中設定的調諧功率（目前 {{pct}} %）。Nexus 不會為其寫入功率，因此此設定在那裡不適用。

english: With the Flex native client, Tune is the radio's own carrier at the tune power set in SmartSDR. Nexus writes no power for it, so this setting does not apply there.
chinese: 使用 Flex 原生使用者端時，「調諧」是電台自身的載波，功率為 SmartSDR 中設定的調諧功率。Nexus 不會為其寫入功率，因此此設定在那裡不適用。
Nexus 啟動 rigctld 所用的連線埠。
資料模式使用普通 SSB

english: Leave this off unless you know you need it. Nexus normally puts the radio in its DATA submode (DATA-U / USB-D / PKTUSB) for FT8, FT4, RTTY-AFSK and SSTV, because on most rigs that is the only mode where the USB codec reaches the transmitter. Turn this on and Nexus commands plain USB/LSB for those modes instead, and stays there — through band changes and when you call a station. Correct if your transmit audio goes in the microphone path, as with an interface wired to the mic jack (some RIGblaster models) — or if you simply prefer plain USB to the DATA submode (for its wider receive passband, say) and your rig is set to send its USB-codec audio in SSB, which on many modern rigs (FT-991A, IC-7300 and the like) is a single menu item. Either way the rig has to put the audio you're feeding onto the air in plain SSB: where it does not — the codec feeds only the data port and nothing carries in SSB — plain SSB takes audio from the mic and the radio transmits no RF at all, a red TX light and nothing on the air. Per radio, since it depends on how that rig is cabled and set. True FSK RTTY is unaffected — it keeps the rig's own RTTY mode.
chinese: 除非你確定需要，否則請保持關閉。Nexus 通常會讓電台切到 DATA 子模式（DATA-U / USB-D / PKTUSB）來跑 FT8、FT4、RTTY-AFSK 和 SSTV，因為在多數電台上，這是 USB 編解碼器唯一能到達發射機的模式。開啟此項後，Nexus 對這些模式改為命令電台使用普通 USB/LSB，並保持不變 — 跨波段切換和呼叫電台時也一樣。如果你的發射音訊走的是麥克風通路（例如接在麥克風插孔上的介面，某些 RIGblaster 型號），或者你只是更喜歡普通 USB 而非 DATA 子模式（比如為了它更寬的接收通帶），並且你的電台已設為在 SSB 下送出 USB 編解碼器的音訊（在很多現代電台上，如 FT-991A、IC-7300 之類，這只是選單裡的一項），那就選它。無論如何，電台必須把你送入的音訊以普通 SSB 送上天：若做不到 — 編解碼器只饋送資料連線埠，SSB 下沒有任何通路 — 普通 SSB 就會從麥克風取音訊，電台完全不發射頻，TX 紅燈亮著而天上一片安靜。按電台分別設定，因為這取決於該電台如何接線與設定。真正的 FSK RTTY 不受影響 — 它仍用電台自帶的 RTTY 模式。
do_not_translate: <b> | RIGblaster | DATA-U | PKTUSB | Nexus | USB-D | AFSK | DATA | RTTY | SSTV | FSK | FT4 | FT8 | LSB | SSB | USB | RF | TX | RTTY-AFSK | USB/LSB | FT-991A | IC-7300

english: Hold the data mode while SSTV is receiving
chinese: SSTV 接收期間保持資料模式

english: Keeps this radio in the data submode for the whole time the SSTV receiver is running, instead of only while a picture is queued or going out — FM-D / DATA-FM on an FM channel, and USB-D / LSB-D on HF. Off by default, which is what Nexus does today: it commands the data submode around a send and puts the radio back in plain FM or SSB in between, so a rig parked on an SSTV calling channel keeps dropping out of the data mode. That revert is deliberate — an SSTV send once keyed a data mode into an FM repeater input — but it is the wrong answer if you sit on an SSTV calling channel for the evening. Stop the receiver before you go back to voice. The receiver keeps running after you leave the SSTV screen, and while it runs this radio is held in the data submode, where transmit audio comes from the data port and your microphone modulates nothing. Per radio, since it depends on how that rig is cabled and what you use it for.
chinese: 在 SSTV 接收機執行的整段時間內，讓這部電台保持在資料子模式，而不是只在圖片排隊或傳送時才切換 — FM 頻道上為 FM-D / DATA-FM，HF 上為 USB-D / LSB-D。預設關閉，也就是 Nexus 現在的行為：它在傳送前後命令資料子模式，中間把電台切回普通 FM 或 SSB，因此停在 SSTV 呼叫頻道上的電台會不斷掉出資料模式。這種回退是有意為之 — 曾經有一次 SSTV 傳送把資料模式鍵控進了 FM 中繼的輸入端 — 但如果你整晚守在 SSTV 呼叫頻道上，這就是錯的答案。回到話音前請先停止接收機。離開 SSTV 介面後接收機仍在執行，而在它執行期間這部電台被保持在資料子模式，此時發射音訊來自資料連線埠，你的麥克風什麼也調製不了。按電台分別設定，因為這取決於該電台如何接線以及你拿它做什麼用。
do_not_translate: <b> | DATA-FM | LSB-D | Nexus | USB-D | FM-D | SSTV | SSB | FM | HF

english: Set the radio's menu 077 FM PKT PORT SELECT to USB, or beacons go out silent. With this on, APRS puts this radio in DATA-FM instead of plain FM; repeater voice stays plain FM. Off, APRS uses plain FM, as it always has.
chinese: 把電台選單 077 FM PKT PORT SELECT 設為 USB，否則信標會靜默發出。開啟此項後，APRS 會讓這部電台進入 DATA-FM 而非普通 FM；中繼話音仍為普通 FM。關閉時，APRS 使用普通 FM，一如既往。
Icom 原生 CI-V（早期體驗）

english: Nexus drives this Icom's CI-V directly instead of launching rigctld — unlocking the rig's real spectrum scope in the waterfall ("CI-V RF") and instant dial tracking. The scope needs 115200 baud, set the same on BOTH the radio and Nexus: (1) on the rig, Menu ▸ SET ▸ Connectors ▸ CI-V ▸ "CI-V USB Baud Rate" = 115200; (2) on the rig, same menu, "CI-V USB Port" = "Unlink from [REMOTE]"; (3) the Baud field above = 115200 to match. Below that the rig refuses to stream the scope (CAT still works; the panadapter just stays off). Save to apply; turn off any time to return to the classic Hamlib path.
chinese: Nexus 直接驅動這部 Icom 的 CI-V，而不啟動 rigctld — 解鎖瀑布圖中電台真正的頻譜（「CI-V RF」）與即時的頻率跟蹤。頻譜需要115200 波特率，且在電台上和 Nexus 中都設為相同值：（1）電台上，Menu ▸ SET ▸ Connectors ▸ CI-V ▸「CI-V USB Baud Rate」= 115200；（2）電台上，同一選單，「CI-V USB Port」=「Unlink from [REMOTE]」；（3）上方波特率欄位 = 115200 以匹配。低於此值電台會拒絕推送頻譜（CAT 仍可用；全景只是不亮）。儲存後生效；隨時關閉即可回到經典 Hamlib 路徑。
do_not_translate: <b> | rigctld | Hamlib | Nexus | CI-V | Icom | CAT | USB | RF

english: Which waterfall this radio draws. Radio's scope is the radio's own spectrum scope, as before. Audio is the sound card's waterfall, as on the Hamlib path: finer close to the dial than a radio scope at a wide span. With Audio the radio stops sending its scope, and native CI-V stays connected for CAT. Save to apply.
chinese: 這部電台繪製哪個瀑布圖。電台頻譜即電台自帶的頻譜，與以前一致。音訊是音效卡的瀑布圖，與 Hamlib 路徑相同：近頻率處比寬跨度下的電台頻譜更精細。選擇音訊後，電台停止傳送其頻譜，而原生 CI-V 仍保持連線以供 CAT 使用。儲存後生效。

english: Needs the native CI-V connection above: through Hamlib the waterfall is already the audio one.
chinese: 需要上方開啟原生 CI-V 連線：經 Hamlib 時瀑布圖本來就是音訊那個。

english: Stream this FlexRadio's real SmartSDR panadapter (VITA-49 FFT) into the cockpit scope — the RF spectrum around your dial, with the Flex-pan span/ref controls. Beta and unverified on hardware, so it's opt-in: needs the Flex IP set (from Find Radios) and SmartSDR reachable on this network. If the scope stays blank or the app hitches, turn it back off. Save to apply.
chinese: 把這部 FlexRadio 真正的 SmartSDR 全景（VITA-49 FFT）串流到操作台頻譜中 — 你頻率周圍的射頻頻譜，帶 Flex 全景的跨度/參考電平控制元件。Beta 且未在硬體上驗證，因此需主動開啟：需要設定 Flex IP（來自「查詢電台」）且本網路可訪問 SmartSDR。若頻譜一直空白或程式卡頓，請關掉它。儲存後生效。
FT-710 射頻頻譜（經 USB 傳輸頻譜）

english: Read the FT-710's own spectrum over its internal USB-SPI bridge instead of the sound card
chinese: 經其內部 USB-SPI 橋接讀取 FT-710 自帶的頻譜，而不是音效卡

english: Draws the radio's own band scope instead of the sound card's 4 kHz slice. Needs SCU-LAN10 enabled in the radio's EX menu, and a build that carries FTDI's LibFT4222 — which is not bundled, because it is closed source and Nexus is GPL-3.0-only. If either is missing the app says which, rather than leaving the panel empty.
chinese: 繪製電台自帶的波段頻譜，而不是音效卡的那 4 kHz 切片。需要在電台 EX 選單中啟用 SCU-LAN10，且構建版本包含 FTDI 的 LibFT4222 — 該庫未隨附，因為它是閉源的，而 Nexus 僅採用 GPL-3.0-only。若缺少其一，程式會說明缺的是哪個，而不是讓面板空著。
do_not_translate: <b> | GPL-3.0-only | LibFT4222 | SCU-LAN10 | Nexus | FTDI | kHz | EX

chinese: Flex 原生 DAX 音訊（Beta）

english: Carry this FlexRadio's audio over the network (VITA-49 DAX) instead of the "DAX Audio RX" / "DAX TX" sound devices, which are invisible under Remote Desktop. Needs Flex native client (Beta) on. With SmartSDR CAT this does nothing: audio stays on the sound devices, and the setting is kept for the client. On the client, the decoders read receive audio straight from the radio, and digital modes and the Remote stream's voice transmit over DAX. Phone at the shack keeps the radio's own mic, so the voice keyer can't play there. Turning this off or disconnecting puts your own DAX setting back, and Nexus never changes it while SmartSDR's DAX is connected. Beta, unverified on hardware: if decodes or transmit stop, turn it back off. Save to apply.
chinese: 透過網路（VITA-49 DAX）傳輸這部 FlexRadio 的音訊，而不是用「DAX Audio RX」/「DAX TX」聲音裝置 — 那兩個在遠端桌面下不可見。需開啟 Flex 原生使用者端（Beta）。配 SmartSDR CAT 時此項不起作用：音訊仍走聲音裝置，該設定只為使用者端保留。在使用者端下，解碼器直接從電台讀取接收音訊，數字模式與 Remote 串流的話音發射走 DAX。台站現場的話音仍用電台自帶的麥克風，因此語音鍵控器在那裡放不出聲音。關閉此項或斷開連線會恢復你自己的 DAX 設定，而 Nexus 在 SmartSDR 的 DAX 已連線時從不改動它。Beta，未在硬體上驗證：若解碼或發射停止，請關掉它。儲存後生效。
do_not_translate: <b> | FlexRadio | SmartSDR | VITA-49 | Remote | Nexus | CAT | DAX | RX | TX

english: Nexus connects to the radio itself, at the Flex radio IP, as one of its SmartSDR clients, and runs CAT and PTT on a slice of its own. Beta and unverified on hardware: try transmit into a dummy load first. If Nexus cannot connect, it falls back to SmartSDR CAT. Save to apply.
chinese: Nexus 在 Flex 電台 IP 處作為其 SmartSDR 使用者端之一直接連線電台，並在自己專屬的 slice 上執行 CAT 與 PTT。Beta 且未在硬體上驗證：請先接假負載試發射。若 Nexus 無法連線，會回退到 SmartSDR CAT。儲存後生效。

english: Let Nexus send CW, Tune and ATU through the native Flex client (not yet bench-tested)
chinese: 允許 Nexus 透過 Flex 原生使用者端傳送 CW、調諧和使用天調（尚未實測）

english: Not yet checked on a real Flex: try CW, Tune and the ATU into a dummy load first. Off by default. Save to apply; Nexus reconnects to the radio.
chinese: 尚未在真實 Flex 上驗證：請先接假負載試 CW、調諧和天調。預設關閉。儲存後生效；Nexus 會重連電台。

english: Could not toggle the CI-V diagnostic log
chinese: 無法切換 CI-V 診斷日誌

english: Recording to {{path}} — this keeps running while you're on other screens, so go to the FT8 or Phone cockpit and reproduce the issue (Tune or transmit) now. Come back and turn it off when done, then send that file. It shows exactly what's on the bus during the fault.
chinese: 正在錄製到 {{path}} — 你去別的介面時它仍在執行，所以現在請到 FT8 或話音操作台復現問題（調諧或發射）。完成後回來關掉它，然後把該檔案發來。它會精確記錄故障期間匯流排上的內容。

english: Records every byte to/from the radio on the native CI-V path to a file in your Downloads — a support tool for hardware-only issues like the IC-9700 PTT flicker. Turn on, reproduce the problem, turn off, then send the file.
chinese: 在原生 CI-V 路徑上，把與電台往返的每個位元組記錄到「下載」資料夾中的檔案裡 — 這是針對僅硬體可見問題的支援工具，例如 IC-9700 的 PTT 閃爍。開啟、復現問題、關閉，然後傳送該檔案。
Flex 電台 IP（原生全景 + DAX）

english: Your FlexRadio's LAN IP (SmartSDR API, port 4992) — turns on the native RF panadapter. This is the radio's address, not the SmartSDR-CAT port above.
chinese: 你 FlexRadio 的區域網 IP（SmartSDR API，連線埠 4992）— 用於開啟原生射頻全景。這是電台的地址，不是上方的 SmartSDR-CAT 連線埠。

english: The "Share this radio" address other programs connect to (Hamlib NET rigctl default 4532). Change it only if something else on this computer already owns the port.
chinese: 其他程式連線用的「共享此電台」地址（Hamlib NET rigctl 預設 4532）。只有當本機上已有別的程式佔用了該連線埠時才需更改。

english: Save settings, connect to the rig, and read its frequency
chinese: 儲存設定、連線電台並讀取其頻率

english: Play receive audio on this computer

Plays the RECEIVED audio — exactly what the decoder hears — out of a device on this computer, for level and RFI diagnosis or simply to listen to the band. This is not a transmit monitor: it never plays your own voice back. Off by default; UNVERIFIED on-air until the attended session.
chinese: 把接收到的音訊 — 也就是解碼器聽到的完全相同的內容 — 從本機的某個裝置播放出來，用於電平和 RFI 診斷，或單純聽波段。這不是發射監聽：它從不回放你自己的聲音。預設關閉；在有人值守的實測之前屬於未驗證功能。

english: Your headphones or speakers — must NOT be the rig's TX output device.
chinese: 你的耳機或音箱 — 絕不能是電台的 TX 輸出裝置。

english: Headphone listening volume (does not affect TX).
chinese: 耳機收聽的音量（不影響 TX）。

english: Where the RF scope's picture comes from: the radio's own panadapter (or the sound card's audio where the radio has none), or an SDRplay RSP receiver through SDRconnect. SDRconnect is SDRplay's own program, free and closed-source, which you install and run beside Nexus with its WebSocket API turned on; it serves every RSP except the original RSP1.
chinese: 射頻頻譜的畫面來自哪裡：電台自帶的全景（電台沒有時用音效卡的音訊），或經 SDRconnect 接入的 SDRplay RSP 接收機。SDRconnect 是 SDRplay 自家的程式，免費但閉源，你在 Nexus 旁邊安裝並執行它，並開啟其 WebSocket API；它支援除初代 RSP1 之外的所有 RSP。

english: SDRconnect draws the receiver's whole span with each station at its own frequency, centred on the rig's dial. Receive only: Nexus never transmits through it and sends it no CAT.
chinese: SDRconnect 會畫出接收機的整個跨度，每個電台都在自己的頻率上，以電台的頻率為中心。僅接收：Nexus 從不經它發射，也不向它傳送 CAT。

english: 127.0.0.1 is this computer. Put the name or address of another computer if SDRconnect runs there.
chinese: 127.0.0.1 表示本機。若 SDRconnect 執行在其他電腦上，請填入其名稱或地址。

english: SDRconnect's WebSocket API port: 5454 unless you moved it in SDRconnect.
chinese: SDRconnect 的 WebSocket API 連線埠：預設為 5454，除非你在 SDRconnect 中改過。

english: Keep the dial in the centre
Retune only when the dial nears the edge
chinese: 僅在頻率接近邊緣時重新調諧

english: How the receiver's centre follows the rig's dial. Retuning only near the edge moves SDRconnect's own display far less.
chinese: 接收機中心如何跟隨電台頻率。僅在接近邊緣時重新調諧，對 SDRconnect 自身顯示畫面的移動要小得多。

english: Feed the receiver from the rig's RX OUT, or from a splitter with transmit protection, never from a plain T-piece on the transmit line: an RSP takes at most 0 dBm, and 100 W is +50 dBm.
chinese: 請從電台的 RX OUT 或帶發射保護的分路器給接收機饋送訊號，絕不要用發射線上的普通 T 型接頭：RSP 最大只能承受 0 dBm，而 100 W 是 +50 dBm。

english: Corrects both legs of a pass: the downlink you listen on and the uplink you transmit on. Nexus tunes only while auto-track is following a pass and you have picked a transponder in the Satellites section. The downlink needs no setup here; the uplink is confirmed once per radio, on the pass itself.
chinese: 對一次過境的兩條鏈路都做校正：你收聽的下行和你發射的上行。僅當自動跟蹤正在跟隨某次過境、且你在「衛星」區選定了轉發器時，Nexus 才會調諧。下行無需在此設定；上行則需按電台分別確認，且要在過境當時進行。

english: Retunes the radio through a pass so you stay on the station you are working. On: the downlink follows the bird as soon as you arm a pass and hold a transponder. Clearing this stops both legs.
chinese: 在過境期間重新調諧電台，讓你始終停留在正在通聯的電台頻率上。開啟後：一旦你備好某次過境並保持選定轉發器，下行就會跟隨衛星。清除此項會同時停止兩條鏈路。

english: The uplink mapping is confirmed per radio, for the radio you are operating. Confirm it for this radio on the pass rail during a pass, or make it the active radio first.
chinese: 上行對映按電台分別確認，針對你目前操作的電台。請在過境時於過境欄上為這部電台確認，或先把它設為目前電台。

english: Which VFO carries your uplink. Match this to how your radio is wired. A wrong mapping transmits on your own downlink — into the satellite's output passband, on top of everyone else working the bird. Picking one applies immediately and confirms it for the radio you are operating; a second radio gets its own confirmation on the pass rail. Every mapping except Uplink only keeps the downlink corrected.
chinese: 哪個 VFO 承載你的上行。請與你的電台接線方式相符。對映錯誤會在你自己的下行上發射 — 打進衛星的輸出通帶，壓在其他所有聯絡這顆衛星的人身上。選擇後立即生效，並為目前操作的電台完成確認；第二部電台需在過境欄上單獨確認。除「僅上行」外，所有對映都會保持下行校正。
重新調諧前的最小多普勒偏移（Hz）

english: Corrections smaller than this are not sent. 20 Hz is inaudible on SSB and keeps the CAT link quiet. 0 sends every update.
chinese: 小於此值的校正不會傳送。20 Hz 在 SSB 上聽不出來，且能讓 CAT 鏈路保持安靜。0 表示每次更新都傳送。

english: Shortest gap between corrections. 1000 ms is what a low-orbit pass needs. Shorter fights your own tuning knob and saturates a serial CAT link.
chinese: 兩次校正之間的最短間隔。低軌過境需要 1000 ms。更短會與你自己的調諧旋鈕打架，並使串列埠 CAT 鏈路飽和。

english: Audible tones at pass start and end
chinese: 過境開始與結束時的提示音

english: A rising tone the moment an armed pass starts and a falling one when it ends, alongside the popup — hear AOS with your hands on the rotor. On by default; clearing this silences only the tones, never the popups.
chinese: 已備好的過境開始時響起一個上升音，結束時響起下降音，與彈窗同時出現 — 讓你雙手扶著旋轉器也能聽見 AOS。預設開啟；清除此項只會靜音提示音，絕不會關掉彈窗。

english: Import a downloaded element file (Celestrak TLE, AMSAT keps, a new launch's SupGP set) — the offline-shack escape hatch. Imports persist across refreshes; the newest epoch per satellite wins.
chinese: 匯入已下載的根數檔案（Celestrak TLE、AMSAT 根數、新發射衛星的 SupGP 集）— 離線台站的應急出口。匯入內容在重新整理後仍保留；每顆衛星以最新曆元為準。
根數已匯入 — 匯入 {{imported}} 條，共 {{total}} 條

english: Not loaded yet — fetched on first launch, then refreshed every 6 h.
chinese: 尚未載入 — 首次啟動時獲取，之後每 6 小時重新整理一次。

english: Keplerian elements (TLEs) for the amateur satellites — pass times, pointing and Doppler all come from them. Refreshed every 6 h from hamradiotools.io: the bird list comes from the SatNOGS database (CC BY-SA 4.0), the elements from CelesTrak and SatNOGS. Import a file for an offline shack or a just-launched bird.
chinese: 業餘衛星的開普勒根數（TLE）— 過境時間、指向和多普勒都由它推算。每 6 小時從 hamradiotools.io 重新整理：衛星清單來自 SatNOGS 資料庫（CC BY-SA 4.0），根數來自 CelesTrak 和 SatNOGS。離線台站或剛發射的衛星則可匯入檔案。

english: Connect a supported amplifier on its own serial port to see power, SWR, temperature and alarms. Use the cockpit controls for Operate/Standby and band steps. Set automatic band following below.
chinese: 在獨立串列埠上連線受支援的功放，即可檢視功率、駐波比、溫度和告警。用操作台控制元件進行「執行/待機」和波段步進。自動波段跟隨在下方設定。

english: Place the Amplifier pane in Conditions to see the readings. Nothing here changes how the radio transmits.
chinese: 在「條件」中放置功放面板即可檢視讀數。此處任何設定都不會改變電台的發射方式。

english: Step the amplifier to the band you are on, without being asked. Off by default — this is the one amplifier control that acts on its own. It never moves the amplifier while you are transmitting, and it steps one band at a time, checking where the amplifier actually is after each one rather than assuming it got there. ⚠️ If your amplifier already follows the radio through its own band-data cable, as most SPE installations do, leave this off: the hardware is doing the same job, and two things steering one band is worse than either alone.
chinese: 無需詢問即把功放步進到你所在的波段。預設關閉 — 這是唯一會自行動作的功放控制元件。它在發射時絕不移動功放，並且一次只步進一個波段，每步之後檢查功放實際所在位置，而不是假定它已經到了。⚠️ 如果你的功放已透過其自帶的波段資料線跟隨電台（多數 SPE 安裝方式如此），請保持關閉：硬體在做同一件事，兩套東西同時操控一個波段比只用其一更糟。

english: Its own port, not the one CAT uses — a serial port can only be open once, so sharing it stops the radio connecting. The speed is worked out for you.
chinese: 用它自己的連線埠，不是 CAT 用的那個 — 串列埠只能開啟一次，共用會讓電台連不上。速率會自動推算。

english: A KPA1500 on your network can be reached by its IP address instead of a cable. The KPA500 has no network port.
chinese: 網上的 KPA1500 可以用 IP 地址訪問，無需線纜。KPA500 沒有網口。

english: Shown on the KPA1500’s NET IP ADDRESS menu. Nexus talks to the amplifier’s UDP server, which any number of programs can use at once, so Elecraft’s KPA1500 Remote can stay connected beside it.
chinese: 顯示在 KPA1500 的 NET IP ADDRESS 選單中。Nexus 與功放的 UDP 伺服器通訊，該伺服器可同時供任意多個程式使用，因此 Elecraft 的 KPA1500 Remote 可以同時保持連線。

english: 1500 unless you changed the amplifier’s command port.
chinese: 預設為 1500，除非你改過功放的命令連線埠。

english: The rotator itself, and its pointing manners. The manners apply to satellite auto-track.
chinese: 旋轉器本身，以及它的指向習慣。「習慣」適用於衛星自動跟蹤。
其他 Hamlib 型號編號…

english: Hamlib rotator model number (rotctl -l lists them)
chinese: Hamlib 旋轉器型號編號（rotctl -l 可列出）

english: Nexus runs the control daemon (rotctld) for you, the same way it does CAT. Then use the Rotor pane in Conditions, ↗ on Needed rows, or the compass anywhere.
chinese: Nexus 會替你執行控制常駐程式（rotctld），就像它對 CAT 所做的那樣。隨後可用「條件」中的旋轉器面板、「需要」行上的 ↗，或任意位置的羅盤。
旋轉器連線埠與波特率

english: Serial baud rate for the rotator controller
chinese: 旋轉器控制器的串列埠波特率

english: Match the rate your controller is set to — Hamlib does not offer one fixed rate for this model.
chinese: 與你的控制器所設的速率一致 — Hamlib 對該型號不提供固定速率。

english: This controller runs at {{rate}} baud — the rate its Hamlib backend declares. Leave it here.
chinese: 此控制器以 {{rate}} 波特率執行 — 這是其 Hamlib 後端宣告的速率。保持此值。

english: This controller runs at {{rate}} baud, not {{set}} — at the wrong rate it never answers and reads as broken hardware. Set {{rate}}, or re-pick the model above to fill it in.
chinese: 此控制器以 {{rate}} 波特率執行，而不是 {{set}} — 速率不對它永遠不會應答，看起來就像硬體壞了。請設為 {{rate}}，或重新選擇上方型號以自動填入。

english: PstRotatorAz: enter {{address}} as the port (its UDP Control Port), and turn on UDP Control in its Setup (the baud is not used). Nexus listens for its replies on that port + 1, {{reply}}, so no other program may use it.
chinese: PstRotatorAz：把 {{address}} 作為連線埠填入（其 UDP 控制連線埠），並在其 Setup 中開啟 UDP Control（波特率不使用）。Nexus 會在該連線埠 + 1 即 {{reply}} 上監聽其回覆，因此其他程式不得佔用它。
外部 rotctld 地址（進階）

english: Point Nexus at a rotctld you run yourself (or one on another machine). It OVERRIDES the model and port above and stops the integrated daemon. Needs the port — a bare host name is not an address.
chinese: 讓 Nexus 指向你自己執行的 rotctld（或另一台機器上的）。它會覆蓋上方的型號與連線埠，並停用內建常駐程式。必須帶連線埠 — 只有主機名不算地址。
停放位置（° 方位角 / 仰角）

english: The stow position — wind-safe, or wherever your mast rests. Used only when After a pass is set to Park.
chinese: 收存位置 — 抗風安全處，或你的桅杆平時停的位置。僅在「過境結束後」設為「停放」時使用。
待命位置（° 方位角 / 仰角）

english: Where the antenna waits for the next pass. Used only when After a pass is set to Ready.
chinese: 天線等待下一次過境的位置。僅在「過境結束後」設為「待命」時使用。

english: What the rotator does after a pass
chinese: 過境結束後旋轉器的動作

english: Stop — leave the antenna where the pass ended
chinese: 停止 — 讓天線停在過境結束時的指向

english: Park — drive to the park position
chinese: 停放 — 轉到停放位置

english: Ready — drive to the ready position
chinese: 待命 — 轉到待命位置

english: Stop is the default and moves nothing: the antenna stays pointed where the bird set. Park and Ready drive the rotator on their own at LOS, so set those positions above first.
chinese: 「停止」是預設且不動任何東西：天線停在衛星把它留下的指向。「停放」和「待命」會在 LOS 時自行驅動旋轉器，所以請先在上面設好對應位置。
容差（° 方位角 / 仰角）

english: A new target closer than this is not commanded. Without a deadband the rotator hunts and the relays chatter for the whole pass. 2° is about a G-5500's own resolution.
chinese: 新目標與目前指向的差值小於此值時不傳送指令。沒有死區的話，旋轉器會整場過境來回搜尋，繼電器嗒嗒作響。2° 大致相當於 G-5500 自身的解析度。
校準修正（° 方位角 / 仰角）

english: Added to every command. Use it when the controller reads one heading and the boom points at another.
chinese: 加到每條指令上。當控制器讀出一個方向而橫樑實際指向另一個方向時使用。

english: Allow the rotator to flip past 90 degrees elevation
chinese: 允許旋轉器翻越高仰角（超過 90°）

english: Takes a high pass by turning azimuth 180° and running elevation past 90°, instead of swinging the mast around at the top of the pass. Off by default: many rotators cannot mechanically go past 90° elevation. Check your controller before turning this on.
chinese: 對付高仰角過境時，把方位角轉 180° 並讓仰角越過 90°，而不是在過境最高點把桅杆繞一大圈。預設關閉：許多旋轉器在機械上無法超過 90° 仰角。開啟前請確認你的控制器支援。
你的第一次 FT8 聯絡

english: Reading this changes no setting and transmits nothing.
chinese: 閱讀此內容不會改動任何設定，也不會發射。

english: Listen first. With the radio connected and on an FT8 frequency, the stations Nexus hears appear in Band Activity every 15 seconds.
chinese: 先聽。電台已連線並處於 FT8 頻率上時，Nexus 每 15 秒會把聽到的電台顯示在「波段活動」中。

english: A line with CQ is a station calling anyone. A higher dB number is a stronger signal.
chinese: 帶 CQ 的一行是某台在呼叫任何人。dB 數值越大，訊號越強。

english: Double-click that line to answer it. That turns TX on: Nexus starts calling the station right away, or on the next period, and sends each message of the contact for you.
chinese: 按兩下該行即可應答。這會開啟 TX：Nexus 會立刻或在下一個週期開始呼叫該台，並替你傳送這次聯絡中的每條訊息。

english: Double-click that line to answer it. TX stays off, because {{setting}} is off in Settings: press {{txOff}} to turn TX on, then Nexus calls the station and sends each message of the contact for you.
chinese: 按兩下該行即可應答。TX 保持關閉，因為設定中的 {{setting}} 已關閉：按 {{txOff}} 開啟 TX，隨後 Nexus 就會呼叫該台並替你傳送這次聯絡中的每條訊息。

english: TX starts off each time Nexus opens ({{txOff}}). {{stop}} ends a transmission at once; {{txOn}} turns TX off once the current period ends.
chinese: Nexus 每次啟動時 TX 都是關閉的（{{txOff}}）。{{stop}} 可立即結束發射；{{txOn}} 會在目前週期結束後關閉 TX。

english: Showing the settings you need first. The rest of this tab is folded to its headings.
chinese: 先顯示你需要的設定。此標籤頁的其餘部分已摺疊到各自的標題下。

english: Operate your station from this computer
chinese: 從這台電腦操作你的台站

english: Finds your station on this network, or reaches it over the internet when you sign in with your Nexus Remote account. F11 switches the window to full screen and back, and Esc over the picture still stops transmitting.
chinese: 在本網路上查詢你的台站，或在你登入 Nexus Remote 帳戶後經網際網路接入。F11 可切換全螢幕與恢復視窗，畫面上按 Esc 仍會停止發射。

english: Nexus could not open the Connect to my station window. Try again.
chinese: Nexus 無法開啟「連線到我的台站」視窗。請重試。

english: Log each completed contact to the ADIF logbook by itself. A contact you opened by clicking their RR73 or RRR exchanges no reports and is never logged by itself: it waits for your confirm in the popup.
chinese: 自動把每次完成的聯絡記入 ADIF 日誌。你透過點選對方 RR73 或 RRR 發起的聯絡沒有交換報告，絕不會自動記錄：它會在彈窗中等待你確認。

english: Open a popup to check and edit each completed contact (WSJT-X “Prompt me to log QSO”). It opens by itself with Auto-log on or off and holds each contact until you log or discard it; if 64 are left waiting, the oldest is logged, never one you opened by clicking their RR73 or RRR. With both off, nothing is logged until you press Log.
chinese: 為每次完成的聯絡彈出視窗，供你核對和編輯（即 WSJT-X 的「Prompt me to log QSO」）。無論是否開啟自動記錄它都會彈出，並保留每次聯絡直到你記錄或丟棄；若積壓到 64 條，最舊的一條會被記錄，但絕不會記錄你透過點選對方 RR73 或 RRR 發起的那一條。兩者都關閉時，在你按「記錄」之前什麼都不會記入。

english: Write the exchanged reports into the logged QSO’s comment, e.g. “FT8  Sent: -07  Rcvd: -12” — the same format WSJT-X uses.
chinese: 把交換的報告寫入已記錄 QSO 的備註，例如「FT8  Sent: -07  Rcvd: -12」— 與 WSJT-X 使用的格式相同。
用 RRR 確認收到（不用 RR73）

english: Acknowledge the final report with a bare RRR (partner still owes a 73) instead of the combined RR73. Off = RR73 (modern FT8 practice).
chinese: 用單獨的 RRR 確認最終報告（對方還欠一個 73），而不是合併的 RR73。關閉 = 使用 RR73（現代 FT8 做法）。
記錄後清除 DX 呼號

english: Wipe the DX Call / DX Grid fields once a contact is logged (WSJT-X option, off by default).
chinese: 聯絡記錄後清空 DX Call / DX Grid 欄位（WSJT-X 選項，預設關閉）。

english: Deep finds the most signals (WSJT-X default); Fast saves CPU on old hardware. All Decoder settings drive the native decoder — on a WSJT-X UDP source (companion mode) decodes arrive already made and none of them apply.
chinese: 「深」能找到最多訊號（WSJT-X 預設）；「快」在老舊硬體上節省 CPU。所有解碼器設定只作用於原生解碼器 — 使用 WSJT-X UDP 源（伴隨模式）時，解碼結果已由對方生成，這些設定都不生效。

english: The decoder's search range. Default 200–2900 Hz. Raise F high toward 4000 Hz to decode stations calling above ~2.9 kHz (common on crowded FT8 bands); lower the range to focus on a narrow filter or dodge strong close-in QRM.
chinese: 解碼器的搜尋範圍。預設 200–2900 Hz。把頻高上限提到 4000 Hz 附近，可解碼在約 2.9 kHz 以上呼叫的電台（擁擠的 FT8 波段上很常見）；收窄範圍則可專注於窄濾波器或避開近距離強 QRM。

english: Retry marginal signals against hypotheses built from your call, the DX call and the QSO state (WSJT-X "Enable AP", on by default) — including the cross-cycle replay of last cycle's QSOs. FT8 only: FT4's AP is part of its Normal/Deep depth and has no separate switch.
chinese: 用你的呼號、對方呼號和 QSO 狀態構建的假設重試邊緣訊號（WSJT-X 的「Enable AP」，預設開啟）— 包括對上一週期 QSO 的跨週期重放。僅 FT8：FT4 的 AP 屬於其標準/深深度的一部分，沒有獨立開關。

english: Limit AP to the "CQ" guess — no MyCall/DxCall hypotheses (FT8 and FT4). WSJT-X switches to this by itself after 5 minutes without transmitting, as a guard against stale-context false decodes; here it is your explicit choice. Off = full AP, the stock behavior.
chinese: 把 AP 限制在「CQ」猜測上 — 不使用 MyCall/DxCall 假設（FT8 與 FT4）。WSJT-X 在 5 分鐘未發射後會自行切到此模式，以防上下文過期造成的誤解碼；這裡由你顯式選擇。關閉 = 完整 AP，即原始行為。

english: Decode only within ±25 Hz of your green RX marker (the same one-station window WSJT-X uses for a double-click re-decode) instead of the whole passband — isolates one weak station and saves CPU. FT8 and FT4 only: 50 Hz is narrower than a single JT65, Q65 or MSK144 signal, so those modes keep the full passband. Applies while the RX marker sits inside the passband above; off = full passband, the stock behavior.
chinese: 僅在你的綠色 RX 標記 ±25 Hz 範圍內解碼（即 WSJT-X 按兩下重解碼所用的單台視窗），而不是整個通帶 — 可隔離單個弱訊號並節省 CPU。僅 FT8 與 FT4：50 Hz 比單個 JT65、Q65 或 MSK144 訊號還窄，因此那些模式仍用完整通帶。僅當 RX 標記落在上方通帶內時生效；關閉 = 完整通帶，即原始行為。
do_not_translate: MSK144 | WSJT-X | JT65 | FT4 | FT8 | Q65 | Hz | RX

english: Off = normal FT8/FT4 operation. Hound = DXpedition pile-up discipline (calls above 1000 Hz; your report auto-moves to the Fox's frequency).
chinese: 關閉 = 常規 FT8/FT4 操作。Hound = DXpedition 堆疊紀律（在 1000 Hz 以上呼叫；你的報告會自動移到 Fox 的頻率）。
do_not_translate: DXpedition | Hound | FT4 | FT8 | Fox | Hz

chinese: 旅程 — 追蹤每週連續

english: Off by default. A gentle “weeks on the air” counter on the Journey board — never a daily streak, never a penalty for a break.
chinese: 預設關閉。在「旅程」看板上顯示一個溫和的「在空中多少周」計數 — 從不按天計，也不因中斷而扣分。

english: Off = passive (hunt & pounce): Nexus listens and only transmits when you act. On = periodically calls CQ to announce you're on frequency.
chinese: 關閉 = 被動（守聽並出擊）：Nexus 只監聽，僅在你操作時發射。開啟 = 週期性呼叫 CQ 宣告你在頻率上。

english: On (default) = a weak frame that fails is recovered by joint-combining its retransmissions (RV0+RV1+RV2), and unacknowledged QSO overs escalate redundancy. Off = RV0-only (each frame decoded on its own).
chinese: 開啟（預設）= 失敗的弱幀透過聯合合併其重傳（RV0+RV1+RV2）來恢復，未被確認的 QSO 發射會提高冗餘度。關閉 = 僅 RV0（每幀獨立解碼）。

english: Measure your PC clock against public NTP servers and CORRECT for it: TempoFast/TempoDeep are slot-timed to UTC, and Nexus shifts its own transmit and decode windows by the measured offset so they land on the true UTC grid even when the clock is off. The top bar shows what is being applied. Turn off for fully-offline operation (no network calls) — the last measurement then keeps steering until it ages out.
chinese: 用公共 NTP 伺服器測量本機時鐘並據此校正：TempoFast/TempoDeep 按 UTC 劃分時隙，Nexus 會按測得的偏移量平移自己的發射與解碼視窗，即使時鐘不準也能落在真實 UTC 柵格上。頂欄會顯示目前應用的校正。完全離線執行時請關閉（不發起任何網路請求）— 最後一次測量會繼續引導，直到過期。

english: Your transmit power in watts — logged on every contact as its power (ADIF TX_PWR), and unlocks the Journey miles-per-watt & QRP feats. Leave blank if unknown.
chinese: 你的發射功率（瓦）— 會作為功率記錄到每次聯絡（ADIF TX_PWR），並解鎖「旅程」中的每瓦英里數與 QRP 成就。不知道可留空。

english: Distances, temperature and wind speed. Automatic follows your operating system's region. Applies everywhere in the app immediately.
chinese: 距離、溫度和風速。自動跟隨作業系統的區域設定。立即在應用內全域性生效。
C — 4 倍間隔，最耐多普勒

english: JT65 always uses a 60 s T/R period, so spacing is the only choice. A is what you want on HF; EME operators move up to B or C as Doppler spread on the higher bands smears the tones. Both stations must use the same submode.
chinese: JT65 始終使用 60 秒的收發週期，因此間隔是唯一可選項。HF 上應選 A；EME 操作者在高波段多普勒展寬把音調糊開時會改用 B 或 C。雙方必須使用相同子模式。

english: The classic weak-signal and moonbounce mode, decoded and transmitted. Messages are the older 22-character format, not the 37-character one FT8 and friends use.
chinese: 經典的弱訊號與月面反射模式，可解碼也可發射。訊息使用較早的 22 字元格式，而非 FT8 一類使用的 37 字元格式。
5 秒 — 快速交替，適合大流星雨

english: 30 s — sparse pings, more to stack
chinese: 30 秒 — 稀疏回波，可堆疊更多

english: MSK144 sends a 72 ms message over and over, so a single meteor trail lasting a tenth of a second can carry the whole thing. Shorter periods turn the exchange around faster during a shower; longer ones give the decoder more frames to stack when pings are sparse. Both stations must use the same period.
chinese: MSK144 會反覆傳送一條 72 ms 的訊息，因此單條持續十分之一秒的流星餘跡就能承載全部內容。較短的週期在流星雨期間交換更快；回波稀疏時較長週期給解碼器更多可堆疊的幀。雙方必須使用相同週期。

english: MSK144 transmits for nearly the whole period, sending the same 72 ms frame hundreds of times — that is how meteor scatter works, and a contact can take many minutes of apparent silence. The audio frequency is fixed at a 1500 Hz centre; the signal is 1 kHz wide, so there is nowhere to tune it. Shorthand (MSK40) messages are off, matching WSJT-X’s default.
chinese: MSK144 幾乎在整個週期內發射，把同一 72 ms 幀傳送數百次 — 這就是流星散射的工作方式，一次聯絡可能要經歷數分鐘的表面靜默。音訊頻率固定在 1500 Hz 中心；訊號寬 1 kHz，因此無處可調。簡寫（MSK40）訊息預設關閉，與 WSJT-X 的預設一致。

english: Round Robin is scheduling — this percentage is not used. Set the slot to 0 to schedule by percentage.
chinese: 輪轉由排程決定 — 此處百分比不使用。把槽位設為 0 即可改按百分比排程。

english: Ignored while Round Robin is active — the rotation decides which intervals transmit. Set the slot to 0 to schedule by percentage again.
chinese: 輪轉生效期間此項被忽略 — 由輪轉決定哪些間隔發射。把槽位設為 0 即可恢復按百分比排程。

english: Fraction of intervals to transmit on. 0 = listen only. A beacon that transmits every interval hears nothing, so a minority is the convention — 20–30% is typical. Below 40% Nexus also avoids back-to-back transmissions while still hitting the rate you asked for.
chinese: 發射所佔的間隔比例。0 = 僅收聽。每個間隔都發射的信標什麼也聽不到，所以只佔少數是慣例 — 通常 20–30%。低於 40% 時 Nexus 還會避免連續發射，同時仍達到你要求的比例。

english: Required, and it has to be real. WSPR reports are published to a public propagation database that other operators draw conclusions from, so a wrong figure corrupts their data as well as yours. The beacon stays silent until this is set. 23 = 200 mW, 30 = 1 W, 37 = 5 W, 43 = 20 W.
chinese: 必填，且必須真實。WSPR 報告會發布到公開的傳播資料庫，其他操作者據此下結論，因此錯誤的數字既汙染你的資料，也汙染他們的。未設定前信標保持靜默。23 = 200 mW，30 = 1 W，37 = 5 W，43 = 20 W。

english: 0 = use the transmit-% schedule. Otherwise your slot in a coordinated rotation: stations agreeing on the same slot count and each taking a different slot never transmit at the same time, because the assignment is fixed by UTC. A rotation needs at least 2 slots.
chinese: 0 = 使用發射佔比排程。否則表示你在協同輪轉中的槽位：約定相同槽位數的台站各佔不同槽位，因分配由 UTC 固定，永遠不會同時發射。輪轉至少需要 2 個槽位。

english: A one-station rotation is no rotation — Round Robin needs at least 2 slots, so it is off and the transmit-% schedule applies.
chinese: 只有一台的輪轉不算輪轉 — 輪轉至少需要 2 個槽位，因此已關閉，改用發射佔比排程。

english: How many stations are in the rotation. Ignored when the slot is 0.
chinese: 參與輪轉的台站數量。槽位為 0 時忽略。

english: Beacons transmit your callsign, grid and power — there is no QSO sequence, so Call CQ and S&P are inactive on these tiers. Transmit still has to be armed as usual; the schedule never keys a radio whose transmit you have not enabled.
chinese: 信標會發射你的呼號、網格和功率 — 沒有 QSO 流程，因此這些層級上「呼叫 CQ」和「守聽並出擊」不可用。發射仍需照常啟用；排程絕不會鍵控一部你未啟用發射的電台。
120 秒 — 最短 FST4W 信標間隔

english: Shared by both tiers. Longer periods hear weaker signals at fewer exchanges per hour. FST4W beacons run at 120/300/900/1800 s; FST4 QSO work is usually 15–60 s. Both stations (or the beacon you are listening for) must be on the same period.
chinese: 兩個層級共用。週期越長越能聽到弱訊號，但每小時交換次數更少。FST4W 信標使用 120/300/900/1800 秒；FST4 QSO 通常為 15–60 秒。雙方（或你在收聽的信標）必須使用相同週期。

english: FST4 is the QSO mode; FST4W is the WSPR-like beacon mode — pick which one on the tier selector. Nexus decodes both and transmits neither. Note that FST4W hashed callsigns show as <...>: the lookup table upstream fills from a file this build does not carry.
chinese: FST4 是 QSO 模式；FST4W 是類似 WSPR 的信標模式 — 在層級選擇器中挑選。Nexus 兩者都能解碼，但都不發射。注意 FST4W 的雜湊呼號會顯示為 <...>：上游用於填充的查表檔案此版本未附帶。
Q65 — EME / VHF 以上散射
30 秒 — 6 米流星 / 電離層散射

english: Longer periods integrate longer and hear weaker signals, at one exchange per period. Both stations must use the same period. Changing this changes the decode frame length, so it takes effect on the next slot.
chinese: 週期越長積分越久、越能聽到弱訊號，但每週期只完成一次交換。雙方必須使用相同週期。更改此項會改變解碼幀長，因此在下一個時隙生效。
E — 16 倍間隔，最耐多普勒

english: Wider spacing survives more Doppler spread and frequency drift but costs sensitivity. Move up the letters as the path degrades — EME on the higher bands usually needs B or C.
chinese: 間隔越寬越能抵抗多普勒展寬與頻率漂移，但犧牲靈敏度。路徑變差時逐級上調 — 高波段 EME 通常需要 B 或 C。

english: Q65 transmits and receives. The period and submode set both what you hear and what you send, and BOTH STATIONS MUST MATCH — a correspondent on a different period or submode will not decode you.
chinese: Q65 可發可收。週期與子模式同時決定你聽到什麼和傳送什麼，且雙方必須一致 — 週期或子模式不同的對方無法解碼你。

english: FM drives the rig to FM + the shift/tone below.
chinese: FM 會把電台切到 FM，並使用下方的偏移/亞音。

english: Offset is the band standard (2 m 600 k, 70 cm 5 M…).
chinese: 偏移量按波段標準（2 米 600 k，70 釐米 5 M…）。

english: Mic gain and voice-keyer message recording are in the Phone cockpit (live CAT + one-touch record).
chinese: 麥克風增益與語音鍵控訊息錄製在話音操作台中（即時 CAT + 一鍵錄製）。

english: Mic used when RECORDING a voice-keyer message. Default records from the audio input device — but on a digital setup that's the rig's RX audio, so you'd record the band, not your voice. Pick your actual mic here. If it can't open, recording falls back to the input device (never silent).
chinese: 錄製語音鍵控訊息時使用的麥克風。預設從音訊輸入裝置錄製 — 但在數字配置下那是電台的 RX 音訊，你會錄到波段而不是自己的聲音。請在此選擇你真正的麥克風。若無法開啟，錄製會回退到輸入裝置（絕不會靜默失敗）。

english: CAT — the rig keys CW (Hamlib send_morse; newer rigs only)
chinese: CAT — 由電台發 CW（Hamlib send_morse；僅較新電台）

english: Serial keyline (DTR/RTS) — key the rig's KEY jack
chinese: 串列埠鍵控線（DTR/RTS）— 鍵控電台的 KEY 插孔

english: Soundcard — audio tone through a data mode (workaround)
chinese: 音效卡 — 經資料模式傳送音訊音調（變通方案）

english: How Nexus sends CW. CAT uses the rig's internal keyer, but older rigs (e.g. IC-756PRO III) don't support it. Serial keyline toggles DTR/RTS into the rig's KEY jack (rig in CW, rig shapes the signal — a clean method that needs only a keying cable). WinKeyer drives a K1EL.Soundcard keys an audio tone — a workaround; set drive so ALC reads zero. It takes your radio out of CW into a data mode (DATA-U/DATA-L, so the tone reaches the transmitter instead of the mic jack); pick any other keyer and CW mode comes straight back. Also switchable live from the CW cockpit.
chinese: Nexus 如何傳送 CW。CAT 使用電台內部鍵控器，但較老的電台（如 IC-756PRO III）不支援。串列埠鍵控線把 DTR/RTS 翻轉送入電台的 KEY 插孔（電台處於 CW 模式，由電台整形訊號 — 乾淨的方法，只需一根鍵控線）。WinKeyer 驅動 K1EL 硬體。音效卡鍵控一個音訊音調 — 屬於變通方案；請調整驅動力使 ALC 讀數為零。它會把你的電台帶離 CW，進入資料模式（DATA-U/DATA-L，好讓音調到達發射機而不是麥克風插孔）；選擇其他任何鍵控器，CW 模式會立刻恢復。也可在 CW 操作台中即時切換。
do_not_translate: <b> | WinKeyer | DATA-L | DATA-U | Nexus | DATA | K1EL | ALC | CAT | CW | IC-756PRO | DTR/RTS

english: CAT CW keying is unproven on this radio. Its Hamlib backend sends a different keying command from the one other radios use, and it reports success either way — so if nothing is transmitted, Nexus cannot tell you. If CW doesn't go out, use the Serial keyline, WinKeyer, or Soundcard keyer.
chinese: CAT CW 鍵控在這部電台上尚未驗證。其 Hamlib 後端傳送的鍵控命令與其他電台使用的不同，而無論成敗它都會報成功 — 所以如果沒有發出任何訊號，Nexus 無法告訴你。若 CW 發不出去，請改用串列埠鍵控線、WinKeyer 或音效卡鍵控。

english: On a Flex over SmartSDR CAT, Esc stops Nexus at once, but the radio may finish the word it is sending: SmartSDR CAT has no documented CW stop, so Nexus hands the radio one word at a time. For a stop that cuts mid-word, choose the WinKeyer keyer on SmartSDR CAT's WinKeyer port, or use the Flex native client.
chinese: 在透過 SmartSDR CAT 連線的 Flex 上，Esc 會立即讓 Nexus 停止，但電台可能把正在傳送的那個詞發完：SmartSDR CAT 沒有公開的 CW 停止指令，因此 Nexus 一次只交給電台一個詞。若需要能中途截斷的停止，請在 SmartSDR CAT 的 WinKeyer 連線埠上選擇 WinKeyer 鍵控器，或使用 Flex 原生使用者端。

english: CW tone pitch (300–1200 Hz) — the soundcard keyer tone and the CW scope zero-beat marker.
chinese: CW 音調音高（300–1200 Hz）— 影響音效卡鍵控音調與 CW 頻譜中的零拍標記。

english: Use reverse CW on every band
chinese: 在所有波段使用反向 CW

english: Put your radio in its reverse CW mode (CW-R / CW-L) instead of its normal CW, on every band. Off by default, so Nexus asks for plain CW and your radio stays where its own menu puts it. This changes only the pitch you hear on a signal — CW and CW-R transmit identically, and the station you work cannot tell — so it is a personal preference, not a band rule. Which sideband it actually selects depends on the radio: on a Yaesu it is CW-L, while on an Icom it follows that rig's own CW Normal Side menu. The Soundcard keyer ignores this, because it never puts the rig in CW at all.
chinese: 把電台置於反向 CW 模式（CW-R / CW-L），而不是常規 CW，且在所有波段。預設關閉，因此 Nexus 請求的是普通 CW，你的電台保持其選單設定的狀態。這只改變你聽到某個訊號時的音高 — CW 與 CW-R 的發射完全相同，與你通聯的台站察覺不到 — 所以這是個人偏好，不是波段規則。實際選中哪個邊帶取決於電台：Yaesu 上是 CW-L，而 Icom 上則跟隨該機自身的 CW Normal Side 選單。音效卡鍵控器忽略此項，因為它根本不把電台切到 CW。
do_not_translate: <b> | Nexus | Yaesu | CW-L | CW-R | Icom | CW

english: The serial port your WinKey presents. 1200 baud. A WinKey micro inside a multi-function interface (Timewave Navigator, microHAM) counts — use that device's CW/WinKey port, not its CAT port.
chinese: 你的 WinKey 呈現的串列埠。1200 波特。多功能介面（Timewave Navigator、microHAM）內建的 WinKey 晶片也算 — 請使用該裝置的 CW/WinKey 連線埠，而不是它的 CAT 連線埠。
鍵控介面（與 CAT 分開）

english: The USB-to-serial into your keying interface (Buxcomm, a homebrew DTR cable, …) that plugs into the rig's KEY jack. Must be a SEPARATE port from CAT. Set the rig to CW and its key-jack to straight-key / bug. An interface with a WinKey chip in it — Timewave Navigator, microHAM, a K1EL WinKeyer — does not key on DTR: pick the WinKeyer backend above instead and give it that device's CW port.
chinese: 接入你鍵控介面（Buxcomm、自制 DTR 線等）的 USB 轉串列埠，該介面插在電台的 KEY 插孔上。必須是與 CAT 分開的連線埠。請把電台設為 CW 模式，並把其鍵控插孔設為直鍵/臭蟲鍵。內建 WinKey 晶片的介面 — Timewave Navigator、microHAM、K1EL WinKeyer — 不會用 DTR 鍵控：請改選上方的 WinKeyer 後端，並給它該裝置的 CW 連線埠。

english: Which control line keys the rig. DTR is standard (RTS = PTT); flip to RTS if your interface is wired the other way.
chinese: 哪條控制線鍵控電台。DTR 是標準（RTS = PTT）；若你的介面是反接的，改用 RTS。

english: Keys your callsign in CW once the final 73 has fully left the air, in Q65, FST4 and MSK144 (stock WSJT-X option, default off). As in WSJT-X, FT8 and FT4 send no CW ID, and neither do FT2, TempoFast or TempoDeep. Uses the normal CW keying path — PTT + tone — after the over, never on top of it.
chinese: 在最後的 73 完全離開空中之後，用 CW 拍發你的呼號，適用於 Q65、FST4 和 MSK144（WSJT-X 原始選項，預設關閉）。與 WSJT-X 一致，FT8 和 FT4 不傳送 CW 標識，FT2、TempoFast 和 TempoDeep 也不發。使用常規 CW 鍵控路徑 — PTT + 音調 — 在發射之後，絕不疊在其上。
do_not_translate: CW | 73 | Q65 | FST4 | MSK144 | WSJT-X | FT8 | FT4 | FT2 | TempoFast | TempoDeep | PTT

chinese: CW 操作台 F 鍵
新 CW 宏配置名稱：
重新命名 CW 宏配置：

english: Using the built-in F1–F8 set. Customize to make them your own (labels + templates; tokens: {MYCALL} {RST} {NAME} and ! = the worked call).
chinese: 正在使用內建的 F1–F8 組合。自訂可讓它們成為你自己的（標籤 + 模板；權杖：{MYCALL} {RST} {NAME}，以及 ! = 對方呼號）。

english: Tokens: {MYCALL} {NAME} {MYGRID} {MYSTATE} {RST} · ! = the worked call · {HISNAME} {HISSTATE} = the worked station's QRZ name/state (fill in Settings ▸ Station for {MYSTATE}; the rest auto-fill from the copilot / roster click + QRZ lookup). Each key KEEPS its role — the Guided copilot's next-step highlight follows the role, so customized text still rolls through F1→F2→F3→F4 exactly as before. Keep the ! token wherever you want the other station's call inserted. Save to apply.
chinese: 權杖：{MYCALL} {NAME} {MYGRID} {MYSTATE} {RST} · ! = 對方呼號 · {HISNAME} {HISSTATE} = 對方在 QRZ 上的姓名/州（{MYSTATE} 需在「設定 ▸ 台站」中填寫；其餘由副駕/名單點選 + QRZ 查詢自動填充）。每個鍵都保留其角色 — 引導式副駕的下一步高亮跟隨角色，因此自訂文字仍會像以前一樣按 F1→F2→F3→F4 推進。請在你希望插入對方呼號的位置保留 ! 權杖。儲存後生效。
do_not_translate: {MYCALL} | {NAME} | {MYGRID} | {MYSTATE} | {RST} | {HISNAME} | {HISSTATE} | QRZ | RST | F1 | F2 | F3 | F4

chinese: 開啟 RTTY 時開始接收

english: The RTTY screen starts the decoder as soon as you open it — tune a signal and the text prints, no setup. Turn this off to arm the receiver by hand (the Arm RX button in the decoded-text pane). This arms the RECEIVER only — transmitting is never armed for you.
chinese: RTTY 介面一開啟就啟動解碼器 — 調到某個訊號上文字就會列印，無需設定。關閉此項則需手動啟用接收（解碼文字窗格中的「啟用接收」按鈕）。這只會啟用接收機 — 發射絕不會替你啟用。

english: AFSK — soundcard tones through the rig in LSB (default)
chinese: AFSK — 音效卡音調經電台以 LSB 傳送（預設）

english: True FSK — serial keyline (DTR/RTS), rig in RTTY mode
chinese: 真 FSK — 串列埠鍵控線（DTR/RTS），電台處於 RTTY 模式

english: How Nexus transmits RTTY. AFSK plays the two-tone waveform through the same TX audio path as FT8 (soundcard-clocked = jitter-free; set drive so ALC reads just zero). True FSK bit-bangs the rig's FSK input over a serial control line with the rig in RTTY mode — unlocking its narrow RTTY filters (e.g. the FTDX10's) — with PTT on CAT or its own line. Software FSK timing is casual/Field-Day grade; AFSK is the timing-cleanest path.
chinese: Nexus 如何傳送 RTTY。AFSK 透過與 FT8 相同的發射音訊通路播放雙音波形（由音效卡定時 = 無抖動；請調整驅動力使 ALC 剛好讀到零）。真 FSK 透過一條串列埠控制線按位翻轉電台的 FSK 輸入、電台處於 RTTY 模式 — 從而解鎖其窄帶 RTTY 濾波器（例如 FTDX10 的）— PTT 走 CAT 或它自己的線。軟體 FSK 的時序只到休閒/Field Day 水平；AFSK 是時序最乾淨的路徑。
do_not_translate: <b> | Nexus | AFSK | RTTY | ALC | CAT | FSK | FT8 | PTT | TX | FTDX10

english: The sideband the rig runs AFSK on. LSB is the RTTY convention. On USB, Nexus puts the rig in its upper data mode (DATA-U / USB-D / DIGU) and swaps the tones itself, so mark stays high on the air and the decoder still copies — leave Reverse off.
chinese: 電台跑 AFSK 所用的邊帶。LSB 是 RTTY 慣例。在 USB 下，Nexus 會把電台置入其上部資料模式（DATA-U / USB-D / DIGU）並自行交換音調，這樣 mark 在空中仍是高音，解碼器照樣能抄收 — 請保持「反向」關閉。
do_not_translate: AFSK | LSB | RTTY | USB | Nexus | DATA-U | USB-D

english: e.g. the FTDX10's USB Enhanced COM
chinese: 例如 FTDX10 的 USB Enhanced COM

english: The port whose control line feeds the rig's FSK input. Empty = the CAT serial port.
chinese: 其控制線饋送電台 FSK 輸入的連線埠。留空 = 使用 CAT 串列埠。

english: DTR (the common wiring — RTS stays free for PTT)
chinese: DTR（常見接法 — RTS 留給 PTT）

english: Which control line carries the data bits. PTT must ride its OWN path — CAT PTT or the separate PTT line, never this one; Nexus refuses a send if they collide.
chinese: 哪條控制線承載資料位。PTT 必須走它自己獨立的通路 — CAT PTT 或獨立的 PTT 線，絕不能用這條；若兩者衝突，Nexus 會拒絕傳送。

english: Drives the TX bit clock and the RX demodulator (true 45.45, never rounded to 45).
chinese: 同時驅動發射位時鐘與接收解調器（真 45.45，絕不取整為 45）。

english: Mark/space spacing — the TX tone pair and the RX demodulator both.
chinese: mark/space 間距 — 同時用於發射音調對與接收解調器。

english: Swaps mark and space on TX and in the RX decoder, to work a station sending upside down. Not for running USB: pick the AFSK sideband instead, which keeps the sense right on its own.
chinese: 在發射和接收解碼器中交換 mark 與 space，用於與顛倒發射的台站通聯。不要用它來跑 USB：請改選 AFSK 邊帶，它會自行保持正確的極性。

english: How long Auto call waits before it calls CQ again, in seconds — and the same wait before it asks a station for a repeat. The clock starts when your over has finished going out, not when it was queued. 30 seconds is what Auto call has always done; change it only if you want a faster or slower cycle. Anything under 5 seconds would key over the answer you just asked for, so 5 is the floor.
chinese: 自動呼叫在再次呼叫 CQ 之前等待多久（秒）— 以及向某台請求重發前的相同等待。計時從你本次發射完全結束開始，而不是從排隊時開始。30 秒是自動呼叫一直以來的做法；只有在你想讓節奏更快或更慢時才改。低於 5 秒會在你剛剛請求的答覆上直接鍵控，因此下限是 5。

english: How many times Auto call asks again inside a contact before it lets that station go. This does not limit CQ. An unanswered CQ repeats until you stop it — that is what the Stop button and the TX switch are for.
chinese: 自動呼叫在一次聯絡中向某台再請求多少次後才放手。這不會限制 CQ。無人應答的 CQ 會一直重複直到你停止 — 這正是「停止」按鈕和 TX 開關的用途。
開啟 PSK 時開始接收

english: The PSK screen starts the decoder as soon as you open it — click a trace on the waterfall and the text prints, no setup. Turn this off to arm the receiver by hand (the Arm RX button in the decoded-text pane). Stopping the receiver yourself is already remembered for the rest of the session. This arms the RECEIVER only — transmitting is never armed for you.
chinese: PSK 介面一開啟就啟動解碼器 — 在瀑布圖上點選一條跡線，文字就會列印，無需設定。關閉此項則需手動啟用接收（解碼文字窗格中的「啟用接收」按鈕）。你自己停止接收機的狀態會在本次工作階段內記住。這只會啟用接收機 — 發射絕不會替你啟用。
開啟 JTTY 時開始接收

english: The JTTY screen starts its decoder as soon as you open it. Turn this off to arm the receiver by hand (the Arm RX button in the All decodes pane). Stopping the receiver yourself is already remembered for the rest of the session. This arms the RECEIVER only — transmitting is never armed for you.
chinese: JTTY 介面一開啟就啟動其解碼器。關閉此項則需手動啟用接收（「全部解碼」窗格中的「啟用接收」按鈕）。你自己停止接收機的狀態會在本次工作階段內記住。這只會啟用接收機 — 發射絕不會替你啟用。

english: The speed your frames go out at, and the period the TX clock follows: Slow 30 s, Normal 15 s, Fast 10 s, JS8 40 6 s, JS8 60 4 s. Normal is what most of the band runs. JS8 40 (called Turbo before JS8Call 3.0) and JS8 60 are for strong signals; JS8Call 3.0 marks JS8 60 experimental. The speed chips in the JS8 header change this same setting.
chinese: 你的幀以何種速度傳送，以及 TX 時鐘跟隨的週期：Slow 30 秒、Normal 15 秒、Fast 10 秒、JS8 40 6 秒、JS8 60 4 秒。波段上大多用 Normal。JS8 40（JS8Call 3.0 之前稱為 Turbo）和 JS8 60 用於強訊號；JS8Call 3.0 將 JS8 60 標為實驗性。JS8 頂欄的速度膠囊改動的是同一個設定。
do_not_translate: JS8 40 | JS8 60 | Turbo | JS8Call | JS8 | TX

english: Every speed is decoded at once by default, as JS8Call does — a Slow station and a JS8 60 station on the same band both print. Untick a speed to save CPU on a small machine; each activity row is marked with its speed letter (E/A/B/C/I). A list saved before JS8 60 arrived keeps the four speeds it had: tick JS8 60 to add it.
chinese: 預設同時解碼所有速度，與 JS8Call 一致 — 同一波段上的 Slow 台站和 JS8 60 台站都會列印出來。取消勾選某個速度可在小機器上節省 CPU；每條活動行都標有其速度字母（E/A/B/C/I）。在 JS8 60 出現之前儲存的清單會保留原有四個速度：勾選 JS8 60 即可加入。

english: Off (0) by default, as in JS8Call. Otherwise a station not heard for this many minutes leaves the Stations list, unless you have it selected or it has an unread message for you, and your HEARING? replies leave it out. Up to 1440 (a day).
chinese: 預設關閉（0），與 JS8Call 一致。否則，若某台站已有這麼多分鐘未被聽到，就會從台站清單中移除，除非你選中了它或它有給你的未讀訊息，且你的 HEARING? 回覆也會排除它。最大 1440（一天）。

english: 2 by default, as in JS8Call. A row of the Band activity pane whose newest decode is this many minutes old leaves the pane, unless RX is on its offset. 0 keeps every row. Up to 1440 (a day).
chinese: 預設 2，與 JS8Call 一致。若「波段活動」窗格中某行的最新解碼已過這麼多分鐘，該行會離開窗格，除非 RX 正落在它的偏移上。0 表示保留所有行。最大 1440（一天）。

english: Return to the last used frequency
Off by default, as in JS8Call. On, opening JS8 tunes the rig back to the frequency you last used in JS8, instead of the band's JS8 frequency.
chinese: 預設關閉，與 JS8Call 一致。開啟後，開啟 JS8 會把電台調回你上次在 JS8 中使用的頻率，而不是該波段的 JS8 頻率。

english: JS8Call's suggested frequencies. Change, add or remove one and the list becomes your own: the band picker in JS8 shows it, and opening JS8 tunes the first one on the band.
chinese: JS8Call 建議的頻率。改動、增加或刪除任一項後，清單就變成你自己的：JS8 中的波段選擇器會顯示它，開啟 JS8 時調諧到該波段上的第一個。

english: Your own list: the band picker in JS8 shows it, and opening JS8 tunes the first one on the band. Reset puts JS8Call's suggested frequencies back.
chinese: 你自己的清單：JS8 中的波段選擇器會顯示它，開啟 JS8 時調諧到該波段上的第一個。重設可恢復 JS8Call 的建議頻率。

english: Type the frequency in MHz, for example {{example}}.
chinese: 請以 MHz 為單位輸入頻率，例如 {{example}}。

english: Your list is replaced by JS8Call's suggested frequencies when you save.
chinese: 儲存後，你的清單會被 JS8Call 的建議頻率替換。

english: Could not save the JS8 frequencies
chinese: 無法儲存 JS8 頻率

english: That file holds no JS8 frequencies Nexus can read. Use a file this list exported.
chinese: 該檔案中沒有 Nexus 能讀取的 JS8 頻率。請使用本清單匯出的檔案。

english: JS8 frequencies imported: {{count}}. Save to keep them.
chinese: 已匯入 JS8 頻率：{{count}}。儲存後生效。
替換你的 JS8 頻率？

english: Your list is replaced by the one in this file.
chinese: 你的清單會被此檔案中的清單替換。

english: Off by default, as in JS8Call. On, Nexus changes the rig's frequency BY ITSELF at the times below, with nobody at the radio: a notice first, then the change 30 seconds later unless you cancel it. Never while transmitting or while a message is going out.
chinese: 預設關閉，與 JS8Call 一致。開啟後，Nexus 會在下列時間自行更換電台頻率，無人值守：先提示，30 秒後執行更改，除非你取消。絕不在發射時或訊息正在傳送時進行。

english: Each row: a frequency, and from when until when (UTC) to be on it. The frequency does not change back when a row ends; add another row for that. Where rows overlap, the one that starts later wins.
chinese: 每行：一個頻率，以及從何時到何時（UTC）使用它。某行結束時頻率不會自動改回；請另加一行。行之間重疊時，開始較晚的那行優先。

english: The frequency does not change back at this time. Add another row to return.
chinese: 到此時間頻率不會自動改回。要返回請再加一行。

english: Frequency of the new row in MHz

0 = a heartbeat only when you press HB. Otherwise, while the HB chip is on, one goes out every this-many minutes on a random free slot between 500 and 1000 Hz. The HB chip itself is never remembered across launches, and nothing keys unless TX is on.
chinese: 0 = 僅在你按 HB 時傳送一次心跳。否則，在 HB 膠囊開啟時，每隔這麼多分鐘在 500 至 1000 Hz 之間的隨機空閒時隙傳送一次。HB 膠囊狀態本身絕不會跨啟動記憶；且除非 TX 已開啟，否則不會鍵控。

english: 0 = the CQ button sends one CQ, as it does today. Above 0 the button becomes a switch: leave it on and a CQ goes out every this-many minutes, with the seconds to the next one counting down on the button — the POTA and beacon habit. A station answering you turns it off, so does the idle watchdog, and so does Stop TX. It is never remembered across launches, and nothing keys unless TX is on.
chinese: 0 = CQ 按鈕只傳送一次 CQ，與現在一致。大於 0 時該按鈕變成開關：保持開啟就每隔這麼多分鐘發出一次 CQ，按鈕上會倒計時到下一次 — 這是 POTA 與信標的習慣。有台站應答你時會關閉它，空閒看門狗也會，停止發射也會。它絕不會跨啟動記憶，且除非 TX 已開啟，否則不會鍵控。

english: Off by default, as in JS8Call. On, a heard heartbeat is answered with your signal report (HEARTBEAT SNR), one frame per station, and a message you hold for that station is offered to it. Needs TX on.
chinese: 預設關閉，與 JS8Call 一致。開啟後，聽到的心跳會用你的訊號報告（HEARTBEAT SNR）應答，每台一幀，並且你為那台保留的訊息也會提供給它。需要 TX 開啟。

english: Never acknowledge heartbeats from these callsigns
chinese: 永不答應這些呼號的心跳

english: Comma-separated, empty by default as in JS8Call. A heartbeat from a station on this list draws no acknowledgement.
chinese: 逗號分隔，預設留空，與 JS8Call 一致。來自此清單中台站的心跳不會被應答。

english: Off by default, as in JS8Call (its Mode ▸ Enable Heartbeat Networking). On, the cockpit shows the HB button and Answer heartbeats can answer the heartbeats you hear; off, no heartbeat and no heartbeat acknowledgement goes out. The same switch as the cockpit’s HB NET.
chinese: 預設關閉，與 JS8Call 一致（其「Mode ▸ Enable Heartbeat Networking」）。開啟後，操作台會顯示 HB 按鈕，且「應答心跳」可以應答你聽到的心跳；關閉則不發心跳，也不發心跳確認。與操作台的 HB NET 是同一個開關。
允許心跳在 500–1000 Hz 之外

english: Off by default, as in JS8Call. On, your heartbeats and heartbeat acknowledgements go out on your own TX offset. Off, each goes on a free spot between 500 and 1000 Hz, and a heartbeat stays on your offset if it is at or below 1000 Hz.
chinese: 預設關閉，與 JS8Call 一致。開啟後，你的心跳與心跳確認會發在你自己的 TX 偏移上。關閉時，每次都會發在 500 至 1000 Hz 之間的空閒位置，而若你的偏移在 1000 Hz 及以下，心跳會留在該偏移上。

english: Pause heartbeats while a call is in the To box
chinese: 「收件人」框中有呼號時暫停心跳

english: On by default, as in JS8Call (its pause while in a QSO). While the cockpit’s To box holds a call, the heartbeat repeat pauses and starts again one interval after you clear the box, no heartbeat is acknowledged, and a repeating CQ stops. Turning the heartbeat repeat on clears the To box.
chinese: 預設開啟，與 JS8Call 一致（其在 QSO 期間的暫停）。當操作台的「收件人」框中有呼號時，心跳重複會暫停，並在你清空該框後間隔一個週期重新開始；此間不應答任何心跳，重複的 CQ 也會停止。重新開啟心跳重複會清空「收件人」框。

english: Don’t acknowledge stations that heartbeat more often than every 55 minutes
chinese: 不應答心跳頻繁於每 55 分鐘一次的台站

english: Off by default, as in JS8Call 3.0. On, a station heard heartbeating again within 55 minutes of its last acknowledged heartbeat is added to Never acknowledge heartbeats from these callsigns, as JS8Call adds it to its list, and the cockpit’s HB ACK chip names it. Take it off that list to acknowledge it again; turning this off leaves the list as it is.
chinese: 預設關閉，與 JS8Call 3.0 一致。開啟後，若某台站在其上次被確認的心跳後 55 分鐘內再次聽到心跳，會被加入「永不答應這些呼號的心跳」，正如 JS8Call 將其加入其清單，操作台的 HB ACK 膠囊會標出它。要再次應答它，請把它從該清單中移除；關閉此項則清單保持不變。

english: Off by default, as in JS8Call. On, nothing addressed to @ALLCALL is answered (a QUERY MSGS included) or marked as addressed to you, and @ALLCALL leaves the To box’s list. Heartbeats and CQs are handled as before.
chinese: 預設關閉，與 JS8Call 一致。開啟後，任何發往 @ALLCALL 的內容都不會被應答（包括 QUERY MSGS），也不會被標記為發給你的，且 @ALLCALL 會從「收件人」框的清單中移除。心跳與 CQ 的處理方式不變。

english: On by default, as in JS8Call: SNR?, GRID?, INFO?, STATUS?, HEARING? and QUERY MSGS addressed to you are answered, and a MSG to you or to a group you joined, or a MSG TO: you hold for another station, gets an ACK; each one first asks for your Yes in the cockpit, unless you turn that off below. On @ALLCALL only QUERY MSGS is answered, when a message waits for that station, at most once every 15 minutes. Off, a reply is put in the message box for you to send, as JS8Call does, and QUERY MSGS is not answered. Needs TX on.
chinese: 預設開啟，與 JS8Call 一致：發給你的 SNR?、GRID?、INFO?、STATUS?、HEARING? 和 QUERY MSGS 會被應答；發給你的、或發給你所加入群組的 MSG，以及你為另一台站保留的 MSG TO:，會得到 ACK；除你在下方關閉確認外，每次都會先在操作台中徵求你的「是」。在 @ALLCALL 上僅當有訊息在等該台站時才應答 QUERY MSGS，且最多每 15 分鐘一次。關閉後，回覆會被放進訊息框由你傳送，與 JS8Call 一致，且 QUERY MSGS 不應答。需要 TX 開啟。
do_not_translate: JS8Call | SNR? | GRID? | INFO? | STATUS? | HEARING? | QUERY MSGS | MSG | MSG TO: | ACK | @ALLCALL | TX

english: Ask for confirmation before sending automatic replies
chinese: 傳送自動回覆前徵求確認

english: On by default, as in JS8Call: every automatic reply (to a query, an ACK, a relay, a heartbeat acknowledgement) waits in the cockpit for your Yes, and is not sent if you say No or do not answer within 89 seconds. Off, each goes by itself in the next period.
chinese: 預設開啟，與 JS8Call 一致：每次自動回覆（對詢問、ACK、中繼、心跳確認）都會在操作台中等待你的「是」，若你選「否」或 89 秒內未作答則不傳送。關閉後，每次都會在下一個週期自行發出。

english: Comma-separated. Empty, the JS8Call default, answers everyone. Otherwise only a station on this list, by its call as heard or its base call (W1AW covers W1AW/P), is answered; anyone else is not acted on at all: no reply, no relay, nothing filed or held for them.
chinese: 逗號分隔。留空（JS8Call 預設）則應答所有人。否則只應答此清單中的台站，按其聽到的呼號或基礎呼號（W1AW 覆蓋 W1AW/P）；對其他人完全不動作：不回覆、不中繼，也不為其歸檔或保留任何東西。
永不自動回覆這些呼號

english: Comma-separated, empty by default as in JS8Call. A station on this list (W1AW covers W1AW/P) is not acted on at all: no reply, no relay, its message not filed.
chinese: 逗號分隔，預設留空，與 JS8Call 一致。此清單中的台站（W1AW 覆蓋 W1AW/P）完全不動作：不回覆、不中繼，其訊息也不歸檔。

english: On by default, as in JS8Call: a message routed through your callsign is passed along (with Auto-reply off, it is put in the message box for you to send), and MSG TO: messages are held in your inbox until the addressee asks for them. This is third-party traffic — whether it is permitted where you operate is your call.
chinese: 預設開啟，與 JS8Call 一致：經你呼號路由的訊息會被轉發（若關閉自動回覆，則放入訊息框由你傳送），且 MSG TO: 訊息會在你的收件箱中保留，直到收件人索取。這屬於第三方轉信 — 在你所在地區是否允許，由你判斷。

english: After this long with nothing typed, heartbeats, auto-replies and relaying all switch off and the cockpit says so — the JS8Call rule, so an unattended station goes quiet. 60 by default; 0 turns the watchdog off; anything below 5 counts as 5. TX enable is left as it was.
chinese: 在這麼長時間無任何輸入後，心跳、自動回覆和中繼全部關閉，操作台會說明 — 即 JS8Call 的規則，讓無人值守的台站安靜下來。預設 60；0 關閉看門狗；小於 5 按 5 計。TX 啟用狀態保持不變。

english: What an INFO? query gets back — rig, antenna, power, a QTH. Upper-case letters, digits and basic punctuation pack tightest; anything else costs extra frames.
chinese: INFO? 詢問會得到什麼 — 電台、天線、功率、QTH。大寫字母、數字和基本標點打包最緊；其他字元會多耗幀。

english: What a STATUS? query gets back. Leave it blank for the JS8Call form: IDLE, the idle minutes, and the app name.
chinese: STATUS? 詢問會得到什麼。留空則使用 JS8Call 的格式：IDLE、空閒分鐘數以及應用名稱。

english: The @GROUP names you belong to, comma-separated — a message to one of them counts as addressed to you. @ALLCALL is everyone and is always on.
chinese: 你所屬的 @GROUP 名稱，逗號分隔 — 發給其中之一的訊息視為發給你。@ALLCALL 代表所有人，始終啟用。

english: Off by default, as in JS8Call. On, the radio stays keyed from the end of one frame of a message until the next frame starts, instead of dropping PTT after each frame and keying again. PTT still drops after the last frame, and at once when you stop transmitting.
chinese: 預設關閉，與 JS8Call 一致。開啟後，從一條訊息某幀結束到下一幀開始，電台保持鍵控，而不是每幀之後釋放 PTT 再重新鍵控。最後一幀後 PTT 仍會釋放，你停止發射時也會立即釋放。

english: Allow TX offset changes while sending
chinese: 傳送期間允許更改 TX 偏移

english: Off by default, as in JS8Call: while a message is waiting to go or going out, the TX offset stays where it is. On, you can move it at once: the frame on the air moves too, from where it has got to, and the frames still to go are sent at the new offset.
chinese: 預設關閉，與 JS8Call 一致：當訊息正在等待傳送或正在傳送時，TX 偏移保持不變。開啟後你可以立即移動它：空中的這一幀也會從它已到達的位置跟著移動，尚未傳送的幀則按新偏移傳送。

english: How long before each period a JS8 frame keys the radio, as JS8Call's Tx delay (0.2 s by default). The frame's first tone still goes out on time, at the period's start delay, so a radio slow to key no longer sends it late. Lengthen it for an amplifier or a radio whose relay is slow.
chinese: 每個週期之前多久鍵控電台，即 JS8Call 的 Tx delay（預設 0.2 秒）。該幀的第一個音調仍會按時在週期的起始延遲處發出，因此鍵控較慢的電台不再發晚。對功放或繼電器較慢的電台請加長。

english: What the CQ button and the repeating CQ send. {{default}}, the JS8Call default, is one CQ frame, and so is any of the eight CQ forms in the list. Longer text takes more frames. It must start with CQ or hold your callsign. Empty sends CQ CQ CQ and your square.
